summary_zh: 为了将视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的应用从网络图像扩展到传感器介导的物理环境，我们提出了多视角物理提示测试时自适应（MVP），这是一个仅前向框架，它通过将相机曝光三角——ISO、快门速度和光圈——视为物理提示，从而将测试时自适应（TTA）从 tokens 转移到 photons。在推理时，MVP获取每个场景的物理视角库，使用源亲和力分数选择前k个传感器设置，评估每个保留视角下的轻量级数字增强，过滤增强视角中最低熵的子集，并使用零温度 softmax（即硬投票）聚合预测。这种选择-然后-投票的设计简单、校准友好，并且不需要梯度或模型修改。在 ImageNet-ES 和 ImageNet-ES-Diverse 上，MVP 在单个自动曝光捕获图像上的性能始终优于纯数字 TTA，最多可达 25.6 个百分点（pp），并且比将传统传感器控制与 TTA 相结合的流程高出高达 3.4 pp 的额外增益。MVP 在降低捕获延迟的精简参数候选集下依然有效，证明了它的实用性。这些结果支持了主要结论，即除了捕获后提示之外，测量时间控制——选择和组合真实的物理视角——能够大幅提高 VLM 的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel test-time adaptation method (MVP) for vision-language models that uses physical camera settings (ISO, shutter speed, aperture) as prompts, significantly improving robustness in sensor-mediated environments compared to digital-only methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的视觉语言模型测试时自适应方法 (MVP)，该方法使用物理相机设置（ISO、快门速度、光圈）作为提示，与纯数字方法相比，显着提高了在传感器介导环境中的鲁棒性。

title: Adaptive Detector-Verifier Framework for Zero-Shot Polyp Detection in Open-World Settings
summary: Polyp detectors trained on clean datasets often underperform in real-world endoscopy, where illumination changes, motion blur, and occlusions degrade image quality. Existing approaches struggle with the domain gap between controlled laboratory conditions and clinical practice, where adverse imaging conditions are prevalent. In this work, we propose AdaptiveDetector, a novel two-stage detector-verifier framework comprising a YOLOv11 detector with a vision-language model (VLM) verifier. The detector adaptively adjusts per-frame confidence thresholds under VLM guidance, while the verifier is fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an asymmetric, cost-sensitive reward function specifically designed to discourage missed detections -- a critical clinical requirement. To enable realistic assessment under challenging conditions, we construct a comprehensive synthetic testbed by systematically degrading clean datasets with adverse conditions commonly encountered in clinical practice, providing a rigorous benchmark for zero-shot evaluation. Extensive zero-shot evaluation on synthetically degraded CVC-ClinicDB and Kvasir-SEG images demonstrates that our approach improves recall by 14 to 22 percentage points over YOLO alone, while precision remains within 0.7 points below to 1.7 points above the baseline. This combination of adaptive thresholding and cost-sensitive reinforcement learning achieves clinically aligned, open-world polyp detection with substantially fewer false negatives, thereby reducing the risk of missed precancerous polyps and improving patient outcomes.
summary_zh: 在干净数据集上训练的息肉检测器在实际内窥镜检查中往往表现不佳，因为光照变化、运动模糊和遮挡会降低图像质量。现有方法难以克服受控实验室条件与临床实践之间的领域差异，在临床实践中，不利成像条件普遍存在。在这项工作中，我们提出 AdaptiveDetector，一种新颖的两阶段检测器-验证器框架，包含一个 YOLOv11 检测器和一个视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 验证器。检测器在 VLM 的指导下自适应地调整每帧置信度阈值，同时验证器通过分组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 进行微调，采用非对称的、成本敏感的奖励函数，专门用于抑制漏检——这是一项关键的临床要求。为了能够在具有挑战性的条件下进行真实的评估，我们构建了一个全面的合成测试平台，通过系统地使用临床实践中常见的不利条件来降低干净数据集的质量，从而为零样本评估提供一个严格的基准。在合成降级的 CVC-ClinicDB 和 Kvasir-SEG 图像上进行的大量零样本评估表明，我们的方法比单独使用 YOLO 提高了 14 到 22 个百分点的召回率，同时精确率保持在基线以下 0.7 个点到以上 1.7 个点的范围内。这种自适应阈值和成本敏感强化学习的结合实现了与临床对齐的、开放世界的息肉检测，并大大减少了假阴性，从而降低了漏检癌前息肉的风险，并改善了患者的治疗结果。
tldr: The paper introduces an adaptive detector-verifier framework utilizing YOLOv11 and a vision-language model, fine-tuned with reinforcement learning, to improve zero-shot polyp detection in realistic, degraded endoscopic images. The approach significantly increases recall with a small impact on precision.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种自适应检测器-验证器框架，该框架利用YOLOv11和一个视觉-语言模型，并通过强化学习进行微调，以提高在真实的、退化的内窥镜图像中对息肉的零样本检测。该方法显著提高了召回率，而对精度的影响较小。

title: More Than the Final Answer: Improving Visual Extraction and Logical Consistency in Vision-Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended from text-only LLMs to vision-language models (VLMs) to elicit long-chain multimodal reasoning. However, RLVR-trained VLMs still exhibit two persistent failure modes: inaccurate visual extraction (missing or hallucinating details) and logically inconsistent chains-of-thought, largely because verifiable signals supervise only the final answer. We propose PeRL-VL (Perception and Reasoning Learning for Vision-Language Models), a decoupled framework that separately improves visual perception and textual reasoning on top of RLVR. For perception, PeRL-VL introduces a VLM-based description reward that scores the model's self-generated image descriptions for faithfulness and sufficiency. For reasoning, PeRL-VL adds a text-only Reasoning SFT stage on logic-rich chain-of-thought data, enhancing coherence and logical consistency independently of vision. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, PeRL-VL improves average Pass@1 accuracy from 63.3% (base Qwen2.5-VL-7B) to 68.8%, outperforming standard RLVR, text-only reasoning SFT, and naive multimodal distillation from GPT-4o.
summary_zh: 从可验证奖励中进行强化学习（RLVR）最近已从仅文本的大语言模型扩展到视觉语言模型（VLMs），以激发长链多模态推理。然而，经过RLVR训练的VLM仍然表现出两种持续存在的失败模式：不准确的视觉提取（遗漏或臆造细节）和逻辑上不一致的思维链，这主要是因为可验证的信号仅监督最终答案。我们提出了PeRL-VL（视觉语言模型的感知和推理学习），这是一个解耦框架，在RLVR的基础上分别改进视觉感知和文本推理。对于感知，PeRL-VL引入了一种基于VLM的描述奖励，该奖励根据真实性和充分性对模型自主生成的图像描述进行评分。对于推理，PeRL-VL增加了一个纯文本推理SFT阶段，其基于逻辑丰富的思维链数据，独立于视觉增强一致性和逻辑一致性。在不同的多模态基准测试中，PeRL-VL将平均Pass@1准确率从63.3%（基础Qwen2.5-VL-7B）提高到68.8%，优于标准RLVR、纯文本推理SFT以及来自GPT-4o的朴素多模态蒸馏。
tldr: The paper introduces PeRL-VL, a framework that improves VLMs by separately enhancing visual perception (using a VLM-based description reward) and textual reasoning (using reasoning-specific SFT), leading to improved performance on multimodal benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PeRL-VL的框架，该框架通过分别增强视觉感知（使用基于VLM的描述奖励）和文本推理（使用特定于推理的SFT）来改进VLM，从而提高多模态基准测试的性能。

title: HMPCC: Human-Aware Model Predictive Coverage Control
summary: We address the problem of coordinating a team of robots to cover an unknown environment while ensuring safe operation and avoiding collisions with non-cooperative agents. Traditional coverage strategies often rely on simplified assumptions, such as known or convex environments and static density functions, and struggle to adapt to real-world scenarios, especially when humans are involved. In this work, we propose a human-aware coverage framework based on Model Predictive Control (MPC), namely HMPCC, where human motion predictions are integrated into the planning process. By anticipating human trajectories within the MPC horizon, robots can proactively coordinate their actions %avoid redundant exploration, and adapt to dynamic conditions. The environment is modeled as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), representing regions of interest. Team members operate in a fully decentralized manner, without relying on explicit communication, an essential feature in hostile or communication-limited scenarios. Our results show that human trajectory forecasting enables more efficient and adaptive coverage, improving coordination between human and robotic agents.
summary_zh: 我们研究的问题是协调一组机器人覆盖一个未知环境，同时确保安全运行并避免与非合作主体的碰撞。传统的覆盖策略通常依赖于简化的假设，例如已知或凸环境以及静态密度函数，并且难以适应真实场景，尤其是在涉及人类时。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于模型预测控制(MPC)的人类感知覆盖框架，即HMPCC，其中人类运动预测被整合到规划过程中。通过预测MPC范围内的行人轨迹，机器人可以主动地协调它们的动作、避免冗余探索并适应动态条件。环境被建模为高斯混合模型(GMM)，用于表示感兴趣的区域。团队成员以完全去中心化的方式运行，无需依赖显式通信，这是在恶劣或通信受限场景中的一项关键特征。我们的结果表明，人类轨迹预测能够实现更高效和自适应的覆盖，从而改善人与机器人智能体之间的协调。
tldr: The paper introduces a human-aware Model Predictive Coverage Control (HMPCC) framework for robot teams to efficiently cover unknown environments by predicting and avoiding human collisions, operating in a decentralized manner without explicit communication.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种人机协作的模型预测覆盖控制（HMPCC）框架，它允许机器人团队通过预测和避免与人类的碰撞来有效地覆盖未知的环境，以一种去中心化的方式运行，无需显式通信。

title: Bayesian Optimization Parameter Tuning Framework for a Lyapunov Based Path Following Controller
summary: Parameter tuning in real-world experiments is constrained by the limited evaluation budget available on hardware. The path-following controller studied in this paper reflects a typical situation in nonlinear geometric controller, where multiple gains influence the dynamics through coupled nonlinear terms. Such interdependence makes manual tuning inefficient and unlikely to yield satisfactory performance within a practical number of trials. To address this challenge, we propose a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that treats the closed-loop system as a black box and selects controller gains using a Gaussian-process surrogate. BO offers model-free exploration, quantified uncertainty, and data-efficient search, making it well suited for tuning tasks where each evaluation is costly. The framework is implemented on Honda's AI-Formula three-wheeled robot and assessed through repeated full-lap experiments on a fixed test track. The results show that BO improves controller performance within 32 trials, including 15 warm-start initial evaluations, indicating that it can efficiently locate high-performing regions of the parameter space under real-world conditions. These findings demonstrate that BO provides a practical, reliable, and data-efficient tuning approach for nonlinear path-following controllers on real robotic platforms.
summary_zh: 在真实世界实验中，参数调优受到硬件上有限的评估预算的制约。本文研究的路径跟踪控制器反映了非线性几何控制器的典型情况，其中多个增益通过耦合的非线性项影响动力学。这种相互依赖性使得手动调优效率低下，并且难以在实际次数的试验内获得令人满意的性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，该框架将闭环系统视为一个黑盒，并使用高斯过程代理模型选择控制器增益。BO 提供了无模型的探索、量化的不确定性和数据高效的搜索，使其非常适合于每次评估成本高昂的调优任务。该框架在 Honda 的 AI-Formula 三轮机器人上实现，并通过在固定测试赛道上重复进行完整圈实验进行评估。结果表明，BO 在 32 次试验内提高了控制器性能，包括 15 次热启动初始评估，表明它可以有效地定位真实世界条件下参数空间中的高性能区域。这些发现表明，BO 为真实机器人平台上非线性路径跟踪控制器提供了一种实用的、可靠的和数据高效的调优方法。
tldr: This paper presents a Bayesian Optimization (BO) framework for tuning path-following controllers on a real robot, demonstrating its efficiency in finding optimal parameters with limited trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，用于在真实机器人上调整路径跟随控制器，证明了其在有限试验中寻找最优参数的效率。

title: Autonomously Unweaving Multiple Cables Using Visual Feedback
summary: Many cable management tasks involve separating out the different cables and removing tangles. Automating this task is challenging because cables are deformable and can have combinations of knots and multiple interwoven segments. Prior works have focused on untying knots in one cable, which is one subtask of cable management. However, in this paper, we focus on a different subtask called multi-cable unweaving, which refers to removing the intersections among multiple interwoven cables to separate them and facilitate further manipulation. We propose a method that utilizes visual feedback to unweave a bundle of loosely entangled cables. We formulate cable unweaving as a pick-and-place problem, where the grasp position is selected from discrete nodes in a graph-based cable state representation. Our cable state representation encodes both topological and geometric information about the cables from the visual image. To predict future cable states and identify valid actions, we present a novel state transition model that takes into account the straightening and bending of cables during manipulation. Using this state transition model, we select between two high-level action primitives and calculate predicted immediate costs to optimize the lower-level actions. We experimentally demonstrate that iterating the above perception-planning-action process enables unweaving electric cables and shoelaces with an 84% success rate on average.
summary_zh: 许多电缆管理任务涉及分离不同的电缆并消除缠结。 自动化此任务具有挑战性，因为电缆是可变形的，并且可能具有多种类型的结和多个交织段的组合。 先前的工作主要集中于解开单根电缆上的结，这只是电缆管理的一个子任务。 然而，在本文中，我们专注于一个不同的子任务，称为多电缆解编，它指的是消除多根交织电缆之间的交叉点，以分离它们并促进进一步操作。 我们提出了一种利用视觉反馈解编松散缠绕的电缆束的方法。 我们将电缆解编形式化为一个抓取放置问题，其中抓取位置是从基于图的电缆状态表示中的离散节点中选择的。 我们的电缆状态表示编码了来自视觉图像的电缆的拓扑和几何信息。 为了预测未来的电缆状态并识别有效的动作，我们提出了一种新颖的状态转移模型，该模型考虑了操作过程中电缆的拉直和弯曲。 使用此状态转移模型，我们在两个高级动作原语之间进行选择，并计算预测的即时成本，以优化低级动作。 实验结果表明，迭代上述感知-规划-行动过程能够解编电线和鞋带，平均成功率为 84%。
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based method for autonomously unweaving multiple loosely tangled cables by formulating it as a pick-and-place problem and using a novel state transition model to predict cable states during manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的自动解开多根松散缠绕电缆的方法，将其定义为抓取放置问题，并使用一种新的状态转移模型来预测操作过程中电缆的状态。

title: Unifying Quadrotor Motion Planning and Control by Chaining Different Fidelity Models
summary: Many aerial tasks involving quadrotors demand both instant reactivity and long-horizon planning. High-fidelity models enable accurate control but are too slow for long horizons; low-fidelity planners scale but degrade closed-loop performance. We present Unique, a unified MPC that cascades models of different fidelity within a single optimization: a short-horizon, high-fidelity model for accurate control, and a long-horizon, low-fidelity model for planning. We align costs across horizons, derive feasibility-preserving thrust and body-rate constraints for the point-mass model, and introduce transition constraints that match the different states, thrust-induced acceleration, and jerk-body-rate relations. To prevent local minima emerging from nonsmooth clutter, we propose a 3D progressive smoothing schedule that morphs norm-based obstacles along the horizon. In addition, we deploy parallel randomly initialized MPC solvers to discover lower-cost local minima on the long, low-fidelity horizon. In simulation and real flights, under equal computational budgets, Unique improves closed-loop position or velocity tracking by up to 75% compared with standard MPC and hierarchical planner-tracker baselines. Ablations and Pareto analyses confirm robust gains across horizon variations, constraint approximations, and smoothing schedules.
summary_zh: 许多涉及四旋翼无人机的空中任务既需要即时反应，又需要长远规划。高保真模型能够实现精确控制，但速度太慢不适用于长远规划；低保真规划器可以扩展规模，但会降低闭环性能。我们提出了 Unique，一种统一的 MPC（模型预测控制），在单个优化过程中级联不同保真度的模型：一个用于精确控制的短视距、高保真模型，以及一个用于规划的长视距、低保真模型。我们对齐跨视距的代价函数，推导了质点模型的保可行性推力和本体速率约束，并引入了过渡约束来匹配不同的状态、推力引起的加速度以及加加速度-本体速率关系。为了防止非光滑杂波中产生局部最小值，我们提出了一种3D渐进式平滑策略，该策略沿视距变形基于范数的障碍物。此外，我们部署并行随机初始化的 MPC 求解器，以在长视距、低保真视界上发现更低代价的局部最小值。在仿真和真实飞行中，在相同的计算预算下，与标准 MPC 和分层规划器-跟踪器基线相比，Unique 将闭环位置或速度跟踪性能提高了高达 75%。消融实验和帕累托分析证实了在不同的视距变化、约束近似和平滑策略上的稳健增益。
tldr: This paper presents a unified Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework named Unique for quadrotors, which combines high-fidelity and low-fidelity models to achieve both reactive control and long-horizon planning, demonstrating significant performance improvements in simulations and real flights.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Unique的统一模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于四旋翼飞行器，该框架结合了高保真和低保真模型，实现了反应控制和长时程规划，并在仿真和实际飞行中表现出显著的性能提升。

title: Adaptive Edge-Cloud Inference for Speech-to-Action Systems Using ASR and Large Language Models (ASTA)
summary: Voice-based interaction has emerged as a natural and intuitive modality for controlling IoT devices. However, speech-driven edge devices face a fundamental trade-off between cloud-based solutions, which offer stronger language understanding capabilities at the cost of latency, connectivity dependence, and privacy concerns, and edge-based solutions, which provide low latency and improved privacy but are limited by computational constraints. This paper presents ASTA, an adaptive speech-to-action solution that dynamically routes voice commands between edge and cloud inference to balance performance and system resource utilization. ASTA integrates on-device automatic speech recognition and lightweight offline language-model inference with cloud-based LLM processing, guided by real-time system metrics such as CPU workload, device temperature, and network latency. A metric-aware routing mechanism selects the inference path at runtime, while a rule-based command validation and repair component ensures successful end-to-end command execution. We implemented our solution on an NVIDIA Jetson-based edge platform and evaluated it using a diverse dataset of 80 spoken commands. Experimental results show that ASTA successfully routes all input commands for execution, achieving a balanced distribution between online and offline inference. The system attains an ASR accuracy of 62.5% and generates executable commands without repair for only 47.5% of inputs, highlighting the importance of the repair mechanism in improving robustness. These results suggest that adaptive edge-cloud orchestration is a viable approach for resilient and resource-aware voice-controlled IoT systems.
summary_zh: 基于语音的交互已经成为控制物联网设备的一种自然且直观的方式。然而，语音驱动的边缘设备面临着一个根本性的权衡：云端解决方案提供更强的语言理解能力，但代价是延迟、连接依赖以及隐私问题；边缘解决方案提供更低的延迟和改进的隐私，但受到计算能力的限制。本文提出了一种自适应的语音到行动解决方案ASTA，它动态地在边缘和云端推理之间路由语音命令，以平衡性能和系统资源利用率。ASTA集成了设备上的自动语音识别和轻量级的离线语言模型推理，以及基于云端的LLM处理，并由实时的系统指标（如CPU负载、设备温度和网络延迟）引导。一种感知度量的路由机制在运行时选择推理路径，而一个基于规则的命令验证和修复组件确保端到端命令的成功执行。我们在一个基于NVIDIA Jetson的边缘平台上实现了我们的解决方案，并使用包含80条口语命令的多样化数据集对其进行了评估。实验结果表明，ASTA成功地路由所有输入命令以执行，并在在线和离线推理之间实现了均衡的分布。该系统达到了62.5%的ASR准确率，并且仅为47.5%的输入生成了无需修复的可执行命令，突显了修复机制在提高鲁棒性方面的重要性。这些结果表明，自适应的边缘-云编排是构建弹性且资源感知的语音控制物联网系统的一种可行方法。
tldr: The paper presents ASTA, an adaptive edge-cloud system for voice-controlled IoT devices that dynamically routes voice commands between edge and cloud inference based on system metrics to balance performance and resource utilization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ASTA，一种自适应边缘-云系统，用于语音控制的物联网设备，它根据系统度量标准动态地将语音命令路由到边缘和云端推理之间，以平衡性能和资源利用率。

title: InteracTalker: Prompt-Based Human-Object Interaction with Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Generating realistic human motions that naturally respond to both spoken language and physical objects is crucial for interactive digital experiences. Current methods, however, address speech-driven gestures or object interactions independently, limiting real-world applicability due to a lack of integrated, comprehensive datasets. To overcome this, we introduce InteracTalker, a novel framework that seamlessly integrates prompt-based object-aware interactions with co-speech gesture generation. We achieve this by employing a multi-stage training process to learn a unified motion, speech, and prompt embedding space. To support this, we curate a rich human-object interaction dataset, formed by augmenting an existing text-to-motion dataset with detailed object interaction annotations. Our framework utilizes a Generalized Motion Adaptation Module that enables independent training, adapting to the corresponding motion condition, which is then dynamically combined during inference. To address the imbalance between heterogeneous conditioning signals, we propose an adaptive fusion strategy, which dynamically reweights the conditioning signals during diffusion sampling. InteracTalker successfully unifies these previously separate tasks, outperforming prior methods in both co-speech gesture generation and object-interaction synthesis, outperforming gesture-focused diffusion methods, yielding highly realistic, object-aware full-body motions with enhanced realism, flexibility, and control.
summary_zh: 生成对口语和物理对象都能自然响应的逼真人體動作对于交互式数字体验至关重要。然而，目前的方法通常独立地处理语音驱动的手势或对象交互，由于缺乏集成、全面的数据集，限制了其在现实世界中的应用。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了InteracTalker，一个新颖的框架，它将基于提示的对象感知交互与伴随语音的手势生成无缝集成。我们通过采用多阶段训练过程来实现这一目标，学习一个统一的运动、语音和提示嵌入空间。为了支持这一点，我们整理了一个丰富的人与对象交互数据集，该数据集通过使用详细的对象交互注释来扩充现有的文本到运动数据集而形成。我们的框架利用通用运动适应模块，该模块能够进行独立训练，适应相应的运动条件，然后在推理期间动态组合。为了解决异构条件信号之间的不平衡问题，我们提出了一种自适应融合策略，该策略在扩散采样期间动态地重新加权条件信号。InteracTalker成功地统一了这些先前分离的任务，在伴随语音的手势生成和对象交互合成方面均优于先前的方法，并优于专注于手势的扩散方法，从而产生了高度真实、对象感知的全身运动，且具有增强的真实性、灵活性和控制性。
tldr: InteracTalker introduces a novel framework for generating realistic human motions that respond to both spoken language and object interactions by learning a unified embedding space and using an adaptive fusion strategy. They also curate a new human-object interaction dataset.
tldr_zh: InteracTalker 引入了一个新的框架，用于生成响应口语和物体交互的真实人体运动，通过学习统一的嵌入空间并使用自适应融合策略。他们还策划了一个新的人体-物体交互数据集。

title: Geometry-Aware Scene-Consistent Image Generation
summary: We study geometry-aware scene-consistent image generation: given a reference scene image and a text condition specifying an entity to be generated in the scene and its spatial relation to the scene, the goal is to synthesize an output image that preserves the same physical environment as the reference scene while correctly generating the entity according to the spatial relation described in the text. Existing methods struggle to balance scene preservation with prompt adherence: they either replicate the scene with high fidelity but poor responsiveness to the prompt, or prioritize prompt compliance at the expense of scene consistency. To resolve this trade-off, we introduce two key contributions: (i) a scene-consistent data construction pipeline that generates diverse, geometrically-grounded training pairs, and (ii) a novel geometry-guided attention loss that leverages cross-view cues to regularize the model's spatial reasoning. Experiments on our scene-consistent benchmark show that our approach achieves better scene alignment and text-image consistency than state-of-the-art baselines, according to both automatic metrics and human preference studies. Our method produces geometrically coherent images with diverse compositions that remain faithful to the textual instructions and the underlying scene structure.
summary_zh: 我们研究几何感知的场景一致图像生成：给定参考场景图像和文本条件，该文本条件指定要在场景中生成的实体及其与场景的空间关系，目标是合成输出图像，该图像在正确地根据文本中描述的空间关系生成实体的同时，保留与参考场景相同的物理环境。现有方法难以平衡场景保留与提示遵循：它们要么以高保真度复制场景但对提示的响应性较差，要么优先考虑提示的依从性而牺牲了场景一致性。为了解决这种权衡，我们引入了两个关键贡献：（i）一种场景一致的数据构建流程，可生成多样化的、几何上接地的训练对，以及（ii）一种新颖的几何引导注意力损失，该损失利用跨视角线索来规范模型的空间推理。在我们场景一致的基准测试上的实验表明，根据自动指标和人工偏好研究，我们的方法比最先进的基线方法实现了更好的场景对齐和文本-图像一致性。我们的方法生成了几何连贯的图像，这些图像具有多样化的组合，并且仍然忠实于文本指令和底层场景结构。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating scene-consistent images based on text prompts by using a new data construction pipeline and a geometry-guided attention loss, achieving better results than existing methods in preserving scene geometry while adhering to the text prompt.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于文本提示生成场景一致图像的方法，通过新的数据构建流程和几何引导的注意力损失，在保持场景几何结构的同时，更好地遵循文本提示，效果优于现有方法。

title: Animus3D: Text-driven 3D Animation via Motion Score Distillation
summary: We present Animus3D, a text-driven 3D animation framework that generates motion field given a static 3D asset and text prompt. Previous methods mostly leverage the vanilla Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) objective to distill motion from pretrained text-to-video diffusion, leading to animations with minimal movement or noticeable jitter. To address this, our approach introduces a novel SDS alternative, Motion Score Distillation (MSD). Specifically, we introduce a LoRA-enhanced video diffusion model that defines a static source distribution rather than pure noise as in SDS, while another inversion-based noise estimation technique ensures appearance preservation when guiding motion. To further improve motion fidelity, we incorporate explicit temporal and spatial regularization terms that mitigate geometric distortions across time and space. Additionally, we propose a motion refinement module to upscale the temporal resolution and enhance fine-grained details, overcoming the fixed-resolution constraints of the underlying video model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Animus3D successfully animates static 3D assets from diverse text prompts, generating significantly more substantial and detailed motion than state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining high visual integrity. Code will be released at https://qiisun.github.io/animus3d_page.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Animus3D，一个文本驱动的3D动画框架，该框架在给定静态3D资产和文本提示的情况下生成运动场。以往方法通常利用原始的Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) 目标函数从预训练的文本到视频扩散模型中蒸馏运动，导致动画的运动幅度极小或存在明显的抖动。为了解决这个问题，我们的方法引入了一种新的SDS替代方案，即运动得分蒸馏 (MSD)。具体来说，我们引入了一个LoRA增强的视频扩散模型，该模型定义了一个静态源分布，而不是像SDS中那样使用纯噪声，同时另一种基于反演的噪声估计技术确保引导运动时的外观保持。为了进一步提高运动的保真度，我们加入了显式的时域和空域正则化项，以减少时间和空间上的几何失真。此外，我们提出了一个运动细化模块，用于提升时间分辨率并增强精细细节，从而克服了底层视频模型的固定分辨率约束。大量的实验表明，Animus3D能够成功地从各种文本提示中为静态3D资产制作动画，与最先进的基线方法相比，生成显著更大且更精细的运动，同时保持很高的视觉完整性。代码将在https://qiisun.github.io/animus3d_page发布。
tldr: Animus3D introduces a novel Motion Score Distillation (MSD) framework for text-driven 3D animation, addressing limitations of existing SDS-based methods through improved motion fidelity and detail.
tldr_zh: Animus3D 提出了一种新的运动分数蒸馏 (MSD) 框架，用于文本驱动的 3D 动画，通过改进的运动保真度和细节解决了现有基于 SDS 的方法的局限性。

title: Self-Motivated Growing Neural Network for Adaptive Architecture via Local Structural Plasticity
summary:
Control policies in deep reinforcement learning are often implemented with fixed-capacity multilayer perceptrons trained by backpropagation, which lack structural plasticity and depend on global error signals. This paper introduces the Self-Motivated Growing Neural Network (SMGrNN), a controller whose topology evolves online through a local Structural Plasticity Module (SPM). The SPM monitors neuron activations and edge-wise weight update statistics over short temporal windows and uses these signals to trigger neuron insertion and pruning, while synaptic weights are updated by a standard gradient-based optimizer. This allows network capacity to be regulated during learning without manual architectural tuning.
  SMGrNN is evaluated on control benchmarks via policy distillation. Compared with multilayer perceptron baselines, it achieves similar or higher returns, lower variance, and task-appropriate network sizes. Ablation studies with growth disabled and growth-only variants isolate the role of structural plasticity, showing that adaptive topology improves reward stability. The local and modular design of SPM enables future integration of a Hebbian plasticity module and spike-timing-dependent plasticity, so that SMGrNN can support both artificial and spiking neural implementations driven by local rules.
summary_zh:
深度强化学习中的控制策略通常采用固定容量的多层感知机实现，这些网络通过反向传播训练，缺乏结构可塑性，且依赖于全局误差信号。本文提出了一种自激励增长神经网络（SMGrNN），其控制器的拓扑结构通过一个局部结构可塑性模块（SPM）在线演化。SPM在短时窗内监测神经元激活和边权重的更新统计信息，并利用这些信号触发神经元的插入和修剪，而突触权重则通过标准的基于梯度的优化器进行更新。这使得网络容量在学习过程中可以自动调节，无需手动调整架构。

SMGrNN通过策略蒸馏在控制基准上进行了评估。与多层感知机基线相比，它实现了相似或更高的回报，更低的方差，以及适合任务的网络规模。消融研究分别禁用增长和仅启用增长，分离出结构可塑性的作用，表明自适应拓扑可以提升奖励稳定性。 SPM的局部和模块化设计使得未来能够集成赫布可塑性模块和基于脉冲时间依赖的可塑性，从而使SMGrNN能够支持由局部规则驱动的人工和脉冲神经实现。
tldr: This paper introduces SMGrNN, a self-motivated growing neural network controller with local structural plasticity for deep reinforcement learning, showing comparable or better performance than MLP baselines with adaptive network sizes.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了SMGrNN，一个具有局部结构可塑性的自驱动增长神经网络控制器，用于深度强化学习，并在具有自适应网络规模的情况下，表现出与MLP基线相当或更好的性能。

title: Sparse Concept Anchoring for Interpretable and Controllable Neural Representations
summary: We introduce Sparse Concept Anchoring, a method that biases latent space to position a targeted subset of concepts while allowing others to self-organize, using only minimal supervision (labels for <0.1% of examples per anchored concept). Training combines activation normalization, a separation regularizer, and anchor or subspace regularizers that attract rare labeled examples to predefined directions or axis-aligned subspaces. The anchored geometry enables two practical interventions: reversible behavioral steering that projects out a concept's latent component at inference, and permanent removal via targeted weight ablation of anchored dimensions. Experiments on structured autoencoders show selective attenuation of targeted concepts with negligible impact on orthogonal features, and complete elimination with reconstruction error approaching theoretical bounds. Sparse Concept Anchoring therefore provides a practical pathway to interpretable, steerable behavior in learned representations.
summary_zh: 我们引入了稀疏概念锚定，这是一种偏置潜在空间的方法，它能够定位目标概念子集，同时允许其他概念进行自组织，仅需极少的监督（每个锚定概念的标签少于0.1%的样本）。训练结合了激活归一化、分离正则化器，以及锚定或子空间正则化器，后者将稀有标签样本吸引到预定义的方向或与轴对齐的子空间。这种锚定的几何结构实现了两种实用的干预措施：可逆的行为引导，即在推理时投影去除概念的潜在分量；以及永久移除，即通过目标权重消融锚定维度。在结构化自编码器上的实验表明，可以有选择性地衰减目标概念，同时对正交特征的影响可以忽略不计，并通过接近理论界限的重建误差来实现完全消除。因此，稀疏概念锚定为已学习表示中的可解释、可引导行为提供了一条可行的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces Sparse Concept Anchoring, a method to create interpretable and controllable neural representations by biasing the latent space with minimal supervision to position a targeted subset of concepts. This enables reversible behavioral steering and permanent removal of anchored dimensions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为稀疏概念锚定的方法，通过以最小监督的方式偏置潜在空间，以定位目标概念的子集，从而创建可解释和可控的神经表示。 这可以实现可逆的行为引导和目标维度的永久移除。

title: Optimized Conflict Management for Urban Air Mobility Using Swarm UAV Networks
summary: Urban Air Mobility (UAM) poses unprecedented traffic coordination challenges, especially with increasing UAV densities in dense urban corridors. This paper introduces a mathematical model using a control algorithm to optimize an Edge AI-driven decentralized swarm architecture for intelligent conflict resolution, enabling real-time decision-making with low latency. Using lightweight neural networks, the system leverages edge nodes to perform distributed conflict detection and resolution. A simulation platform was developed to evaluate the scheme under various UAV densities. Results indicate that the conflict resolution time is dramatically minimized up to 3.8 times faster, and accuracy is enhanced compared to traditional centralized control models. The proposed architecture is highly promising for scalable, efficient, and safe aerial traffic management in future UAM systems.
summary_zh: 城市空中交通(UAM)带来了前所未有的交通协调挑战，尤其是在密集城区走廊中无人机密度不断增加的情况下。本文介绍了一种数学模型，该模型利用控制算法来优化边缘AI驱动的去中心化集群架构，以实现智能冲突消解，从而能够以低延迟进行实时决策。该系统利用轻量级神经网络，利用边缘节点执行分布式冲突检测和消解。我们开发了一个仿真平台来评估该方案在各种无人机密度下的性能。结果表明，与传统的中心化控制模型相比，冲突消解时间显著缩短，最高可达3.8倍，并且准确性得到了提高。所提出的架构在未来UAM系统中具有高度潜力，可以实现可扩展、高效和安全的空中交通管理。
tldr: This paper introduces an Edge AI-driven decentralized swarm architecture for real-time UAV conflict resolution in Urban Air Mobility, showing significant improvements in speed and accuracy compared to centralized approaches via simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种边缘AI驱动的去中心化集群架构，用于城市空中交通中无人机的实时冲突解决。通过仿真表明，与集中式方法相比，该方法在速度和准确性方面都有显著提升。

title: Sim2Real Reinforcement Learning for Soccer skills
summary: This thesis work presents a more efficient and effective approach to training control-related tasks for humanoid robots using Reinforcement Learning (RL). The traditional RL methods are limited in adapting to real-world environments, complexity, and natural motions, but the proposed approach overcomes these limitations by using curriculum training and Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP) technique. The results show that the developed RL policies for kicking, walking, and jumping are more dynamic, and adaptive, and outperformed previous methods. However, the transfer of the learned policy from simulation to the real world was unsuccessful, highlighting the limitations of current RL methods in fully adapting to real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 本论文提出了一种更高效和有效的强化学习（RL）方法，用于训练人形机器人控制相关的任务。传统的强化学习方法在适应真实世界环境、复杂度和自然运动方面存在局限性，而提出的方法通过使用课程学习和对抗性运动先验（AMP）技术克服了这些局限性。结果表明，所开发的用于踢球、行走和跳跃的强化学习策略更具动态性和适应性，并且优于以往的方法。然而，学习到的策略从仿真环境到真实世界的迁移并不成功，突显了当前强化学习方法在完全适应真实世界场景方面的局限性。
tldr: This paper explores Sim2Real Reinforcement Learning for humanoid robot soccer skills, using curriculum training and Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP). While the simulation results are promising, the transfer to the real world failed, highlighting Sim2Real challenges.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了使用课程学习和对抗运动先验 (AMP) 的类人机器人足球技能的 Sim2Real 强化学习。 仿真结果很有希望，但转移到现实世界失败，突显了 Sim2Real 挑战。

title: Robust Motion Generation using Part-level Reliable Data from Videos
summary:
Extracting human motion from large-scale web videos offers a scalable solution to the data scarcity issue in character animation. However, some human parts in many video frames cannot be seen due to off-screen captures or occlusions. It brings a dilemma: discarding the data missing any part limits scale and diversity, while retaining it compromises data quality and model performance.
  To address this problem, we propose leveraging credible part-level data extracted from videos to enhance motion generation via a robust part-aware masked autoregression model. First, we decompose a human body into five parts and detect the parts clearly seen in a video frame as "credible". Second, the credible parts are encoded into latent tokens by our proposed part-aware variational autoencoder. Third, we propose a robust part-level masked generation model to predict masked credible parts, while ignoring those noisy parts.
  In addition, we contribute K700-M, a challenging new benchmark comprising approximately 200k real-world motion sequences, for evaluation. Experimental results indicate that our method successfully outperforms baselines on both clean and noisy datasets in terms of motion quality, semantic consistency and diversity. Project page: https://boyuaner.github.io/ropar-main/
summary_zh:
从大规模网络视频中提取人体运动为角色动画中的数据稀缺问题提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。然而，由于屏幕外捕捉或遮挡，许多视频帧中的某些人体部位无法被看到。这带来了一个两难困境：丢弃任何部位缺失的数据会限制规模和多样性，而保留它则会损害数据质量和模型性能。

为了解决这个问题，我们提出利用从视频中提取的可信部位级数据，通过一个稳健的部位感知掩码自回归模型来增强运动生成。首先，我们将人体分解为五个部位，并将视频帧中清晰可见的部位检测为“可信”部位。其次，通过我们提出的部位感知变分自编码器，将可信部位编码为潜在令牌。第三，我们提出一个稳健的部位级掩码生成模型，用于预测被掩盖的可信部位，同时忽略那些噪声部位。

此外，我们贡献了 K700-M，这是一个具有挑战性的新基准，包含大约 20 万个真实世界运动序列，用于评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在运动质量、语义一致性和多样性方面均优于清洁和噪声数据集上的基线方法。项目主页：https://boyuaner.github.io/ropar-main/
tldr: This paper introduces a part-aware masked autoregression model for robust human motion generation from noisy web videos, contributing a new benchmark dataset K700-M and demonstrating superior performance compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种部分感知（part-aware）的掩码自回归模型，用于从嘈杂的网络视频中稳健地生成人体运动。同时，论文贡献了一个新的基准数据集 K700-M，并展示了优于现有方法的性能。

title: Co-Exploration and Co-Exploitation via Shared Structure in Multi-Task Bandits
summary: We propose a novel Bayesian framework for efficient exploration in contextual multi-task multi-armed bandit settings, where the context is only observed partially and dependencies between reward distributions are induced by latent context variables. In order to exploit these structural dependencies, our approach integrates observations across all tasks and learns a global joint distribution, while still allowing personalised inference for new tasks. In this regard, we identify two key sources of epistemic uncertainty, namely structural uncertainty in the latent reward dependencies across arms and tasks, and user-specific uncertainty due to incomplete context and limited interaction history. To put our method into practice, we represent the joint distribution over tasks and rewards using a particle-based approximation of a log-density Gaussian process. This representation enables flexible, data-driven discovery of both inter-arm and inter-task dependencies without prior assumptions on the latent variables. Empirically, we demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines such as hierarchical model bandits, especially in settings with model misspecification or complex latent heterogeneity.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯框架，用于在上下文多任务多臂老虎机环境中进行高效探索，其中上下文仅被部分观察到，并且奖励分布之间的依赖关系由潜在上下文变量引起。为了利用这些结构依赖关系，我们的方法整合了所有任务的观测结果并学习全局联合分布，同时仍然允许对新任务进行个性化推断。在这方面，我们识别出两种主要的认知不确定性来源，即臂和任务之间潜在奖励依赖关系中的结构不确定性，以及由于不完整的上下文和有限的交互历史导致的用户特定不确定性。为了将我们的方法付诸实践，我们使用对数密度高斯过程的基于粒子的近似来表示任务和奖励上的联合分布。这种表示能够灵活地、数据驱动地发现臂间和任务间依赖关系，而无需对潜在变量进行先验假设。实证表明，我们的方法优于分层模型老虎机等基线方法，尤其是在模型失真或复杂潜在异质性的情况下。
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian framework for multi-task bandit problems with partial context observation, using a particle-based approximation of a Gaussian process to model inter-task dependencies and enhance exploration. It outperforms hierarchical model bandits, particularly in complex or misspecified settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯框架，用于解决具有部分上下文观测的多任务bandit问题。该框架使用基于粒子的近似高斯过程来建模任务间的依赖关系，并增强探索能力。在复杂或模型错误设定的情况下，该方法优于分层模型bandit。

title: High Order Control Lyapunov Function - Control Barrier Function - Quadratic Programming Based Autonomous Driving Controller for Bicyclist Safety
summary: Ensuring the safety of Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) is a critical challenge in the development of advanced autonomous driving systems in smart cities. Among vulnerable road users, bicyclists present unique characteristics that make their safety both critical and also manageable. Vehicles often travel at significantly higher relative speeds when interacting with bicyclists as compared to their interactions with pedestrians which makes collision avoidance system design for bicyclist safety more challenging. Yet, bicyclist movements are generally more predictable and governed by clear traffic rules as compared to the sudden and sometimes erratic pedestrian motion, offering opportunities for model-based control strategies. To address bicyclist safety in complex traffic environments, this study proposes and develops a High Order Control Lyapunov Function High Order Control Barrier Function Quadratic Programming (HOCLF HOCBF QP) control framework. Through this framework, CLFs constraints guarantee system stability so that the vehicle can track its reference trajectory, whereas CBFs constraints ensure system safety by letting vehicle avoiding potential collisions region with surrounding obstacles. Then by solving a QP problem, an optimal control command that simultaneously satisfies stability and safety requirements can be calculated. Three key bicyclist crash scenarios recorded in the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) are recreated and used to comprehensively evaluate the proposed autonomous driving bicyclist safety control strategy in a simulation study. Simulation results demonstrate that the HOCLF HOCBF QP controller can help the vehicle perform robust, and collision-free maneuvers, highlighting its potential for improving bicyclist safety in complex traffic environments.
summary_zh: 在智慧城市中，确保弱势道路使用者（VRUs）的安全是高级自动驾驶系统开发中的一项关键挑战。在弱势道路使用者中，自行车骑行者具有独特的特点，使得他们的安全既至关重要又可控。与车辆与行人交互相比，车辆在与自行车骑行者交互时通常以更高的相对速度行驶，这使得针对自行车骑行者安全的防撞系统设计更具挑战性。然而，与行人突然且有时不稳定的运动相比，自行车骑行者的运动通常更可预测，并受明确的交通规则约束，这为基于模型的控制策略提供了机会。为了解决复杂交通环境中自行车骑行者的安全问题, 本研究提出并开发了一种高阶控制李雅普诺夫函数高阶控制障碍函数二次规划（HOCLF HOCBF QP）控制框架。通过该框架，CLF约束保证了系统的稳定性，使车辆能够跟踪其参考轨迹；而CBF约束则通过使车辆避开与周围物体的潜在碰撞区域来确保系统的安全性。然后，通过求解一个QP问题，可以计算出一个同时满足稳定性和安全性要求的最佳控制指令。重现了交通事故分析报告系统（FARS）中记录的三个关键自行车骑行者碰撞场景，并将其用于在仿真研究中全面评估所提出的自动驾驶自行车骑行者安全控制策略。仿真结果表明，HOCLF HOCBF QP控制器可以帮助车辆执行稳健且无碰撞的行驶动作，突出了其在改善复杂交通环境中自行车骑行者安全方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a High Order Control Lyapunov Function - Control Barrier Function - Quadratic Programming (HOCLF HOCBF QP) control framework for autonomous vehicles to ensure bicyclist safety, demonstrating its effectiveness in simulated crash scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高阶控制李雅普诺夫函数-控制障碍函数-二次规划（HOCLF HOCBF QP）的控制框架，用于自动驾驶车辆确保自行车骑行者的安全，并在模拟碰撞场景中展示了其有效性。

title: Making Robots Play by the Rules: The ROS 2 CLIPS-Executive
summary: CLIPS is a rule-based programming language for building knowledge-driven applications, well suited for the complex task of coordinating autonomous robots. Inspired by the CLIPS-Executive originally developed for the lesser known Fawkes robotics framework, we present an Integration of CLIPS into the ROS ecosystem. Additionally, we show the flexibility of CLIPS by describing a PDDL-based planning framework integration.
summary_zh: CLIPS是一种基于规则的编程语言，用于构建知识驱动型应用，非常适合协调自主机器人等复杂任务。受最初为鲜为人知的Fawkes机器人框架开发的CLIPS-Executive启发，我们提出了CLIPS与ROS生态系统的集成方案。此外，我们通过描述一个基于PDDL的规划框架集成，展示了CLIPS的灵活性。
tldr: This paper presents a CLIPS-based executive for ROS 2, enabling rule-based programming and PDDL-based planning for robotics applications within the ROS ecosystem.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于CLIPS的ROS 2执行器，实现了ROS生态系统中的规则型编程和基于PDDL的机器人规划。

title: Value-Aware Multiagent Systems
summary: This paper introduces the concept of value awareness in AI, which goes beyond the traditional value-alignment problem. Our definition of value awareness presents us with a concise and simplified roadmap for engineering value-aware AI. The roadmap is structured around three core pillars: (1) learning and representing human values using formal semantics, (2) ensuring the value alignment of both individual agents and multiagent systems, and (3) providing value-based explainability on behaviour. The paper presents a selection of our ongoing work on some of these topics, along with applications to real-life domains.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了AI中的价值意识概念，该概念超越了传统的价值对齐问题。我们对价值意识的定义为构建具有价值意识的AI提供了一个简洁而简化的路线图。该路线图围绕三个核心支柱构建：（1）使用形式语义学习和表示人类价值观；（2）确保个体智能体和多智能体系统的价值对齐；（3）提供基于价值的行为可解释性。本文展示了我们在这些领域正在进行的部分工作，以及在现实领域的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a 'value-aware AI' framework for multi-agent systems, focusing on learning/representing human values, value alignment, and value-based explainability, presenting initial work and applications.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于多智能体系统的“价值感知AI”框架，重点关注人类价值观的学习/表示、价值对齐和基于价值的可解释性，并展示了初步工作和应用。

title: StegaVAR: Privacy-Preserving Video Action Recognition via Steganographic Domain Analysis
summary: Despite the rapid progress of deep learning in video action recognition (VAR) in recent years, privacy leakage in videos remains a critical concern. Current state-of-the-art privacy-preserving methods often rely on anonymization. These methods suffer from (1) low concealment, where producing visually distorted videos that attract attackers' attention during transmission, and (2) spatiotemporal disruption, where degrading essential spatiotemporal features for accurate VAR. To address these issues, we propose StegaVAR, a novel framework that embeds action videos into ordinary cover videos and directly performs VAR in the steganographic domain for the first time. Throughout both data transmission and action analysis, the spatiotemporal information of hidden secret video remains complete, while the natural appearance of cover videos ensures the concealment of transmission. Considering the difficulty of steganographic domain analysis, we propose Secret Spatio-Temporal Promotion (STeP) and Cross-Band Difference Attention (CroDA) for analysis within the steganographic domain. STeP uses the secret video to guide spatiotemporal feature extraction in the steganographic domain during training. CroDA suppresses cover interference by capturing cross-band semantic differences. Experiments demonstrate that StegaVAR achieves superior VAR and privacy-preserving performance on widely used datasets. Moreover, our framework is effective for multiple steganographic models.
summary_zh: 近年来，深度学习在视频动作识别（VAR）领域发展迅速，但视频中的隐私泄露仍然是一个关键问题。目前最先进的隐私保护方法通常依赖于匿名化处理。这些方法存在以下问题：（1）隐蔽性不足，生成的视觉扭曲视频在传输过程中容易引起攻击者的注意；（2）时空扰乱，降低了准确进行VAR所必需的关键时空特征。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为StegaVAR的新型框架，该框架将动作视频嵌入到普通的掩护视频中，并且首次直接在隐写域中执行VAR。在数据传输和动作分析的整个过程中，隐藏的秘密视频的时空信息保持完整，而掩护视频的自然外观确保了传输的隐蔽性。考虑到隐写域分析的难度，我们提出了秘密时空增强（STeP）和跨频带差异注意力（CroDA），用于在隐写域内进行分析。STeP在训练期间使用秘密视频来指导隐写域中的时空特征提取。CroDA通过捕捉跨频带语义差异来抑制掩护视频的干扰。实验表明，StegaVAR在广泛使用的数据集上实现了优异的VAR和隐私保护性能。此外，我们的框架对多种隐写模型有效。
tldr: StegaVAR introduces a novel privacy-preserving video action recognition framework that embeds action videos into cover videos and performs recognition directly in the steganographic domain, achieving better concealment and preserving spatiotemporal features.
tldr_zh: StegaVAR 提出了一种新颖的隐私保护视频动作识别框架，该框架将动作视频嵌入到封面视频中，并直接在隐写域中执行识别，从而实现更好的隐藏效果并保留时空特征。

title: ceLLMate: Sandboxing Browser AI Agents
summary: Browser-using agents (BUAs) are an emerging class of autonomous agents that interact with web browsers in human-like ways, including clicking, scrolling, filling forms, and navigating across pages. While these agents help automate repetitive online tasks, they are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can trick an agent into performing undesired actions, such as leaking private information or issuing state-changing requests. We propose ceLLMate, a browser-level sandboxing framework that restricts the agent's ambient authority and reduces the blast radius of prompt injections. We address two fundamental challenges: (1) The semantic gap challenge in policy enforcement arises because the agent operates through low-level UI observations and manipulations; however, writing and enforcing policies directly over UI-level events is brittle and error-prone. To address this challenge, we introduce an agent sitemap that maps low-level browser behaviors to high-level semantic actions. (2) Policy prediction in BUAs is the norm rather than the exception. BUAs have no app developer to pre-declare sandboxing policies, and thus, ceLLMate pairs website-authored mandatory policies with an automated policy-prediction layer that adapts and instantiates these policies from the user's natural-language task. We implement ceLLMate as an agent-agnostic browser extension and demonstrate how it enables sandboxing policies that effectively block various types of prompt injection attacks with negligible overhead.
summary_zh: 浏览器使用代理(BUA)是一种新兴的自主代理，它们以类似人类的方式与Web浏览器交互，包括点击、滚动、填写表单以及跨页面导航。虽然这些代理有助于自动化重复性的在线任务，但它们容易受到提示注入攻击，这种攻击可以诱使代理执行不期望的操作，例如泄露私人信息或发出状态改变请求。我们提出了ceLLMate，一个浏览器级别的沙盒框架，用于限制代理的环境权限并减少提示注入的爆炸半径。我们解决了两个根本性的挑战：（1）策略执行中的语义鸿沟挑战，这是因为代理通过低级别的UI观察和操作来运行；然而，直接在UI级别的事件上编写和强制执行策略是脆弱且容易出错的。为了应对这个挑战，我们引入了一个代理站点地图，该地图将低级别的浏览器行为映射到高级别的语义动作。（2）在BUA中，策略预测是常态而非例外。BUA没有应用开发者来预先声明沙盒策略，因此，ceLLMate将网站编写的强制性策略与自动策略预测层配对，该策略预测层可以从用户的自然语言任务中适应和实例化这些策略。我们将ceLLMate实现为一个与代理无关的浏览器扩展，并展示了它如何启用沙盒策略，从而有效地阻止各种类型的提示注入攻击，且开销可忽略不计。
tldr: The paper introduces ceLLMate, a browser-level sandboxing framework for browser-using agents (BUAs) that mitigates prompt injection attacks by mapping low-level UI interactions to high-level semantic actions and using automated policy prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ceLLMate，一个用于浏览器代理（BUA）的浏览器级沙盒框架，通过将低级UI交互映射到高级语义动作并使用自动化策略预测来减轻提示注入攻击。

title: AI-Driven Real-Time Kick Classification in Olympic Taekwondo Using Sensor Fusion
summary: Olympic Taekwondo has faced challenges in spectator engagement due to static, defensive gameplay and contentious scoring. Current Protector and Scoring Systems (PSS) rely on impact sensors and simplistic logic, encouraging safe strategies that diminish the sport's dynamism. This paper proposes an AI-powered scoring system that integrates existing PSS sensors with additional accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetic/RFID, and impact force sensors in a sensor fusion framework. The system classifies kicks in real-time to identify technique type, contact location, impact force, and even the part of the foot used. A machine learning pipeline employing sensor fusion and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) is detailed, enabling automatic kick technique recognition for scoring. We present a novel kick scoring rubric that awards points based on specific kick techniques (e.g., turning and spinning kicks) to incentivize dynamic attacks. Drawing on a 2024 study achieving 96-98% accuracy, we validate the feasibility of real-time kick classification and further propose enhancements to this methodology, such as ensemble SVM classifiers and expanded datasets, to achieve the high-stakes accuracy required by the sport. We analyze how the proposed system can improve scoring fairness, reduce rule exploitation and illegitimate tactics, encourage more dynamic techniques, and enhance spectator understanding and excitement. The paper includes system design illustrations, a kick scoring table from an AI-augmented rule set, and discusses anticipated impacts on Olympic Taekwondo.
summary_zh: 奥运跆拳道在观众参与度方面面临挑战，原因在于其静态、防御性的打法以及颇具争议的评分方式。目前的护具与计分系统 (PSS) 依赖于冲击传感器和简化的逻辑，鼓励安全的战略，削弱了这项运动的活力。本文提出了一种基于人工智能的计分系统，该系统将现有的 PSS 传感器与额外的加速度计、陀螺仪、磁性/RFID 传感器和冲击力传感器集成在一个传感器融合框架中。该系统能够实时分类踢击动作，以识别技术类型、接触位置、冲击力，甚至踢击使用的足部部位。详细介绍了一种利用传感器融合和支持向量机 (SVM) 的机器学习流程，从而实现自动踢击技术识别以进行评分。我们提出了一种新的踢击评分标准，该标准根据特定的踢击技术（例如，转身和旋转踢）授予积分，以激励动态攻击。借鉴一项2024年的研究，该研究实现了96-98%的准确率，我们验证了实时踢击分类的可行性，并进一步提出了对该方法的改进，例如集成SVM分类器和扩展数据集，以达到这项运动所需的高风险准确性。我们分析了所提出的系统如何提高评分的公平性，减少规则漏洞利用和非正当战术，鼓励更具活力的技术，并增强观众的理解和兴奋感。本文包括系统设计图示、来自人工智能增强规则集的踢击评分表，并讨论了对奥运跆拳道的预期影响。
tldr: This paper proposes an AI-powered scoring system for Olympic Taekwondo using sensor fusion and SVMs to classify kicks in real-time and incentivize dynamic attacks via a novel scoring rubric. The system aims to improve scoring fairness and spectator engagement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于人工智能的跆拳道奥运会实时评分系统，该系统利用传感器融合和支持向量机（SVM）实时对踢腿动作进行分类，并通过新的评分规则来鼓励动态攻击。该系统旨在提高评分的公平性和观众的参与度。

title: Spinal Line Detection for Posture Evaluation through Train-ing-free 3D Human Body Reconstruction with 2D Depth Images
summary: The spinal angle is an important indicator of body balance. It is important to restore the 3D shape of the human body and estimate the spine center line. Existing mul-ti-image-based body restoration methods require expensive equipment and complex pro-cedures, and single image-based body restoration methods have limitations in that it is difficult to accurately estimate the internal structure such as the spine center line due to occlusion and viewpoint limitation. This study proposes a method to compensate for the shortcomings of the multi-image-based method and to solve the limitations of the sin-gle-image method. We propose a 3D body posture analysis system that integrates depth images from four directions to restore a 3D human model and automatically estimate the spine center line. Through hierarchical matching of global and fine registration, restora-tion to noise and occlusion is performed. Also, the Adaptive Vertex Reduction is applied to maintain the resolution and shape reliability of the mesh, and the accuracy and stabil-ity of spinal angle estimation are simultaneously secured by using the Level of Detail en-semble. The proposed method achieves high-precision 3D spine registration estimation without relying on training data or complex neural network models, and the verification confirms the improvement of matching quality.
summary_zh: 脊柱角是身体平衡的重要指标。恢复人体3D形状并估计脊柱中心线至关重要。现有的基于多图像的身体恢复方法需要昂贵的设备和复杂的程序，而基于单图像的身体恢复方法由于遮挡和视角限制，难以准确估计诸如脊柱中心线等内部结构。本研究提出了一种方法，以弥补基于多图像方法的缺点，并解决单图像方法的局限性。我们提出了一种3D人体姿态分析系统，该系统集成了来自四个方向的深度图像，以恢复3D人体模型并自动估计脊柱中心线。通过全局和精细配准的分层匹配，实现了对噪声和遮挡的恢复。此外，应用自适应顶点缩减以保持网格的分辨率和形状可靠性，并且通过使用细节层次集成来同时确保脊柱角估计的准确性和稳定性。所提出的方法无需依赖训练数据或复杂的神经网络模型即可实现高精度的3D脊柱配准估计，验证结果证实了匹配质量的提高。
tldr: This paper proposes a training-free 3D human body reconstruction method using depth images from four directions to estimate the spine center line for posture evaluation, improving upon single/multi-image based limitations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的3D人体重建方法，该方法使用来自四个方向的深度图像来估计脊柱中心线，以进行姿势评估，从而克服了基于单/多图像方法的局限性。

title: Automatic Wire-Harness Color Sequence Detector
summary: Wire harness inspection process remains a labor-intensive process prone to errors in the modern Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) industry. This paper introduces a semiautomated machine vision system capable of verifying correct wire positioning, correctness of the connector polarity and correctness of color sequences for both linear and circular wire harness configurations. Five industrial standard CMOS cameras are integrated into a modularized mechanical framework in the physical structure of the solution and a HSV and RGB color domain value comparison based color sequence classifier is used in the operation. For each harness batch, a user can train the system using at least five reference samples; the trained file is stored and reused for similar harness types. The Solution is deployed at GPV Lanka Pvt. Ltd. (Fig. 2) and the system achieved 100% detection accuracy and reduced inspection time by 44% compared to manual methods. Additional features include user management, adjustable lighting, session data storage, and secure login. Results of this product usage in the real world situation demonstrate that this approach delivers reliable and efficient inspection capabilities.
summary_zh: 在现代电子制造服务(EMS)行业中，线束检验过程仍然是劳动密集型且容易出错的。本文介绍了一种半自动化机器视觉系统，该系统能够验证线性和圆形线束配置的正确线缆定位，连接器极性的正确性以及颜色序列的正确性。解决方案的物理结构中集成了五个工业标准CMOS相机到一个模块化的机械框架中，并且在操作中使用了基于HSV和RGB颜色域值比较的颜色序列分类器。对于每个线束批次，用户可以使用至少五个参考样品对系统进行训练；训练后的文件将被存储并重复用于类似的线束类型。该解决方案已部署在GPV Lanka Pvt. Ltd.（图2）中，与手动方法相比，该系统实现了100%的检测准确率，并将检验时间缩短了44%。其他功能包括用户管理，可调节照明，会话数据存储和安全登录。该产品在现实世界情况下的使用结果表明，这种方法提供了可靠且高效的检验能力。
tldr: The paper presents a semi-automated machine vision system for wire harness inspection, improving accuracy and reducing inspection time compared to manual methods in a real-world industrial setting. It focuses on color sequence detection and verification.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于线束检测的半自动化机器视觉系统， 通过颜色序列检测和验证提升了精度， 并降低了现实工业环境中的检测时间。

title: Multi-Trajectory Physics-Informed Neural Networks for HJB Equations with Hard-Zero Terminal Inventory: Optimal Execution on Synthetic & SPY Data
summary: We study optimal trade execution with a hard-zero terminal inventory constraint, modeled via Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations. Vanilla PINNs often under-enforce this constraint and produce unstable controls. We propose a Multi-Trajectory PINN (MT-PINN) that adds a rollout-based trajectory loss and propagates a terminal penalty on terminal inventory via backpropagation-through-time, directly enforcing zero terminal inventory. A lightweight lambda-curriculum is adopted to stabilize training as the state expands from a risk-neutral reduced HJB to a risk-averse HJB. On the Gatheral-Schied single-asset model, MT-PINN aligns closely with their derived closed-form solutions and concentrates terminal inventory tightly around zero while reducing errors along optimal paths. We apply MT-PINNs on SPY intraday data, matching TWAP when risk-neutral, and achieving lower exposure and competitive costs, especially in falling windows, for higher risk-aversion.
summary_zh: 我们研究了带有硬性零终端库存约束的最优交易执行问题，并使用 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程进行建模。 传统的 PINN 算法通常无法很好地执行此约束，并产生不稳定的控制。 我们提出了一种多轨迹 PINN (MT-PINN) 算法，该算法增加了一个基于 rollout 的轨迹损失，并通过时间反向传播来传递关于终端库存的终端惩罚，从而直接强制执行零终端库存。我们采用了一种轻量级的 lambda 课程学习策略，以稳定训练过程，因为状态从风险中性的简化 HJB 扩展到风险厌恶的 HJB。在 Gatheral-Schied 单资产模型上，MT-PINN 的结果与他们推导的闭式解非常吻合，并将终端库存紧密地集中在零附近，同时减少了沿最优路径的误差。我们将 MT-PINN 应用于 SPY 日内数据，在风险中性时与 TWAP 相匹配，并且对于更高的风险厌恶，实现了更低的风险敞口和具有竞争力的成本，尤其是在下跌窗口中。
tldr: The paper introduces Multi-Trajectory Physics-Informed Neural Networks (MT-PINNs) to solve Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations for optimal trade execution with a hard-zero terminal inventory constraint, demonstrating improved performance on synthetic and SPY data compared to vanilla PINNs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种多轨迹物理信息神经网络（MT-PINN），用于解决具有硬零终端库存约束的最优交易执行的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程，并在合成数据和SPY数据上展示了比传统PINN更好的性能。

title: Designing The Drive: Enhancing User Experience through Adaptive Interfaces in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: With the recent development and integration of autonomous vehicles (AVs) in transportation systems of the modern world, the emphasis on customizing user interfaces to optimize the overall user experience has been growing expediently. Therefore, understanding user needs and preferences is essential to the acceptance and trust of these technologies as they continue to grow in prevalence. This paper addresses the implementation of HCI principles in the personalization of interfaces to improve safety, security, and usability for the users. This paper explores the way that personalized interfaces can be devised to increase user engagement and satisfaction through various HCI strategies such as adaptive design, multi-modal interaction, and user feedback mechanisms. Moreover, this paper puts emphasis on factors of transparency and user control in the design of an interface; hence, allowing users to design or modify their experience could foster an increase in trust in autonomous systems. In so doing, this research touches on the quite influential role HCI will play in this future scenario of autonomous vehicles while designing to ensure relevance to the diverse needs of users while maintaining high standards of safety and security. Discussing various HCI strategies such as adaptive design, multi-modal interaction, and feedback mechanisms to the user, this paper demonstrates how personalized interfaces can enhance significantly both user engagement and satisfaction. Transparency and user control also in designing an interface are further discussed, pointing out the need for a prerequisite condition of enabling the user to take control of their experience as a state of trust in autonomous systems. In summary, this paper points out the role of HCI in the development of autonomous vehicles and addresses numerous needs with respect to those enforced safety and security standards.
summary_zh: 随着近年来自动驾驶车辆（AVs）在现代世界交通运输系统中的发展和融合，定制用户界面以优化整体用户体验的重要性日益凸显。因此，理解用户需求和偏好对于这些技术的接受度和信任度至关重要，因为它们将继续普及。本文探讨了人机交互（HCI）原则在界面个性化中的应用，旨在提高用户的安全性、保障性和可用性。本文探索了如何通过各种HCI策略，如自适应设计、多模态交互和用户反馈机制，设计个性化界面以提高用户参与度和满意度。此外，本文强调了界面设计中的透明度和用户控制因素；因此，允许用户设计或修改他们的体验可以促进对自动驾驶系统的信任。通过此途径，这项研究触及了人机交互在自动驾驶车辆的未来场景中将发挥的重要作用，同时在设计时确保与用户的多样化需求相关，并保持高标准的安全性和保障性。本文讨论了各种HCI策略，如自适应设计、多模态交互和用户反馈机制，展示了个性化界面如何显著提高用户参与度和满意度。本文进一步讨论了界面设计中的透明度和用户控制，指出了赋予用户掌控自身体验能力的作为建立对自动驾驶系统信任的先决条件的重要性。总而言之，本文指出了人机交互在自动驾驶车辆发展中的作用，并解决了在强制执行的安全和保障标准方面的众多需求。
tldr: This paper explores the application of HCI principles, specifically adaptive interfaces, multi-modal interaction, and user feedback, to enhance user experience, trust, and safety in autonomous vehicles by allowing users to personalize and control their interaction with the system.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了人机交互原则，特别是自适应界面、多模式交互和用户反馈在自动驾驶车辆中的应用，通过允许用户个性化和控制与系统的交互，以增强用户体验、信任和安全性。

title: MMDrive: Interactive Scene Understanding Beyond Vision with Multi-representational Fusion
summary: Vision-language models enable the understanding and reasoning of complex traffic scenarios through multi-source information fusion, establishing it as a core technology for autonomous driving. However, existing vision-language models are constrained by the image understanding paradigm in 2D plane, which restricts their capability to perceive 3D spatial information and perform deep semantic fusion, resulting in suboptimal performance in complex autonomous driving environments. This study proposes MMDrive, an multimodal vision-language model framework that extends traditional image understanding to a generalized 3D scene understanding framework. MMDrive incorporates three complementary modalities, including occupancy maps, LiDAR point clouds, and textual scene descriptions. To this end, it introduces two novel components for adaptive cross-modal fusion and key information extraction. Specifically, the Text-oriented Multimodal Modulator dynamically weights the contributions of each modality based on the semantic cues in the question, guiding context-aware feature integration. The Cross-Modal Abstractor employs learnable abstract tokens to generate compact, cross-modal summaries that highlight key regions and essential semantics. Comprehensive evaluations on the DriveLM and NuScenes-QA benchmarks demonstrate that MMDrive achieves significant performance gains over existing vision-language models for autonomous driving, with a BLEU-4 score of 54.56 and METEOR of 41.78 on DriveLM, and an accuracy score of 62.7% on NuScenes-QA. MMDrive effectively breaks the traditional image-only understanding barrier, enabling robust multimodal reasoning in complex driving environments and providing a new foundation for interpretable autonomous driving scene understanding.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型通过多源信息融合，实现了对复杂交通场景的理解和推理，使其成为自动驾驶的核心技术。然而，现有的视觉-语言模型受限于二维平面中的图像理解范式，这限制了它们感知三维空间信息和执行深度语义融合的能力，导致在复杂的自动驾驶环境中表现欠佳。本研究提出了一种多模态视觉-语言模型框架MMDrive，它将传统的图像理解扩展到广义的三维场景理解框架。MMDrive整合了三种互补的模态，包括占用栅格地图、激光雷达点云和文本场景描述。为此，它引入了两个用于自适应跨模态融合和关键信息提取的新组件。具体而言，面向文本的多模态调制器基于问题中的语义线索动态地加权每种模态的贡献，从而引导上下文感知的特征集成。跨模态抽象器采用可学习的抽象令牌来生成紧凑的跨模态摘要，突出显示关键区域和必要的语义。在DriveLM和NuScenes-QA基准上的全面评估表明，MMDrive在自动驾驶的视觉-语言模型上取得了显著的性能提升，在DriveLM上达到了54.56的BLEU-4评分和41.78的METEOR评分，在NuScenes-QA上达到了62.7%的准确率。MMDrive有效地打破了传统的仅图像理解的壁垒，实现了在复杂驾驶环境中强大的多模态推理，并为可解释的自动驾驶场景理解提供了新的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces MMDrive, a multimodal vision-language model for autonomous driving that leverages occupancy maps, LiDAR, and text to enhance 3D scene understanding, achieving significant performance gains on DriveLM and NuScenes-QA benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MMDrive，一种用于自动驾驶的多模态视觉-语言模型，该模型利用占用图、激光雷达和文本来增强3D场景理解，并在DriveLM和NuScenes-QA基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: OXE-AugE: A Large-Scale Robot Augmentation of OXE for Scaling Cross-Embodiment Policy Learning
summary: Large and diverse datasets are needed for training generalist robot policies that have potential to control a variety of robot embodiments -- robot arm and gripper combinations -- across diverse tasks and environments. As re-collecting demonstrations and retraining for each new hardware platform are prohibitively costly, we show that existing robot data can be augmented for transfer and generalization. The Open X-Embodiment (OXE) dataset, which aggregates demonstrations from over 60 robot datasets, has been widely used as the foundation for training generalist policies. However, it is highly imbalanced: the top four robot types account for over 85\% of its real data, which risks overfitting to robot-scene combinations. We present AugE-Toolkit, a scalable robot augmentation pipeline, and OXE-AugE, a high-quality open-source dataset that augments OXE with 9 different robot embodiments. OXE-AugE provides over 4.4 million trajectories, more than triple the size of the original OXE. We conduct a systematic study of how scaling robot augmentation impacts cross-embodiment learning. Results suggest that augmenting datasets with diverse arms and grippers improves policy performance not only on the augmented robots, but also on unseen robots and even the original robots under distribution shifts. In physical experiments, we demonstrate that state-of-the-art generalist policies such as OpenVLA and $π_0$ benefit from fine-tuning on OXE-AugE, improving success rates by 24-45% on previously unseen robot-gripper combinations across four real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://OXE-AugE.github.io/.
summary_zh: 为了训练能够控制各种机器人形态（机器人手臂和夹爪的组合）、执行多样任务以及适应不同环境的通用机器人策略，需要大型且多样化的数据集。由于为每个新的硬件平台重新收集演示数据和重新训练成本过于高昂，我们证明了现有的机器人数据可以被增强以实现迁移和泛化。开放X-形态（OXE）数据集汇集了来自超过60个机器人数据集的演示数据，已被广泛用作训练通用策略的基础。然而，它高度不平衡：前四种机器人类型占据了其真实数据的85%以上，这存在过度拟合机器人-场景组合的风险。我们提出了AugE-Toolkit，一个可扩展的机器人增强流程，以及OXE-AugE，一个高质量的开源数据集，它使用9种不同的机器人形态增强了OXE。OXE-AugE提供了超过440万条轨迹，是原始OXE的三倍多。我们对扩展机器人增强如何影响跨形态学习进行了系统研究。结果表明，使用不同的手臂和夹爪增强数据集不仅提高了增强机器人上的策略性能，而且提高了未见过机器人甚至原始机器人在分布偏移下的策略性能。在物理实验中，我们证明了诸如OpenVLA和$π_0$等最先进的通用策略可以通过在OXE-AugE上进行微调而受益，在四个真实世界操纵任务中，在先前未见过的机器人-夹爪组合上的成功率提高了24-45%。项目网站：https://OXE-AugE.github.io/。
tldr: This paper introduces OXE-AugE, a large-scale augmented dataset for cross-embodiment robot policy learning, showing significant improvements in policy performance on both seen and unseen robots in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 OXE-AugE，一个用于跨具身机器人策略学习的大规模增强数据集，展示了在真实世界任务中，策略在已见和未见机器人上的性能显著提升。

title: Spatial-Aware VLA Pretraining through Visual-Physical Alignment from Human Videos
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for robot learning by integrating visual perception with language-guided policy learning. However, most existing approaches rely on 2D visual inputs to perform actions in 3D physical environments, creating a significant gap between perception and action grounding. To bridge this gap, we propose a Spatial-Aware VLA Pretraining paradigm that performs explicit alignment between visual space and physical space during pretraining, enabling models to acquire 3D spatial understanding before robot policy learning. Starting from pretrained vision-language models, we leverage large-scale human demonstration videos to extract 3D visual and 3D action annotations, forming a new source of supervision that aligns 2D visual observations with 3D spatial reasoning. We instantiate this paradigm with VIPA-VLA, a dual-encoder architecture that incorporates a 3D visual encoder to augment semantic visual representations with 3D-aware features. When adapted to downstream robot tasks, VIPA-VLA achieves significantly improved grounding between 2D vision and 3D action, resulting in more robust and generalizable robotic policies.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型通过整合视觉感知与语言引导的策略学习，为机器人学习提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于2D视觉输入在3D物理环境中执行动作，这在感知和动作定位之间造成了显著的差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种空间感知VLA预训练范式，该范式在预训练期间执行视觉空间和物理空间之间的显式对齐，使模型能够在机器人策略学习之前获得3D空间理解。从预训练的视觉-语言模型出发，我们利用大规模人类示范视频提取3D视觉和3D动作标注，形成一种新的监督来源，将2D视觉观察与3D空间推理对齐。我们用VIPA-VLA实例化了这个范式，VIPA-VLA是一种双编码器架构，它包含一个3D视觉编码器，用3D感知特征增强语义视觉表示。当应用于下游机器人任务时，VIPA-VLA实现了2D视觉和3D动作之间显著改进的定位，从而产生了更稳健和更具泛化性的机器人策略。
tldr: This paper introduces VIPA-VLA, a Spatial-Aware VLA pretraining paradigm that uses human demonstration videos with 3D annotations to explicitly align visual and physical spaces, improving robot policy learning in downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种空间感知VLA预训练范式 VIPA-VLA，它利用带有 3D 注释的人类演示视频，显式对齐视觉和物理空间，从而改进了下游任务中的机器人策略学习。

title: Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model
summary: While a general embodied agent must function as a unified system, current methods are built on isolated models for understanding, world modeling, and control. This fragmentation prevents unifying multimodal generative capabilities and hinders learning from large-scale, heterogeneous data. In this paper, we propose Motus, a unified latent action world model that leverages existing general pretrained models and rich, sharable motion information. Motus introduces a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture to integrate three experts (i.e., understanding, video generation, and action) and adopts a UniDiffuser-style scheduler to enable flexible switching between different modeling modes (i.e., world models, vision-language-action models, inverse dynamics models, video generation models, and video-action joint prediction models). Motus further leverages the optical flow to learn latent actions and adopts a recipe with three-phase training pipeline and six-layer data pyramid, thereby extracting pixel-level "delta action" and enabling large-scale action pretraining. Experiments show that Motus achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art methods in both simulation (a +15% improvement over X-VLA and a +45% improvement over Pi0.5) and real-world scenarios(improved by +11~48%), demonstrating unified modeling of all functionalities and priors significantly benefits downstream robotic tasks.
summary_zh:
摘要：
虽然通用具身智能体必须作为一个统一系统运行，但目前的方法是基于孤立的理解、世界建模和控制模型构建的。这种碎片化阻碍了多模态生成能力的统一，并妨碍了从大规模异构数据中学习。本文提出了一种统一的潜在动作世界模型 Motus，它利用现有的通用预训练模型和丰富的、可共享的运动信息。Motus 引入了一种混合Transformer (MoT) 架构来整合三个专家（即，理解、视频生成和动作），并采用 UniDiffuser 风格的调度器，以实现不同建模模式之间的灵活切换（即，世界模型、视觉-语言-动作模型、逆动力学模型、视频生成模型和视频-动作联合预测模型）。Motus 进一步利用光流来学习潜在动作，并采用包含三阶段训练流程和六层数据金字塔的方案，从而提取像素级“delta action”并实现大规模的动作预训练。实验表明，在模拟（相比 X-VLA 性能提升 +15%，相比 Pi0.5 性能提升 +45%）和真实世界场景（性能提升 +11%~48%）中，Motus 都实现了优于最先进方法的性能，证明了所有功能和先验的统一建模能够显著提升下游机器人任务的性能。
tldr: Motus introduces a unified latent action world model using a Mixture-of-Transformer architecture and UniDiffuser-style scheduler to integrate understanding, video generation, and action, achieving SOTA performance in simulation and real-world robotic tasks by leveraging optical flow and a multi-phase training pipeline.
tldr_zh: Motus 提出了一个统一的潜在动作世界模型，利用混合Transformer架构和UniDiffuser风格的调度器来整合理解、视频生成和动作，通过利用光流和多阶段训练流水线，在模拟和真实世界机器人任务中实现了SOTA性能。

title: Lemon: A Unified and Scalable 3D Multimodal Model for Universal Spatial Understanding
summary: Scaling large multimodal models (LMMs) to 3D understanding poses unique challenges: point cloud data is sparse and irregular, existing models rely on fragmented architectures with modality-specific encoders, and training pipelines often suffer from instability and poor scalability. We introduce Lemon, a unified transformer architecture that addresses these challenges by jointly processing 3D point cloud patches and language tokens as a single sequence. Unlike prior work that relies on modality-specific encoders and cross-modal alignment modules, this design enables early spatial-linguistic fusion, eliminates redundant encoders, improves parameter efficiency, and supports more effective model scaling. To handle the complexity of 3D data, we develop a structured patchification and tokenization scheme that preserves spatial context, and a three-stage training curriculum that progressively builds capabilities from object-level recognition to scene-level spatial reasoning. Lemon establishes new state-of-the-art performance across comprehensive 3D understanding and reasoning tasks, from object recognition and captioning to spatial reasoning in 3D scenes, while demonstrating robust scaling properties as model size and training data increase. Our work provides a unified foundation for advancing 3D spatial intelligence in real-world applications.
summary_zh: 将大型多模态模型(LMMs)扩展到三维理解带来了独特的挑战：点云数据稀疏且不规则，现有模型依赖于具有模态特定编码器的碎片化架构，并且训练流程通常存在不稳定性和较差的可扩展性。我们引入了Lemon，一个统一的Transformer架构，它通过将3D点云块和语言令牌作为单个序列进行联合处理来解决这些挑战。与以往依赖于模态特定编码器和跨模态对齐模块的工作不同，这种设计实现了早期的空间-语言融合，消除了冗余编码器，提高了参数效率，并支持更有效的模型扩展。为了处理3D数据的复杂性，我们开发了一种结构化的分块和令牌化方案，以保留空间上下文，以及一个三阶段训练课程，逐步构建从对象级识别到场景级空间推理的能力。Lemon在全面的3D理解和推理任务中建立了新的最先进性能，从对象识别和图像描述到3D场景中的空间推理，同时证明了随着模型大小和训练数据的增加，具有强大的扩展特性。我们的工作为推进现实世界应用中的3D空间智能提供了一个统一的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces Lemon, a unified transformer architecture for 3D multimodal understanding that jointly processes point clouds and language, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various 3D tasks and demonstrating strong scaling properties.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Lemon，一个用于3D多模态理解的统一Transformer架构，它联合处理点云和语言，在各种3D任务上实现了最先进的性能，并展示了强大的扩展性。

title: DrivePI: Spatial-aware 4D MLLM for Unified Autonomous Driving Understanding, Perception, Prediction and Planning
summary: Although multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse domains, their application in generating fine-grained 3D perception and prediction outputs in autonomous driving remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose DrivePI, a novel spatial-aware 4D MLLM that serves as a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that is also compatible with vision-action (VA) models. Our method jointly performs spatial understanding, 3D perception (i.e., 3D occupancy), prediction (i.e., occupancy flow), and planning (i.e., action outputs) in parallel through end-to-end optimization. To obtain both precise geometric information and rich visual appearance, our approach integrates point clouds, multi-view images, and language instructions within a unified MLLM architecture. We further develop a data engine to generate text-occupancy and text-flow QA pairs for 4D spatial understanding. Remarkably, with only a 0.5B Qwen2.5 model as MLLM backbone, DrivePI as a single unified model matches or exceeds both existing VLA models and specialized VA models. Specifically, compared to VLA models, DrivePI outperforms OpenDriveVLA-7B by 2.5% mean accuracy on nuScenes-QA and reduces collision rate by 70% over ORION (from 0.37% to 0.11%) on nuScenes. Against specialized VA models, DrivePI surpasses FB-OCC by 10.3 RayIoU for 3D occupancy on OpenOcc, reduces the mAVE from 0.591 to 0.509 for occupancy flow on OpenOcc, and achieves 32% lower L2 error than VAD (from 0.72m to 0.49m) for planning on nuScenes. Code will be available at https://github.com/happinesslz/DrivePI
summary_zh: 尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）已经在多个领域展现出强大的能力，但其在自动驾驶中生成细粒度三维感知和预测输出方面的应用仍未被充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了DrivePI，一种新型空间感知四维MLLM，可用作统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，同时也兼容视觉-动作（VA）模型。我们的方法通过端到端优化并行地执行空间理解、三维感知（即三维占据栅格）、预测（即占据流）和规划（即动作输出）。为了获得精确的几何信息和丰富的视觉外观，我们的方法在一个统一的MLLM架构中集成了点云、多视角图像和语言指令。我们进一步开发了一个数据引擎，用于生成文本-占据栅格和文本-流QA对，以进行四维空间理解。值得注意的是，仅使用0.5B Qwen2.5模型作为MLLM主干，DrivePI作为一个单一的统一模型就能够媲美甚至超越现有的VLA模型和专门的VA模型。具体来说，与VLA模型相比，DrivePI在nuScenes-QA上超越了OpenDriveVLA-7B 2.5%的平均准确率，并在nuScenes上将碰撞率比ORION降低了70%（从0.37%降至0.11%）。与专门的VA模型相比，DrivePI在OpenOcc上，对三维占据栅格的RayIoU超越了FB-OCC 10.3，在OpenOcc上，对占据流的mAVE从0.591降至0.509，并在nuScenes上，对规划的L2误差比VAD降低了32%（从0.72米降至0.49米）。代码将在https://github.com/happinesslz/DrivePI上提供。
tldr: DrivePI is a novel spatial-aware 4D MLLM for autonomous driving, unifying understanding, perception, prediction, and planning in a single end-to-end framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance with a relatively small model.
tldr_zh: DrivePI是一种新颖的、具有空间感知的4D MLLM，用于自动驾驶，它在一个端到端的框架中统一了理解、感知、预测和规划，并以相对较小的模型实现了最先进的性能。

title: Universal Dexterous Functional Grasping via Demonstration-Editing Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved great success in dexterous grasping, significantly improving grasp performance and generalization from simulation to the real world. However, fine-grained functional grasping, which is essential for downstream manipulation tasks, remains underexplored and faces several challenges: the complexity of specifying goals and reward functions for functional grasps across diverse objects, the difficulty of multi-task RL exploration, and the challenge of sim-to-real transfer. In this work, we propose DemoFunGrasp for universal dexterous functional grasping. We factorize functional grasping conditions into two complementary components - grasping style and affordance - and integrate them into an RL framework that can learn to grasp any object with any functional grasping condition. To address the multi-task optimization challenge, we leverage a single grasping demonstration and reformulate the RL problem as one-step demonstration editing, substantially enhancing sample efficiency and performance. Experimental results in both simulation and the real world show that DemoFunGrasp generalizes to unseen combinations of objects, affordances, and grasping styles, outperforming baselines in both success rate and functional grasping accuracy. In addition to strong sim-to-real capability, by incorporating a vision-language model (VLM) for planning, our system achieves autonomous instruction-following grasp execution.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)在灵巧抓取方面取得了巨大成功，显著提高了抓取性能和从仿真到现实世界的泛化能力。然而，对于下游操作任务至关重要的精细化功能抓取，仍未得到充分探索，并且面临着几个挑战：跨不同对象指定功能抓取的目标和奖励函数的复杂性、多任务强化学习探索的难度，以及仿真到现实迁移的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了 DemoFunGrasp 用于通用灵巧功能抓取。我们将功能抓取条件分解为两个互补的组成部分——抓取风格和可供性——并将它们整合到一个强化学习框架中，该框架可以学习使用任何功能抓取条件来抓取任何对象。为了解决多任务优化挑战，我们利用一次抓取演示，并将强化学习问题重新定义为一步演示编辑，从而大大提高了样本效率和性能。仿真和现实世界中的实验结果表明，DemoFunGrasp 可以泛化到未见过的对象、可供性和抓取风格的组合，在成功率和功能抓取精度方面都优于基线方法。除了强大的仿真到现实能力外，通过结合视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 进行规划，我们的系统还可以实现自主指令跟随抓取执行。
tldr: The paper introduces DemoFunGrasp, a reinforcement learning framework for universal dexterous functional grasping that leverages demonstration editing to achieve strong sim-to-real transfer and autonomous instruction-following via a vision-language model.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DemoFunGrasp，一个用于通用灵巧功能抓取的强化学习框架，它利用演示编辑来实现强大的从仿真到现实的迁移，并通过视觉-语言模型实现自主指令跟随。

title: Fast Policy Learning for 6-DOF Position Control of Underwater Vehicles
summary: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) require reliable six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) position control to operate effectively in complex and dynamic marine environments. Traditional controllers are effective under nominal conditions but exhibit degraded performance when faced with unmodeled dynamics or environmental disturbances. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a powerful alternative but training is typically slow and sim-to-real transfer remains challenging. This work introduces a GPU-accelerated RL training pipeline built in JAX and MuJoCo-XLA (MJX). By jointly JIT-compiling large-scale parallel physics simulation and learning updates, we achieve training times of under two minutes.Through systematic evaluation of multiple RL algorithms, we show robust 6-DOF trajectory tracking and effective disturbance rejection in real underwater experiments, with policies transferred zero-shot from simulation. Our results provide the first explicit real-world demonstration of RL-based AUV position control across all six degrees of freedom.
summary_zh: 自主水下航行器（AUVs）需要在复杂和动态的海洋环境中有效运行，因此需要可靠的六自由度（6-DOF）位置控制。传统控制器在标称条件下有效，但在面对未建模的动力学或环境干扰时性能下降。强化学习（RL）提供了一种强大的替代方案，但训练通常很慢，且从模拟到现实的迁移仍然具有挑战性。本研究介绍了一种基于JAX和MuJoCo-XLA (MJX)构建的GPU加速RL训练流水线。通过联合JIT编译大规模并行物理仿真和学习更新，我们实现了低于两分钟的训练时间。通过对多种RL算法的系统评估，我们展示了在真实水下实验中强大的6-DOF轨迹跟踪和有效的干扰抑制能力，这些策略是从模拟中零样本迁移的。我们的结果首次明确地展示了基于RL的AUV位置控制在所有六个自由度上的真实世界应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a fast, GPU-accelerated RL training pipeline for 6-DOF AUV position control, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and demonstrating real-world results of RL-based AUV control across all six degrees of freedom.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于六自由度自主水下航行器位置控制的快速GPU加速的RL训练流水线，实现了零样本模拟到现实的转移，并展示了基于RL的AUV控制在所有六个自由度上的实际结果。

title: Intrinsic-Motivation Multi-Robot Social Formation Navigation with Coordinated Exploration
summary: This paper investigates the application of reinforcement learning (RL) to multi-robot social formation navigation, a critical capability for enabling seamless human-robot coexistence. While RL offers a promising paradigm, the inherent unpredictability and often uncooperative dynamics of pedestrian behavior pose substantial challenges, particularly concerning the efficiency of coordinated exploration among robots. To address this, we propose a novel coordinated-exploration multi-robot RL algorithm introducing an intrinsic motivation exploration. Its core component is a self-learning intrinsic reward mechanism designed to collectively alleviate policy conservatism. Moreover, this algorithm incorporates a dual-sampling mode within the centralized training and decentralized execution framework to enhance the representation of both the navigation policy and the intrinsic reward, leveraging a two-time-scale update rule to decouple parameter updates. Empirical results on social formation navigation benchmarks demonstrate the proposed algorithm's superior performance over existing state-of-the-art methods across crucial metrics. Our code and video demos are available at: https://github.com/czxhunzi/CEMRRL.
summary_zh: 本文研究了强化学习（RL）在多机器人社交编队导航中的应用，这是实现无缝人机共存的关键能力。尽管强化学习提供了一种有前景的范例， but 行人 inherently 不可预测 行人不 cooperative 动态 构成了实质性的挑战，尤其是在机器人之间协调探索的效率方面。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的协同探索多机器人强化学习算法，引入了内在激励探索。其核心组成部分是一种自学习内在奖励机制，旨在集体缓解策略保守性。此外，该算法在中心化训练和去中心化执行框架内融入了双重采样模式，以增强导航策略和内在奖励的表征，并利用双时间尺度更新规则来解耦参数更新。在社交编队导航基准测试中进行的实证结果表明，所提出的算法在关键指标上的性能优于现有的最先进方法。我们的代码和视频演示可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/czxhunzi/CEMRRL。
tldr: The paper introduces a new multi-robot reinforcement learning algorithm with intrinsic motivation for coordinated exploration in social formation navigation, showing superior performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的多机器人强化学习算法，该算法具有内在动机，用于社交队形导航中的协同探索，并在基准数据集上表现出卓越性能。

title: START: Traversing Sparse Footholds with Terrain Reconstruction
summary: Traversing terrains with sparse footholds like legged animals presents a promising yet challenging task for quadruped robots, as it requires precise environmental perception and agile control to secure safe foot placement while maintaining dynamic stability. Model-based hierarchical controllers excel in laboratory settings, but suffer from limited generalization and overly conservative behaviors. End-to-end learning-based approaches unlock greater flexibility and adaptability, but existing state-of-the-art methods either rely on heightmaps that introduce noise and complex, costly pipelines, or implicitly infer terrain features from egocentric depth images, often missing accurate critical geometric cues and leading to inefficient learning and rigid gaits. To overcome these limitations, we propose START, a single-stage learning framework that enables agile, stable locomotion on highly sparse and randomized footholds. START leverages only low-cost onboard vision and proprioception to accurately reconstruct local terrain heightmap, providing an explicit intermediate representation to convey essential features relevant to sparse foothold regions. This supports comprehensive environmental understanding and precise terrain assessment, reducing exploration cost and accelerating skill acquisition. Experimental results demonstrate that START achieves zero-shot transfer across diverse real-world scenarios, showcasing superior adaptability, precise foothold placement, and robust locomotion.
summary_zh: 利用腿式动物的方式穿越具有稀疏支撑点的地形，对于四足机器人来说既是一种有前景又具有挑战的任务，因为它需要精确的环境感知和敏捷的控制，以确保安全的足端落点，同时保持动态稳定性。基于模型的层次化控制器在实验室环境中表现出色，但存在泛化能力有限和行为过于保守的问题。端到端学习方法具有更大的灵活性和适应性，但目前最先进的方法要么依赖于引入噪声以及复杂且昂贵的管道的高度图，要么从自我中心深度图像中隐式地推断地形特征，通常会遗漏准确的关键几何线索，导致低效的学习和僵硬的步态。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种名为 START 的单阶段学习框架，该框架能够在高度稀疏且随机的支撑点上实现敏捷稳定的运动。START 仅利用低成本的板载视觉和本体感觉来精确重建局部地形高度图，提供显式的中间表示来传递与稀疏支撑点区域相关的重要特征。这有助于全面地理解环境和精确地评估地形，从而降低探索成本并加速技能获取。实验结果表明，START 能够在各种真实场景中实现零样本迁移，展示了卓越的适应性、精确的足端落点和鲁棒的运动能力。
tldr: START is a single-stage learning framework that uses onboard vision and proprioception to reconstruct terrain heightmaps, enabling agile and stable locomotion for quadruped robots on sparse footholds with zero-shot transfer to real-world scenarios.
