自主驾驶需要在动态环境中实现可靠的避撞。非线性模型预测控制器（NMPCs）适用于此任务，但在需要高频率的时间关键场景中表现不佳。为了满足这种需求，通常通过线性化、缩短预测窗口或减少时间节点来简化优化问题，但这都牺牲了精度或可靠性。 本文提出了一种通用的凸避障公式，这是通过一种集成逻辑的新颖方法实现的。这有助于将避障公式纳入凸MPC方案中，从而实现与传统非凸方法相比计算效率显著提高的凸优化框架。该公式的一个关键特性是，即使障碍物位于预测范围之外，避障仍然有效，从而允许更短的预测范围用于实时部署。在非凸公式不可避免的情况下，所提出的方法达到或超过了有代表性的非凸方案的性能。该方法在自动驾驶车辆应用中进行了评估，这些应用中系统动力学具有高度非线性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel convex obstacle avoidance formulation for autonomous driving, enabling efficient and reliable collision avoidance, even with short prediction horizons, outperforming nonconvex methods in some cases.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的新型凸障碍物规避公式，即使在预测范围较短的情况下，也能实现高效可靠的碰撞规避，并且在某些情况下性能优于非凸方法。

title: PortAgent: LLM-driven Vehicle Dispatching Agent for Port Terminals
summary: Vehicle Dispatching Systems (VDSs) are critical to the operational efficiency of Automated Container Terminals (ACTs). However, their widespread commercialization is hindered due to their low transferability across diverse terminals. This transferability challenge stems from three limitations: high reliance on port operational specialists, a high demand for terminal-specific data, and time-consuming manual deployment processes. Leveraging the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), this paper proposes PortAgent, an LLM-driven vehicle dispatching agent that fully automates the VDS transferring workflow. It bears three features: (1) no need for port operations specialists; (2) low need of data; and (3) fast deployment. Specifically, specialist dependency is eliminated by the Virtual Expert Team (VET). The VET collaborates with four virtual experts, including a Knowledge Retriever, Modeler, Coder, and Debugger, to emulate a human expert team for the VDS transferring workflow. These experts specialize in the domain of terminal VDS via a few-shot example learning approach. Through this approach, the experts are able to learn VDS-domain knowledge from a few VDS examples. These examples are retrieved via a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mechanism, mitigating the high demand for terminal-specific data. Furthermore, an automatic VDS design workflow is established among these experts to avoid extra manual interventions. In this workflow, a self-correction loop inspired by the LLM Reflexion framework is created
summary_zh: 车辆调度系统（VDS）对自动化集装箱码头（ACT）的运营效率至关重要。然而，由于其在不同码头间的可移植性较低，阻碍了其广泛商业化。这种可移植性挑战源于三个限制：高度依赖港口运营专家、对码头特定数据的高需求以及耗时的手动部署流程。 鉴于大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起，本文提出了一种由LLM驱动的车辆调度代理 PortAgent，可完全自动化VDS的转移工作流程。它具有三个特点：（1）无需港口运营专家；（2）对数据的需求低；（3）快速部署。 具体而言，专家依赖性通过虚拟专家团队（VET）消除。VET与四位虚拟专家合作，包括知识检索器、建模器、编码器和调试器，以模拟人工专家团队进行VDS转移工作流程。这些专家通过少样本示例学习方法专注于码头VDS领域。通过这种方法，专家能够从少量VDS示例中学习VDS领域知识。这些示例通过检索增强生成（RAG）机制检索，从而减轻了对码头特定数据的高需求。此外，这些专家之间建立了一个自动VDS设计工作流程，以避免额外的手动干预。 在此工作流程中，创建了一个受LLM Reflexion框架启发的自我纠正循环。
tldr: The paper introduces PortAgent, an LLM-driven vehicle dispatching agent for port terminals that aims to automate the VDS transferring workflow, reducing the need for specialist knowledge, data, and manual deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 PortAgent，一个由大型语言模型驱动的港口终端车辆调度代理，旨在自动化 VDS 转移工作流程，减少对专家知识、数据和手动部署的需求。

title: A data-physics hybrid generative model for patient-specific post-stroke motor rehabilitation using wearable sensor data
summary: Dynamic prediction of locomotor capacity after stroke is crucial for tailoring rehabilitation, yet current assessments provide only static impairment scores and do not indicate whether patients can safely perform specific tasks such as slope walking or stair climbing. Here, we develop a data-physics hybrid generative framework that reconstructs an individual stroke survivor's neuromuscular control from a single 20 m level-ground walking trial and predicts task-conditioned locomotion across rehabilitation scenarios. The system combines wearable-sensor kinematics, a proportional-derivative physics controller, a population Healthy Motion Atlas, and goal-conditioned deep reinforcement learning with behaviour cloning and generative adversarial imitation learning to generate physically plausible, patient-specific gait simulations for slopes and stairs. In 11 stroke survivors, the personalized controllers preserved idiosyncratic gait patterns while improving joint-angle and endpoint fidelity by 4.73% and 12.10%, respectively, and reducing training time to 25.56% relative to a physics-only baseline. In a multicentre pilot involving 21 inpatients, clinicians who used our locomotion predictions to guide task selection and difficulty obtained larger gains in Fugl-Meyer lower-extremity scores over 28 days of standard rehabilitation than control clinicians (mean change 6.0 versus 3.7 points). These findings indicate that our generative, task-predictive framework can augment clinical decision-making in post-stroke gait rehabilitation and provide a template for dynamically personalized motor recovery strategies.
summary_zh: 卒中后运动能力的动态预测对于定制康复至关重要，然而，目前的评估仅提供静态的损伤评分，并不能指示患者是否能够安全地执行特定任务，如坡道行走或爬楼梯。在此，我们开发了一种数据-物理混合生成框架，该框架从单次20米平地行走试验中重构个体卒中幸存者的神经肌肉控制，并预测横跨多种康复场景的任务条件下的运动。该系统结合了可穿戴传感器运动学、比例-微分物理控制器、人群健康运动图谱，以及基于目标条件的深度强化学习（采用行为克隆和生成对抗模仿学习），从而生成在坡道和楼梯上具有物理可行性、患者特异性的步态模拟。在11名卒中幸存者中，个性化控制器在保留特异性步态模式的同时，将关节角度和末端执行器的保真度分别提高了4.73%和12.10%，并将训练时间缩短至仅为基于物理模型的基线的25.56%。在一个涉及21名住院患者的多中心试点研究中，使用我们的运动预测来指导任务选择和难度的临床医生，在28天的标准康复期间，与对照组临床医生相比，在Fugl-Meyer下肢评分方面获得了更大的增益（平均变化6.0分对比3.7分）。这些研究结果表明，我们的生成式、任务预测框架能够增强卒中后步态康复中的临床决策，并为动态个性化的运动恢复策略提供模板。
tldr: This paper presents a data-physics hybrid generative model using wearable sensor data to predict patient-specific post-stroke motor rehabilitation outcomes, demonstrating improved clinical outcomes in a pilot study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据-物理混合生成模型，利用可穿戴传感器数据来预测患者特定的中风后运动康复结果，并在初步研究中证明了临床效果的改善。

title: Understanding and Improving Hyperbolic Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: The performance of reinforcement learning (RL) agents depends critically on the quality of the underlying feature representations. Hyperbolic feature spaces are well-suited for this purpose, as they naturally capture hierarchical and relational structure often present in complex RL environments. However, leveraging these spaces commonly faces optimization challenges due to the nonstationarity of RL. In this work, we identify key factors that determine the success and failure of training hyperbolic deep RL agents. By analyzing the gradients of core operations in the Poincaré Ball and Hyperboloid models of hyperbolic geometry, we show that large-norm embeddings destabilize gradient-based training, leading to trust-region violations in proximal policy optimization (PPO). Based on these insights, we introduce Hyper++, a new hyperbolic PPO agent that consists of three components: (i) stable critic training through a categorical value loss instead of regression; (ii) feature regularization guaranteeing bounded norms while avoiding the curse of dimensionality from clipping; and (iii) using a more optimization-friendly formulation of hyperbolic network layers. In experiments on ProcGen, we show that Hyper++ guarantees stable learning, outperforms prior hyperbolic agents, and reduces wall-clock time by approximately 30%. On Atari-5 with Double DQN, Hyper++ strongly outperforms Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines. We release our code at https://github.com/Probabilistic-and-Interactive-ML/hyper-rl .
summary_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 智能体的性能高度依赖于底层特征表示的质量。双曲特征空间非常适合此目的，因为它们自然地捕捉了复杂 RL 环境中常见的层级和关系结构。然而，利用这些空间通常面临由于 RL 的非平稳性而导致的优化挑战。在这项工作中，我们确定了决定训练双曲深度 RL 智能体成功与失败的关键因素。通过分析庞加莱球模型和双曲面模型中核心操作的梯度，我们表明大范数嵌入会破坏基于梯度的训练，导致近端策略优化 (PPO) 中的信任区域违规。基于这些见解，我们引入了 Hyper++，一种新的双曲 PPO 智能体，它由三个部分组成：（i）通过分类值损失而非回归实现稳定的评论家训练；（ii）特征正则化，保证有界范数，同时避免因裁剪而造成的维度灾难；以及（iii）使用更易于优化的双曲网络层公式。在 ProcGen 上的实验中，我们表明 Hyper++ 保证了稳定的学习，优于先前的双曲智能体，并将实际运行时间减少了约 30%。在 Atari-5 上使用 Double DQN，Hyper++ 明显优于欧几里得和双曲基线。我们在 https://github.com/Probabilistic-and-Interactive-ML/hyper-rl 上发布了我们的代码。
tldr: This paper addresses optimization challenges in hyperbolic deep reinforcement learning (RL) by identifying factors that destabilize training and introducing Hyper++, a new hyperbolic PPO agent with stable critic training, feature regularization, and optimization-friendly hyperbolic network layers, demonstrating improved performance on ProcGen and Atari.
tldr_zh: 本文解决了双曲深度强化学习（RL）中的优化挑战，通过识别破坏训练稳定性的因素，并引入了Hyper++，一种新的双曲PPO代理，具有稳定的评论家训练、特征正则化和优化友好的双曲网络层，在ProcGen和Atari上展示了改进的性能。

title: SportsGPT: An LLM-driven Framework for Interpretable Sports Motion Assessment and Training Guidance
summary: Existing intelligent sports analysis systems mainly focus on "scoring and visualization," often lacking automatic performance diagnosis and interpretable training guidance. Recent advances of Large Language Models (LMMs) and motion analysis techniques provide new opportunities to address the above limitations. In this paper, we propose SportsGPT, an LLM-driven framework for interpretable sports motion assessment and training guidance, which establishes a closed loop from motion time-series input to professional training guidance. First, given a set of high-quality target models, we introduce MotionDTW, a two-stage time series alignment algorithm designed for accurate keyframe extraction from skeleton-based motion sequences. Subsequently, we design a Knowledge-based Interpretable Sports Motion Assessment Model (KISMAM) to obtain a set of interpretable assessment metrics (e.g., insufficient extension) by constrasting the keyframes with the targe models. Finally, we propose SportsRAG, a RAG-based training guidance model based on Qwen3. Leveraging a 6B-token knowledge base, it prompts the LLM to generate professional training guidance by retrieving domain-specific QA pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that MotionDTW significantly outperforms traditional methods with lower temporal error and higher IoU scores. Furthermore, ablation studies validate the KISMAM and SportsRAG, confirming that SportsGPT surpasses general LLMs in diagnostic accuracy and professionalism.
summary_zh: 现有智能运动分析系统主要侧重于“评分与可视化”，通常缺乏自动的性能诊断和可解释的训练指导。大型语言模型（LLM）和运动分析技术的最新进展为解决上述局限性提供了新的机遇。本文提出SportsGPT，一个LLM驱动的框架，用于可解释的运动评估和训练指导，它建立了一个从运动时间序列输入到专业训练指导的闭环。首先，给定一组高质量的目标模型，我们引入MotionDTW，一种为精确地从基于骨骼的运动序列中提取关键帧而设计的两阶段时间序列对齐算法。其次，我们设计了一个基于知识的可解释运动评估模型（KISMAM），通过将关键帧与目标模型进行对比，获得一组可解释的评估指标（例如，伸展不足）。最后，我们提出SportsRAG，一个基于Qwen3的RAG训练指导模型。利用一个60亿token的知识库，它通过检索特定领域的问答对来提示 LLM 生成专业的训练指导。实验结果表明，MotionDTW 以较低的时间误差和较高的IoU分数显著优于传统方法。此外，消融研究验证了 KISMAM 和 SportsRAG，证实 SportsGPT 在诊断准确性和专业性方面超越了通用 LLM。
tldr: SportsGPT is an LLM-driven framework that provides interpretable sports motion assessment and training guidance using motion time-series data, keyframe extraction, a knowledge-based assessment model, and RAG-based training advice generation.
tldr_zh: SportsGPT是一个LLM驱动的框架，它使用运动时间序列数据、关键帧提取、基于知识的评估模型和基于RAG的训练建议生成，提供可解释的运动评估和训练指导。

title: Evaluating Small Language Models for Agentic On-Farm Decision Support Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLM) hold potential to support dairy scholars and farmers by supporting decision-making and broadening access to knowledge for stakeholders with limited technical expertise. However, the substantial computational demand restricts access to LLM almost exclusively through cloud-based service, which makes LLM-based decision support tools impractical for dairy farming. To address this gap, lightweight alternatives capable of running locally on farm hardware are required. In this work, we benchmarked 20 open-source Small Language Models (SLM) available on HuggingFace under farm-realistic computing constraints. Building on our prior work, we developed an agentic AI system that integrates five task-specific agents: literature search, web search, SQL database interaction, NoSQL database interaction, and graph generation following predictive models. Evaluation was conducted in two phases. In the first phase, five test questions were used for the initial screening to identify models capable of following basic dairy-related instructions and performing reliably in a compute-constrained environment. Models that passed this preliminary stage were then evaluated using 30 questions (five per task category mentioned above, plus one category addressing integrity and misconduct) in phase two. In results, Qwen-4B achieved superior performance across most of task categories, although showed unstable effectiveness in NoSQL database interactions through PySpark. To our knowledge, this is the first work explicitly evaluating the feasibility of SLM as engines for dairy farming decision-making, with central emphases on privacy and computational efficiency. While results highlight the promise of SLM-assisted tools for practical deployment in dairy farming, challenges remain, and fine-tuning is still needed to refine SLM performance in dairy-specific questions.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）有潜力通过支持决策制定并拓宽技术专业知识有限的利益相关者获取知识的渠道，从而为奶业学者和农场主提供支持。然而，巨大的计算需求几乎完全限制了通过基于云的服务访问LLM，这使得基于LLM的决策支持工具对奶牛养殖来说不切实际。为了解决这一差距，需要能够在农场硬件上本地运行的轻量级替代方案。在这项工作中，我们对HuggingFace上提供的20种开源小型语言模型（SLM）在农场实际计算约束下进行了基准测试。在之前的研究基础上，我们开发了一个智能体AI系统，该系统集成了五个特定任务的智能体：文献搜索、网络搜索、SQL数据库交互、NoSQL数据库交互和遵循预测模型的图生成。评估分两个阶段进行。在第一阶段，使用五个测试问题进行初步筛选，以识别能够在计算受限环境中遵循基本的奶业相关指令并可靠执行的模型。通过该初步阶段的模型在第二阶段使用30个问题（每个上述任务类别五个，外加一个涉及诚信和不当行为的类别）进行评估。结果显示，Qwen-4B在大多数任务类别中都表现出卓越的性能，尽管通过PySpark进行NoSQL数据库交互时表现出不稳定的有效性。据我们所知，这是第一项明确评估SLM作为乳制品生产决策引擎可行性的工作，重点强调隐私和计算效率。虽然结果突出了SLM辅助工具在乳制品生产中实际部署的前景，但仍然存在挑战，并且仍需要进行微调以改进SLM在乳制品特定问题中的性能。
tldr: This paper benchmarks Small Language Models (SLMs) for on-farm decision support in dairy farming, specifically focusing on computational efficiency and privacy, and finds Qwen-4B performs well but requires further fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了小型语言模型（SLM）在奶牛场决策支持中的应用，特别关注计算效率和隐私，发现Qwen-4B表现良好，但需要进一步微调。

title: ACE-SLAM: Scene Coordinate Regression for Neural Implicit Real-Time SLAM
summary:
We present a novel neural RGB-D Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) system that learns an implicit map of the scene in real time. For the first time, we explore the use of Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) as the core implicit map representation in a neural SLAM pipeline, a paradigm that trains a lightweight network to directly map 2D image features to 3D global coordinates. SCR networks provide efficient, low-memory 3D map representations, enable extremely fast relocalization, and inherently preserve privacy, making them particularly suitable for neural implicit SLAM.
  Our system is the first one to achieve strict real-time in neural implicit RGB-D SLAM by relying on a SCR-based representation. We introduce a novel SCR architecture specifically tailored for this purpose and detail the critical design choices required to integrate SCR into a live SLAM pipeline. The resulting framework is simple yet flexible, seamlessly supporting both sparse and dense features, and operates reliably in dynamic environments without special adaptation. We evaluate our approach on established synthetic and real-world benchmarks, demonstrating competitive performance against the state of the art. Project Page: https://github.com/ialzugaray/ace-slam
summary_zh:
我们提出了一种新型的神经RGB-D同步定位与地图构建(SLAM)系统，该系统可以实时学习场景的隐式地图。我们首次探索将场景坐标回归(SCR)作为神经SLAM流程中核心的隐式地图表示方法。这种范式训练一个轻量级网络，直接将2D图像特征映射到3D全局坐标。SCR网络提供高效、低内存的3D地图表示，能够实现极快的重定位，并且天然地保护隐私，使其特别适合神经隐式SLAM。

  我们的系统是首个通过依赖基于SCR的表示，在神经隐式RGB-D SLAM中实现严格实时的系统。我们引入了一种专门为此目的量身定制的新型SCR架构，并详细描述了将SCR集成到实时SLAM流程中所需的关键设计选择。由此产生的框架简单而灵活，能够无缝支持稀疏和密集特征，并且在动态环境中可靠运行，无需特殊适配。我们在已建立的合成和真实世界基准测试中评估了我们的方法，证明了与最先进水平相比具有竞争力的性能。项目页面：https://github.com/ialzugaray/ace-slam
tldr: This paper introduces ACE-SLAM, a novel neural RGB-D SLAM system using Scene Coordinate Regression for real-time implicit map learning and achieving real-time performance. It claims to preserve privacy and work well in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ACE-SLAM的新型神经RGB-D SLAM系统，该系统使用场景坐标回归进行实时隐式地图学习，从而实现实时性能。它声称可以保护隐私并在动态环境中运行良好。

title: Vector Prism: Animating Vector Graphics by Stratifying Semantic Structure
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are central to modern web design, and the demand to animate them continues to grow as web environments become increasingly dynamic. Yet automating the animation of vector graphics remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) despite recent progress in code generation and motion planning. VLMs routinely mis-handle SVGs, since visually coherent parts are often fragmented into low-level shapes that offer little guidance of which elements should move together. In this paper, we introduce a framework that recovers the semantic structure required for reliable SVG animation and reveals the missing layer that current VLM systems overlook. This is achieved through a statistical aggregation of multiple weak part predictions, allowing the system to stably infer semantics from noisy predictions. By reorganizing SVGs into semantic groups, our approach enables VLMs to produce animations with far greater coherence. Our experiments demonstrate substantial gains over existing approaches, suggesting that semantic recovery is the key step that unlocks robust SVG animation and supports more interpretable interactions between VLMs and vector graphics.
summary_zh: 可缩放矢量图形 (SVG) 在现代网页设计中占据核心地位，随着网络环境日益动态化，对其进行动画处理的需求持续增长。然而，尽管代码生成和运动规划方面取得了进展，对于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 来说，自动化矢量图形的动画处理仍然具有挑战性。由于视觉上连贯的部分经常被分解成低层次的形状，这些形状几乎不能指导哪些元素应该一起移动，因此 VLM 常常无法正确处理 SVG。在本文中，我们介绍了一种框架，该框架能够恢复可靠的 SVG 动画所需的语义结构，并揭示了当前 VLM 系统所忽略的缺失层。这通过对多个弱部件预测进行统计聚合来实现，从而使系统能够从嘈杂的预测中稳定地推断语义。通过将 SVG 重组为语义组，我们的方法使 VLM 能够生成具有更高连贯性的动画。我们的实验表明，相对于现有方法，我们取得了显著的提升，这表明语义恢复是解锁稳健 SVG 动画的关键步骤，并支持 VLM 与矢量图形之间更具可解释性的交互。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework called Vector Prism that recovers semantic structure in SVGs to enable more coherent animation of vector graphics by vision-language models, achieving substantial gains over existing approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为Vector Prism的框架，通过恢复SVG中的语义结构，使视觉语言模型能够更连贯地动画化矢量图形，并在现有方法上取得了显著的提升。

title: Zoom-Zero: Reinforced Coarse-to-Fine Video Understanding via Temporal Zoom-in
summary: Grounded video question answering (GVQA) aims to localize relevant temporal segments in videos and generate accurate answers to a given question; however, large video-language models (LVLMs) exhibit limited temporal awareness. Although existing approaches based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) attempt to improve temporal grounding, they still struggle to faithfully ground their answers in the relevant video evidence, leading to temporal mislocalization and hallucinations. In this work, we present Zoom-Zero, a coarse-to-fine framework that first localizes query-relevant segments and then temporally zooms into the most salient frames for finer-grained visual verification. Our method addresses the limits of GRPO for the GVQA task with two key innovations: (i) a zoom-in accuracy reward that validates the fidelity of temporal grounding prediction and facilitates fine-grained visual verification on grounded frames; (ii) token-selective credit assignment, which attributes rewards to the tokens responsible for temporal localization or answer generation, mitigating GRPO's issue in handling multi-faceted reward signals. Our proposed method advances grounded video question answering, improving temporal grounding by 5.2\% on NExT-GQA and 4.6\% on ReXTime, while also enhancing average answer accuracy by 2.4\%. Additionally, the coarse-to-fine zoom-in during inference further benefits long-form video understanding by preserving critical visual details without compromising global context, yielding an average improvement of 6.4\% on long-video benchmarks.
summary_zh: 基于上下文的视频问答(GVQA)旨在定位视频中相关的时序片段，并为给定的问题生成准确的答案；然而，大型视频-语言模型(LVLMs)表现出有限的时序感知能力。尽管现有的基于群体相对策略优化(GRPO)的方法试图改善时序定位，但它们仍然难以将其答案忠实地定位在相关的视频证据中，导致时序错位和幻觉。在这项工作中，我们提出了Zoom-Zero，一个粗到精的框架，它首先定位查询相关的片段，然后进行时序放大，聚焦于最显著的帧以进行更精细的视觉验证。我们的方法通过两项关键创新解决了GRPO在GVQA任务中的局限性：（i）一个放大精度奖励，用于验证时序定位预测的保真度，并促进对已定位帧的精细视觉验证；（ii）令牌选择性信用分配，将奖励归因于负责时序定位或答案生成的令牌，缓解GRPO在处理多方面奖励信号方面的问题。我们提出的方法推动了基于上下文的视频问答，在NExT-GQA上提高了5.2%的时序定位精度，在ReXTime上提高了4.6%，同时也将平均答案准确率提高了2.4%。此外，推理期间的粗到精的放大进一步有益于长视频理解，它保留了关键的视觉细节而不损害全局上下文，在长视频基准测试中平均提高了6.4%。
tldr: The paper introduces Zoom-Zero, a coarse-to-fine framework leveraging reinforcement learning to improve temporal grounding accuracy in video question answering by focusing on salient frames, leading to improved performance on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Zoom-Zero，一种粗到精的框架，利用强化学习来提高视频问答中时间对齐的准确性，通过关注显著帧，从而在多个基准测试上实现了性能的提升。

title: AnchorHOI: Zero-shot Generation of 4D Human-Object Interaction via Anchor-based Prior Distillation
summary: Despite significant progress in text-driven 4D human-object interaction (HOI) generation with supervised methods, the scalability remains limited by the scarcity of large-scale 4D HOI datasets. To overcome this, recent approaches attempt zero-shot 4D HOI generation with pre-trained image diffusion models. However, interaction cues are minimally distilled during the generation process, restricting their applicability across diverse scenarios. In this paper, we propose AnchorHOI, a novel framework that thoroughly exploits hybrid priors by incorporating video diffusion models beyond image diffusion models, advancing 4D HOI generation. Nevertheless, directly optimizing high-dimensional 4D HOI with such priors remains challenging, particularly for human pose and compositional motion. To address this challenge, AnchorHOI introduces an anchor-based prior distillation strategy, which constructs interaction-aware anchors and then leverages them to guide generation in a tractable two-step process. Specifically, two tailored anchors are designed for 4D HOI generation: anchor Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) for expressive interaction composition, and anchor keypoints for realistic motion synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnchorHOI outperforms previous methods with superior diversity and generalization.
summary_zh: 尽管在有监督方法驱动的文本驱动4D人-物交互（HOI）生成方面取得了显著进展，但大规模4D HOI数据集的稀缺性仍然限制了其可扩展性。为了克服这个问题，最近的方法尝试使用预训练的图像扩散模型进行零样本4D HOI生成。然而，交互线索在生成过程中被最小化地提取，限制了其在各种场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出AnchorHOI，一种新颖的框架，通过结合图像扩散模型之外的视频扩散模型，彻底利用混合先验，从而推进4D HOI生成。然而，使用这些先验直接优化高维4D HOI仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于人类姿势和组合运动。为了解决这个挑战，AnchorHOI引入了一种基于锚点的先验提炼策略，它构建了交互感知的锚点，然后利用这些锚点在可处理的两步过程中引导生成。具体而言，针对4D HOI生成设计了两个定制的锚点：用于表达交互组合的锚点神经辐射场（NeRFs）和用于逼真运动合成的锚点关键点。大量实验表明，AnchorHOI优于以往的方法，具有卓越的多样性和泛化性。
tldr: The paper presents AnchorHOI, a novel zero-shot framework for generating 4D human-object interactions using anchor-based prior distillation from video diffusion models to address the scarcity of large-scale 4D HOI datasets and improve interaction cues.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的AnchorHOI框架，该框架利用基于锚点的先验知识蒸馏，从视频扩散模型中生成4D人-物交互，旨在解决大规模4D HOI数据集的稀缺问题，并改善交互提示。

title: Deep Learning Perspective of Scene Understanding in Autonomous Robots
summary: This paper provides a review of deep learning applications in scene understanding in autonomous robots, including innovations in object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, depth estimation, 3D reconstruction, and visual SLAM. It emphasizes how these techniques address limitations of traditional geometric models, improve depth perception in real time despite occlusions and textureless surfaces, and enhance semantic reasoning to understand the environment better. When these perception modules are integrated into dynamic and unstructured environments, they become more effective in decisionmaking, navigation and interaction. Lastly, the review outlines the existing problems and research directions to advance learning-based scene understanding of autonomous robots.
summary_zh: 本文综述了深度学习在自主机器人场景理解中的应用，包括在目标检测、语义分割和实例分割、深度估计、三维重建以及视觉SLAM等领域的创新。文章着重强调这些技术如何克服传统几何模型的局限性，如何在遮挡和无纹理表面条件下实时提升深度感知能力，以及如何增强语义推理以更好地理解环境。当这些感知模块集成到动态和非结构化环境中时，它们在决策制定、导航和交互方面变得更加有效。最后，本文概述了当前存在的问题和研究方向，以推进自主机器人基于学习的场景理解能力。
tldr: This paper reviews deep learning techniques for scene understanding in autonomous robots, covering object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, SLAM, and their impact on decision-making and navigation, while also outlining future research directions.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了深度学习技术在自主机器人场景理解中的应用，涵盖目标检测、分割、深度估计、SLAM及其对决策和导航的影响，并概述了未来的研究方向。

title: Quality-Driven and Diversity-Aware Sample Expansion for Robust Marine Obstacle Segmentation
summary: Marine obstacle detection demands robust segmentation under challenging conditions, such as sun glitter, fog, and rapidly changing wave patterns. These factors degrade image quality, while the scarcity and structural repetition of marine datasets limit the diversity of available training data. Although mask-conditioned diffusion models can synthesize layout-aligned samples, they often produce low-diversity outputs when conditioned on low-entropy masks and prompts, limiting their utility for improving robustness. In this paper, we propose a quality-driven and diversity-aware sample expansion pipeline that generates training data entirely at inference time, without retraining the diffusion model. The framework combines two key components:(i) a class-aware style bank that constructs high-entropy, semantically grounded prompts, and (ii) an adaptive annealing sampler that perturbs early conditioning, while a COD-guided proportional controller regulates this perturbation to boost diversity without compromising layout fidelity. Across marine obstacle benchmarks, augmenting training data with these controlled synthetic samples consistently improves segmentation performance across multiple backbones and increases visual variation in rare and texture-sensitive classes.
summary_zh: 海洋障碍物检测需要在诸如阳光闪烁、雾以及快速变化的海浪模式等具有挑战性的条件下进行稳健的分割。这些因素会降低图像质量，而海洋数据集的稀缺性和结构重复性限制了可用训练数据的多样性。尽管mask条件下的扩散模型可以合成布局对齐的样本，但当以低熵mask和提示词为条件时，它们通常会产生低多样性的输出，从而限制了其在提高鲁棒性方面的效用。在本文中，我们提出了一种质量驱动且具有多样性意识的样本扩展流程，该流程完全在推理时生成训练数据，而无需重新训练扩散模型。该框架结合了两个关键组件：（i）一个类别感知的风格库，用于构建高熵、语义接地的提示词；（ii）一个自适应退火采样器，它扰动早期条件，同时一个COD（一致性目标检测）引导的比例控制器调节这种扰动，以提高多样性而不损害布局保真度。在多个海洋障碍物基准测试中，使用这些受控的合成样本来增强训练数据，始终如一地提高了多个骨干网络的分割性能，并增加了稀有和纹理敏感类别中的视觉变化。
tldr: This paper introduces a quality-driven and diversity-aware sample expansion pipeline to generate synthetic training data for robust marine obstacle segmentation using mask-conditioned diffusion models, showing improved segmentation performance across various conditions and rare classes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种质量驱动和多样性感知样本扩展流程，利用掩码条件扩散模型生成合成训练数据，用于稳健的海洋障碍物分割，从而在各种条件和稀有类别中提高了分割性能。

title: MoLingo: Motion-Language Alignment for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: We introduce MoLingo, a text-to-motion (T2M) model that generates realistic, lifelike human motion by denoising in a continuous latent space. Recent works perform latent space diffusion, either on the whole latent at once or auto-regressively over multiple latents. In this paper, we study how to make diffusion on continuous motion latents work best. We focus on two questions: (1) how to build a semantically aligned latent space so diffusion becomes more effective, and (2) how to best inject text conditioning so the motion follows the description closely. We propose a semantic-aligned motion encoder trained with frame-level text labels so that latents with similar text meaning stay close, which makes the latent space more diffusion-friendly. We also compare single-token conditioning with a multi-token cross-attention scheme and find that cross-attention gives better motion realism and text-motion alignment. With semantically aligned latents, auto-regressive generation, and cross-attention text conditioning, our model sets a new state of the art in human motion generation on standard metrics and in a user study. We will release our code and models for further research and downstream usage.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了MoLingo，一个文本到动作(T2M)模型，它通过在连续潜在空间中去噪生成逼真、栩栩如生的人体动作。最近的研究在潜在空间中执行扩散，要么一次性处理整个潜在空间，要么通过多个潜在空间进行自回归。在本文中，我们研究如何使连续动作潜在空间的扩散效果最佳。我们专注于两个问题：（1）如何构建语义对齐的潜在空间，使扩散更有效；（2）如何最佳地注入文本条件，使动作紧密跟随描述。我们提出了一个使用帧级别文本标签训练的语义对齐动作编码器，使具有相似文本含义的潜在变量保持接近，从而使潜在空间更加有利于扩散。我们还将单token条件化与多token交叉注意力方案进行比较，发现交叉注意力能够提供更好的动作逼真度和文本-动作对齐。凭借语义对齐的潜在空间、自回归生成和交叉注意力文本条件化，我们的模型在标准指标和用户研究中，在人体动作生成方面设定了新的技术水平。我们将发布我们的代码和模型，以供进一步研究和下游使用。
tldr: MoLingo introduces a text-to-motion model using denoising in a semantically aligned latent space with cross-attention text conditioning, achieving state-of-the-art results in human motion generation.
tldr_zh: MoLingo 提出了一种文本到动作（T2M）模型，该模型通过在语义对齐的潜在空间中使用交叉注意力文本条件作用进行去噪，从而实现了人体动作生成方面的最先进结果。

title: A Scientific Reasoning Model for Organic Synthesis Procedure Generation
summary: Solving computer-aided synthesis planning is essential for enabling fully automated, robot-assisted synthesis workflows and improving the efficiency of drug discovery. A key challenge, however, is bridging the gap between computational route design and practical laboratory execution, particularly the accurate prediction of viable experimental procedures for each synthesis step. In this work, we present QFANG, a scientific reasoning language model capable of generating precise, structured experimental procedures directly from reaction equations, with explicit chain-of-thought reasoning. To develop QFANG, we curated a high-quality dataset comprising 905,990 chemical reactions paired with structured action sequences, extracted and processed from patent literature using large language models. We introduce a Chemistry-Guided Reasoning (CGR) framework that produces chain-of-thought data grounded in chemical knowledge at scale. The model subsequently undergoes supervised fine-tuning to elicit complex chemistry reasoning. Finally, we apply Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to further enhance procedural accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that QFANG outperforms advanced general-purpose reasoning models and nearest-neighbor retrieval baselines, measured by traditional NLP similarity metrics and a chemically aware evaluator using an LLM-as-a-judge. Moreover, QFANG generalizes to certain out-of-domain reaction classes and adapts to variations in laboratory conditions and user-specific constraints. We believe that QFANG's ability to generate high-quality synthesis procedures represents an important step toward bridging the gap between computational synthesis planning and fully automated laboratory synthesis.
summary_zh: 计算机辅助合成规划的求解对于实现全自动化、机器人辅助的合成工作流程以及提高药物发现的效率至关重要。然而，一个关键挑战在于弥合计算路线设计与实际实验室执行之间的差距，特别是准确预测每个合成步骤的可行实验程序。在这项工作中，我们提出了QFANG，一种科学推理语言模型，能够直接从反应方程式生成精确、结构化的实验程序，并具有显式的链式思考推理能力。为了开发QFANG，我们整理了一个高质量的数据集，其中包含905,990个化学反应，并配有结构化的动作序列，这些数据是从专利文献中提取并使用大型语言模型进行处理的。我们引入了一种化学指导推理（CGR）框架，该框架能够大规模生成基于化学知识的链式思考数据。随后，该模型经过监督微调，以引发复杂的化学推理。最后，我们应用来自可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来进一步提高程序准确性。实验结果表明，通过传统的NLP相似性指标以及使用LLM-as-a-judge的化学感知评估器进行衡量，QFANG优于先进的通用推理模型和最近邻检索基线。此外，QFANG可以推广到某些领域外的反应类型，并适应实验室条件和用户特定约束的变化。我们相信，QFANG生成高质量合成程序的能力代表着弥合计算合成规划与全自动实验室合成之间差距的重要一步。
tldr: The paper introduces QFANG, a scientific reasoning language model that generates detailed, structured experimental procedures for organic synthesis directly from reaction equations using a Chemistry-Guided Reasoning framework and Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards. It bridges the gap between computational route design and practical laboratory execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 QFANG 的科学推理语言模型，该模型使用化学引导推理框架和可验证奖励的强化学习，直接从反应方程式生成详细的、结构化的有机合成实验步骤。它弥合了计算路线设计和实际实验室执行之间的差距。

title: A Comprehensive Safety Metric to Evaluate Perception in Autonomous Systems
summary: Complete perception of the environment and its correct interpretation is crucial for autonomous vehicles. Object perception is the main component of automotive surround sensing. Various metrics already exist for the evaluation of object perception. However, objects can be of different importance depending on their velocity, orientation, distance, size, or the potential damage that could be caused by a collision due to a missed detection. Thus, these additional parameters have to be considered for safety evaluation. We propose a new safety metric that incorporates all these parameters and returns a single easily interpretable safety assessment score for object perception. This new metric is evaluated with both real world and virtual data sets and compared to state of the art metrics.
summary_zh: 对环境的完整感知及其正确解读对于自动驾驶车辆至关重要。目标感知是汽车环绕感知技术的主要组成部分。现已存在多种用于评估目标感知的指标。然而，目标的重要性可能因其速度、方向、距离、大小或因未检测到目标而可能造成的碰撞损害而异。因此，在安全评估中必须考虑这些附加参数。我们提出了一种新的安全指标，该指标包含所有这些参数，并返回一个用于目标感知的单一且易于理解的安全评估分数。该新指标通过真实世界和虚拟数据集进行评估，并与最先进的指标进行比较。
tldr: This paper introduces a comprehensive safety metric for evaluating object perception in autonomous vehicles, considering factors like object velocity and potential damage to provide a single safety score. The metric is validated using real-world and virtual datasets and compared against existing state-of-the-art metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种综合安全指标，用于评估自动驾驶汽车中的物体感知，考虑了物体速度和潜在损害等因素，以提供单一的安全评分。该指标已使用真实世界和虚拟数据集进行了验证，并与现有的最先进指标进行了比较。

title: Field evaluation and optimization of a lightweight lidar-based UAV navigation system for dense boreal forest environments
summary: The interest in the usage of uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) for forest applications has increased in recent years. While above-canopy flight has reached a high level of autonomy, navigating under-canopy remains a significant challenge. The use of autonomous UAVs could reduce the burden of data collection, which has motivated the development of numerous solutions for under-canopy autonomous flight. However, the experiments conducted in the literature and their reporting lack rigor. Very rarely, the density and the difficulty of the test forests are reported, or multiple flights are flown, and the success rate of those flights is reported. The aim of this study was to implement an autonomously flying quadrotor based on a lightweight lidar using openly available algorithms and test its behavior in real forest environments. A set of rigorous experiments was conducted with a quadrotor prototype utilizing the IPC path planner and LTA-OM SLAM algorithm. Based on the results of the first 33 flights, the original system was further enhanced. With the optimized system, 60 flights were performed, resulting in a total of 93 test flights. The optimized system performed significantly better in terms of reliability and flight mission completion times, achieving success rates of 12/15 in a medium-density forest and 15/15 in a dense forest, at a target flight velocity of 1 m/s. At a target flight velocity of 2 m/s, it had a success rate of 12/15 and 5/15, respectively. Furthermore, a standardized testing setup and evaluation criteria were proposed, enabling consistent performance comparisons of autonomous under-canopy UAV systems, enhancing reproducibility, guiding system improvements, and accelerating progress in forest robotics.
summary_zh: 近年来，使用无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）进行森林应用的兴趣日益增长。虽然高于树冠的飞行已经达到了很高的自主水平，但低于树冠的导航仍然是一个重大挑战。自主UAV的使用可以减轻数据收集的负担，这推动了许多低于树冠自主飞行解决方案的开发。然而，文献中进行的实验及其报告缺乏严谨性。极少有文献报告测试森林的密度和难度，或者进行多次飞行并报告这些飞行的成功率。本研究旨在实现一种基于轻量级激光雷达且使用公开算法的自主飞行四旋翼飞行器，并在真实的森林环境中测试其性能。使用四旋翼原型，结合IPC路径规划器和LTA-OM SLAM算法，进行了一系列严谨的实验。基于前33次飞行的结果，对原始系统进行了进一步的增强。通过优化的系统，进行了60次飞行，总计93次测试飞行。在可靠性和飞行任务完成时间方面，优化后的系统表现明显更好，在中等密度森林中的成功率为12/15，在高密度森林中的成功率为15/15，目标飞行速度为1米/秒。在2米/秒的目标飞行速度下，成功率分别为12/15和5/15。此外，还提出了标准化的测试设置和评估标准，从而能够对自主低于树冠UAV系统进行一致的性能比较，提高可重复性，指导系统改进，并加速森林机器人技术的发展。
tldr: This paper presents a field evaluation and optimization of a lidar-based UAV navigation system for autonomous flight in dense boreal forests, highlighting improved success rates and proposing a standardized testing setup. It addresses autonomous navigation challenges under forest canopies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于激光雷达的无人机导航系统在茂密北方森林中的实地评估和优化，重点介绍了提高的成功率，并提出了一个标准化的测试装置。  它解决了森林冠层下的自主导航挑战。

title: SUPER -- A Framework for Sensitivity-based Uncertainty-aware Performance and Risk Assessment in Visual Inertial Odometry
summary: While many visual odometry (VO), visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and SLAM systems achieve high accuracy, the majority of existing methods miss to assess risks at runtime. This paper presents SUPER (Sensitivity-based Uncertainty-aware PErformance and Risk assessment) that is a generic and explainable framework that propagates uncertainties via sensitivities for real-time risk assessment in VIO. The scientific novelty lies in the derivation of a real-time risk indicator that is backend-agnostic and exploits the Schur complement blocks of the Gauss-Newton normal matrix to propagate uncertainties. Practically, the Schur complement captures the sensitivity that reflects the influence of the uncertainty on the risk occurrence. Our framework estimates risks on the basis of the residual magnitudes, geometric conditioning, and short horizon temporal trends without requiring ground truth knowledge. Our framework enables to reliably predict trajectory degradation 50 frames ahead with an improvement of 20% to the baseline. In addition, SUPER initiates a stop or relocalization policy with 89.1% recall. The framework is backend agnostic and operates in real time with less than 0.2% additional CPU cost. Experiments show that SUPER provides consistent uncertainty estimates. A SLAM evaluation highlights the applicability to long horizon mapping.
summary_zh: 虽然许多视觉里程计(VO)、视觉惯性里程计(VIO)和SLAM系统都能够实现高精度，但大多数现有方法都无法在运行时评估风险。本文提出了SUPER（基于敏感度的不确定性感知性能和风险评估），它是一个通用的、可解释的框架，通过敏感度传播不确定性，用于VIO中的实时风险评估。本研究的科学创新在于推导出一种与后端无关的实时风险指标，并利用高斯-牛顿正规矩阵的舒尔补块来传播不确定性。实际上，舒尔补块捕获了敏感度，反映了不确定性对风险发生的影响。我们的框架在无需真值知识的情况下，基于残差大小、几何条件和短时程时间趋势来估计风险。我们的框架能够可靠地预测50帧前的轨迹退化，相比基线方法提升了20%。此外，SUPER以89.1%的召回率启动停止或重定位策略。该框架与后端无关，并且以低于0.2%的额外CPU成本实时运行。实验表明SUPER提供了稳定一致的不确定性估计。SLAM评估突出了其在长时程建图中的适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces SUPER, a novel framework for real-time risk assessment in VIO (Visual-Inertial Odometry) that propagates uncertainties via sensitivities using the Schur complement, enabling improved trajectory degradation prediction and relocalization policies with minimal computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为SUPER的新框架，用于VIO中的实时风险评估。该框架通过灵敏度传播不确定性，利用舒尔补来提高轨迹退化预测和重定位策略的性能，且计算开销极小。

title: Causal Structure Learning for Dynamical Systems with Theoretical Score Analysis
summary: Real world systems evolve in continuous-time according to their underlying causal relationships, yet their dynamics are often unknown. Existing approaches to learning such dynamics typically either discretize time -- leading to poor performance on irregularly sampled data -- or ignore the underlying causality. We propose CaDyT, a novel method for causal discovery on dynamical systems addressing both these challenges. In contrast to state-of-the-art causal discovery methods that model the problem using discrete-time Dynamic Bayesian networks, our formulation is grounded in Difference-based causal models, which allow milder assumptions for modeling the continuous nature of the system. CaDyT leverages exact Gaussian Process inference for modeling the continuous-time dynamics which is more aligned with the underlying dynamical process. We propose a practical instantiation that identifies the causal structure via a greedy search guided by the Algorithmic Markov Condition and Minimum Description Length principle. Our experiments show that CaDyT outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both regularly and irregularly-sampled data, discovering causal networks closer to the true underlying dynamics.
summary_zh: 现实世界系统根据其底层因果关系在连续时间内演化，但其动态特性通常未知。现有的学习此类动态特性的方法通常要么离散化时间——导致在不规则采样数据上表现不佳——要么忽略底层因果关系。我们提出CaDyT，一种用于动态系统因果发现的新方法，旨在解决这两个挑战。与使用离散时间动态贝叶斯网络对问题进行建模的最新因果发现方法不同，我们的公式基于差分因果模型，该模型允许更温和的假设来建模系统的连续性质。CaDyT利用精确的高斯过程推断来建模连续时间动态特性，这更符合底层的动态过程。我们提出了一种实用的实例化方法，通过算法马尔可夫条件和最小描述长度原则指导的贪婪搜索来识别因果结构。我们的实验表明，CaDyT在规则和不规则采样数据上都优于最新的方法，能够发现更接近真实底层动态特性的因果网络。
tldr: The paper introduces CaDyT, a novel method for causal discovery in continuous-time dynamical systems using Difference-based causal models and Gaussian Process inference, outperforming existing methods, especially on irregularly sampled data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为CaDyT的新方法，用于连续时间动态系统中的因果发现，它使用基于差异的因果模型和高斯过程推理，优于现有方法，特别是在不规则采样数据上。

title: A Threshold-Triggered Deep Q-Network-Based Framework for Self-Healing in Autonomic Software-Defined IIoT-Edge Networks
summary:
Stochastic disruptions such as flash events arising from benign traffic bursts and switch thermal fluctuations are major contributors to intermittent service degradation in software-defined industrial networks. These events violate IEC~61850-derived quality-of-service requirements and user-defined service-level agreements, hindering the reliable and timely delivery of control, monitoring, and best-effort traffic in IEC~61400-25-compliant wind power plants. Failure to maintain these requirements often results in delayed or lost control signals, reduced operational efficiency, and increased risk of wind turbine generator downtime.
  To address these challenges, this study proposes a threshold-triggered Deep Q-Network self-healing agent that autonomically detects, analyzes, and mitigates network disruptions while adapting routing behavior and resource allocation in real time. The proposed agent was trained, validated, and tested on an emulated tri-clustered switch network deployed in a cloud-based proof-of-concept testbed.
  Simulation results show that the proposed agent improves disruption recovery performance by 53.84% compared to a baseline shortest-path and load-balanced routing approach and outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including the Adaptive Network-based Fuzzy Inference System by 13.1% and the Deep Q-Network and traffic prediction-based routing optimization method by 21.5%, in a super-spine leaf data-plane architecture.
  Additionally, the agent maintains switch thermal stability by proactively initiating external rack cooling when required. These findings highlight the potential of deep reinforcement learning in building resilience in software-defined industrial networks deployed in mission-critical, time-sensitive application scenarios.
summary_zh:
随机性中断，例如良性流量突发引起的瞬时事件和交换机热波动，是软件定义工业网络中导致间歇性服务降级的主要因素。这些事件违反了源自IEC~61850的服务质量要求和用户定义的服务级别协议，阻碍了符合IEC~61400-25标准的风力发电厂中控制、监控和尽力而为流量的可靠和及时传送。未能维持这些要求通常会导致控制信号延迟或丢失、运营效率降低以及风力涡轮发电机停机风险增加。

为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种阈值触发的深度Q网络自愈代理，该代理能够自主地检测、分析和缓解网络中断，同时实时调整路由行为和资源分配。该代理在一个基于云的概念验证测试平台上部署的仿真三集群交换机网络中进行了训练、验证和测试。

仿真结果表明，与基准最短路径和负载均衡路由方法相比，该代理将中断恢复性能提高了 53.84%，并且在超级脊叶数据平面架构中，其性能优于最先进的方法，包括自适应网络模糊推理系统，提升了 13.1%，以及基于深度Q网络和流量预测的路由优化方法，提升了 21.5%。

此外，该代理还通过在需要时主动启动外部机架冷却来维持交换机的热稳定性。这些发现突出了深度强化学习在构建部署于任务关键型、时间敏感型应用场景中的软件定义工业网络弹性方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a threshold-triggered Deep Q-Network self-healing agent for autonomic detection, analysis, and mitigation of network disruptions in software-defined industrial networks, demonstrating improved disruption recovery and thermal stability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于阈值触发的深度Q网络自愈代理，用于自动检测、分析和缓解软件定义工业网络中的网络中断，实验证明该方法提高了中断恢复能力和热稳定性。

title: ProtoFlow: Interpretable and Robust Surgical Workflow Modeling with Learned Dynamic Scene Graph Prototypes
summary:
Purpose: Detailed surgical recognition is critical for advancing AI-assisted surgery, yet progress is hampered by high annotation costs, data scarcity, and a lack of interpretable models. While scene graphs offer a structured abstraction of surgical events, their full potential remains untapped. In this work, we introduce ProtoFlow, a novel framework that learns dynamic scene graph prototypes to model complex surgical workflows in an interpretable and robust manner.
  Methods: ProtoFlow leverages a graph neural network (GNN) encoder-decoder architecture that combines self-supervised pretraining for rich representation learning with a prototype-based fine-tuning stage. This process discovers and refines core prototypes that encapsulate recurring, clinically meaningful patterns of surgical interaction, forming an explainable foundation for workflow analysis.
  Results: We evaluate our approach on the fine-grained CAT-SG dataset. ProtoFlow not only outperforms standard GNN baselines in overall accuracy but also demonstrates exceptional robustness in limited-data, few-shot scenarios, maintaining strong performance when trained on as few as one surgical video. Our qualitative analyses further show that the learned prototypes successfully identify distinct surgical sub-techniques and provide clear, interpretable insights into workflow deviations and rare complications.
  Conclusion: By uniting robust representation learning with inherent explainability, ProtoFlow represents a significant step toward developing more transparent, reliable, and data-efficient AI systems, accelerating their potential for clinical adoption in surgical training, real-time decision support, and workflow optimization.
summary_zh:
目的：精细的手术识别对于推进人工智能辅助手术至关重要，但高昂的标注成本、数据稀缺以及缺乏可解释的模型阻碍了该领域的进展。虽然场景图提供了对手术事件的结构化抽象，但其全部潜力尚未被挖掘。在这项工作中，我们引入了ProtoFlow，一种新颖的框架，它学习动态场景图原型，以可解释且稳健的方式建模复杂的手术工作流程。
方法：ProtoFlow利用图神经网络（GNN）编码器-解码器架构，该架构结合了用于丰富表示学习的自监督预训练和基于原型的微调阶段。此过程发现并优化了核心原型，这些原型封装了反复出现的、具有临床意义的手术交互模式，为工作流程分析奠定了可解释的基础。
结果：我们在精细的CAT-SG数据集上评估了我们的方法。ProtoFlow不仅在整体准确度上优于标准GNN基线，而且在有限数据、少样本场景中表现出卓越的鲁棒性，即使只在一个手术视频上训练也能保持强大的性能。我们的定性分析进一步表明，学习到的原型成功地识别了不同的手术亚技术，并为工作流程偏差和罕见并发症提供了清晰、可解释的见解。
结论：通过将稳健的表示学习与内在的可解释性相结合，ProtoFlow代表了朝着开发更透明、可靠和数据高效的人工智能系统迈出的重要一步，加速了它们在手术培训、实时决策支持和工作流程优化中临床应用的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces ProtoFlow, a GNN-based framework that learns dynamic scene graph prototypes for interpretable and robust surgical workflow modeling, achieving high accuracy and robustness even with limited data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ProtoFlow，一个基于GNN的框架，它学习动态场景图原型来进行可解释和鲁棒的手术工作流程建模，即使在数据有限的情况下也能实现高精度和鲁棒性。

title: DriverGaze360: OmniDirectional Driver Attention with Object-Level Guidance
summary: Predicting driver attention is a critical problem for developing explainable autonomous driving systems and understanding driver behavior in mixed human-autonomous vehicle traffic scenarios. Although significant progress has been made through large-scale driver attention datasets and deep learning architectures, existing works are constrained by narrow frontal field-of-view and limited driving diversity. Consequently, they fail to capture the full spatial context of driving environments, especially during lane changes, turns, and interactions involving peripheral objects such as pedestrians or cyclists. In this paper, we introduce DriverGaze360, a large-scale 360$^\circ$ field of view driver attention dataset, containing $\sim$1 million gaze-labeled frames collected from 19 human drivers, enabling comprehensive omnidirectional modeling of driver gaze behavior. Moreover, our panoramic attention prediction approach, DriverGaze360-Net, jointly learns attention maps and attended objects by employing an auxiliary semantic segmentation head. This improves spatial awareness and attention prediction across wide panoramic inputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriverGaze360-Net achieves state-of-the-art attention prediction performance on multiple metrics on panoramic driving images. Dataset and method available at https://av.dfki.de/drivergaze360.
summary_zh: 预测驾驶员注意力是开发可解释的自动驾驶系统以及理解人-自动驾驶混合交通场景中驾驶员行为的关键问题。尽管通过大规模驾驶员注意力数据集和深度学习架构已取得显著进展，但现有工作受到狭窄的前方视野和有限驾驶多样性的制约。因此，它们无法捕捉驾驶环境的完整空间上下文，尤其是在变道、转弯以及涉及行人或骑自行车者等周边物体的交互过程中。在本文中，我们推出了DriverGaze360，一个大规模的360$^\circ$视野驾驶员注意力数据集，包含从19名驾驶员收集的约100万个带有视线标注的帧，能够对驾驶员的视线行为进行全面的全向建模。此外，我们的全景注意力预测方法DriverGaze360-Net，通过采用辅助语义分割头，联合学习注意力图和关注对象。这提高了宽全景输入中的空间感知和注意力预测。大量实验表明，DriverGaze360-Net在全景驾驶图像上，在多个指标上实现了最先进的注意力预测性能。数据集和方法可在https://av.dfki.de/drivergaze360获取。
tldr: The paper introduces DriverGaze360, a large-scale 360-degree driver attention dataset and an associated attention prediction model, DriverGaze360-Net, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in panoramic driving image attention prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DriverGaze360，一个大规模的360度驾驶员注意力数据集，以及一个相关的注意力预测模型DriverGaze360-Net，该模型在全景驾驶图像注意力预测方面实现了最先进的性能。

title: Robust Single-shot Structured Light 3D Imaging via Neural Feature Decoding
summary: We consider the problem of active 3D imaging using single-shot structured light systems, which are widely employed in commercial 3D sensing devices such as Apple Face ID and Intel RealSense. Traditional structured light methods typically decode depth correspondences through pixel-domain matching algorithms, resulting in limited robustness under challenging scenarios like occlusions, fine-structured details, and non-Lambertian surfaces. Inspired by recent advances in neural feature matching, we propose a learning-based structured light decoding framework that performs robust correspondence matching within feature space rather than the fragile pixel domain. Our method extracts neural features from the projected patterns and captured infrared (IR) images, explicitly incorporating their geometric priors by building cost volumes in feature space, achieving substantial performance improvements over pixel-domain decoding approaches. To further enhance depth quality, we introduce a depth refinement module that leverages strong priors from large-scale monocular depth estimation models, improving fine detail recovery and global structural coherence. To facilitate effective learning, we develop a physically-based structured light rendering pipeline, generating nearly one million synthetic pattern-image pairs with diverse objects and materials for indoor settings. Experiments demonstrate that our method, trained exclusively on synthetic data with multiple structured light patterns, generalizes well to real-world indoor environments, effectively processes various pattern types without retraining, and consistently outperforms both commercial structured light systems and passive stereo RGB-based depth estimation methods. Project page: https://namisntimpot.github.io/NSLweb/.
summary_zh: 我们考虑使用单次拍摄结构光系统进行主动3D成像的问题，该系统广泛应用于商业3D传感设备中，如Apple Face ID和Intel RealSense。传统的结构光方法通常通过像素域匹配算法来解码深度对应关系，导致在遮挡、精细结构细节和非朗伯表面等具有挑战性的场景下鲁棒性有限。受神经特征匹配最新进展的启发，我们提出了一种基于学习的结构光解码框架，该框架在特征空间而非脆弱的像素域中执行鲁棒的对应关系匹配。我们的方法从投影图案和捕获的红外(IR)图像中提取神经特征，通过在特征空间中构建代价体来显式地结合其几何先验，从而显著提升了相对于像素域解码方法的性能。为了进一步提高深度质量，我们引入了一个深度细化模块，该模块利用来自大规模单目深度估计模型的强先验，从而改善了精细细节的恢复和全局结构一致性。为了促进有效的学习，我们开发了一个基于物理的结构光渲染流水线，生成了近一百万个包含各种物体和材料的合成图案-图像对，适用于室内环境。实验表明，我们的方法完全在合成数据上使用多种结构光图案进行训练，能够很好地泛化到真实的室内环境中，有效地处理各种图案类型而无需重新训练，并且始终优于商业结构光系统和基于被动立体RGB的深度估计方法。项目主页：https://namisntimpot.github.io/NSLweb/。
tldr: This paper presents a novel neural feature decoding framework for robust single-shot structured light 3D imaging, trained on synthetic data and demonstrating superior performance compared to traditional methods and commercial systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的神经特征解码框架，用于鲁棒的单次结构光3D成像。该框架在合成数据上进行训练，并展示了相对于传统方法和商业系统的卓越性能。

title: FocalComm: Hard Instance-Aware Multi-Agent Perception
summary: Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) is a promising paradigm for improving autonomous driving safety, particularly for vulnerable road users like pedestrians, via robust 3D perception. However, existing CP approaches often optimize for vehicle detection performance metrics, underperforming on smaller, safety-critical objects such as pedestrians, where detection failures can be catastrophic. Furthermore, previous CP methods rely on full feature exchange rather than communicating only salient features that help reduce false negatives. To this end, we present FocalComm, a novel collaborative perception framework that focuses on exchanging hard-instance-oriented features among connected collaborative agents. FocalComm consists of two key novel designs: (1) a learnable progressive hard instance mining (HIM) module to extract hard instance-oriented features per agent, and (2) a query-based feature-level (intermediate) fusion technique that dynamically weights these identified features during collaboration. We show that FocalComm outperforms state-of-the-art collaborative perception methods on two challenging real-world datasets (V2X-Real and DAIR-V2X) across both vehicle-centric and infrastructure-centric collaborative setups. FocalComm also shows a strong performance gain in pedestrian detection in V2X-Real.
summary_zh: 多智能体协同感知（CP）是一种有前景的范式，通过稳健的3D感知来提高自动驾驶的安全性，特别是对行人等弱势道路使用者而言。然而，现有的CP方法通常针对车辆检测性能指标进行优化，在行人之类较小且对安全至关重要的目标上表现不佳，而这些目标的检测失败可能会造成灾难性后果。此外，先前的CP方法依赖于完整的特征交换，而不是仅传输有助于减少假阴性的显著特征。为此，我们提出FocalComm，一种新颖的协同感知框架，专注于在连接的协同智能体之间交换面向难例的特征。FocalComm包含两个关键的新颖设计：（1）一个可学习的渐进式难例挖掘（HIM）模块，用于提取每个智能体的面向难例的特征，以及（2）一种基于查询的特征级（中间层）融合技术，可在协作期间动态地加权这些识别出的特征。我们表明，FocalComm在两个具有挑战性的真实世界数据集（V2X-Real和DAIR-V2X）上，在以车辆为中心和以基础设施为中心的协同设置中，均优于最先进的协同感知方法。FocalComm还在V2X-Real中的行人检测方面表现出强大的性能提升。
tldr: FocalComm is a new collaborative perception framework for autonomous driving that focuses on exchanging hard-instance-oriented features, improving the detection of safety-critical objects like pedestrians, particularly in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) scenarios.
tldr_zh: FocalComm 是一种新的用于自动驾驶的协作感知框架，它专注于交换面向难例的特征，从而提高对行人类安全关键对象的检测，尤其是在车联网 (V2X) 场景中。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Hierarchical Alignment for UAV-based Human Detection using Diffusion Models
summary: Training object detectors demands extensive, task-specific annotations, yet this requirement becomes impractical in UAV-based human detection due to constantly shifting target distributions and the scarcity of labeled images. As a remedy, synthetic simulators are adopted to generate annotated data, with a low annotation cost. However, the domain gap between synthetic and real images hinders the model from being effectively applied to the target domain. Accordingly, we introduce Coarse-to-Fine Hierarchical Alignment (CFHA), a three-stage diffusion-based framework designed to transform synthetic data for UAV-based human detection, narrowing the domain gap while preserving the original synthetic labels. CFHA explicitly decouples global style and local content domain discrepancies and bridges those gaps using three modules: (1) Global Style Transfer -- a diffusion model aligns color, illumination, and texture statistics of synthetic images to the realistic style, using only a small real reference set; (2) Local Refinement -- a super-resolution diffusion model is used to facilitate fine-grained and photorealistic details for the small objects, such as human instances, preserving shape and boundary integrity; (3) Hallucination Removal -- a module that filters out human instances whose visual attributes do not align with real-world data to make the human appearance closer to the target distribution. Extensive experiments on public UAV Sim2Real detection benchmarks demonstrate that our methods significantly improve the detection accuracy compared to the non-transformed baselines. Specifically, our method achieves up to $+14.1$ improvement of mAP50 on Semantic-Drone benchmark. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of the global and local stages and highlight the importance of hierarchical alignment. The code is released at \href{https://github.com/liwd190019/CFHA}{this url}.
summary_zh: 训练目标检测器需要大量的特定任务标注，但在基于无人机的行人检测中，由于目标分布的不断变化以及标注图像的稀缺，这一要求变得不切实际。作为一种补救措施，采用合成模拟器生成带有标注的数据，标注成本较低。然而，合成图像和真实图像之间的领域差距阻碍了模型有效地应用于目标领域。因此，我们引入了一种名为粗到细分层对齐(CFHA)的三阶段基于扩散的框架，旨在转换用于基于无人机的行人检测的合成数据，在缩小领域差距的同时保留原始的合成标签。CFHA显式地解耦了全局风格和局部内容的领域差异，并使用三个模块来弥合这些差距:(1)全局风格迁移——一个扩散模型，仅使用一个小的真实参考集，将合成图像的颜色、光照和纹理统计信息与真实风格对齐;(2)局部细化——一个超分辨率扩散模型，用于增强小物体的精细和照片级细节，例如行人实例，从而保持形状和边界的完整性;(3)幻觉移除——一个模块，过滤掉视觉属性与真实世界数据不一致的行人实例，使行人外观更接近目标分布。在公共无人机Sim2Real检测基准测试上的大量实验表明，与未转换的基线相比，我们的方法显著提高了检测精度。具体而言，我们的方法在Semantic-Drone基准测试上实现了高达+14.1 mAP50的提升。消融研究证实了全局和局部阶段的互补作用，并强调了分层对齐的重要性。代码已发布在\href{https://github.com/liwd190019/CFHA}{此网址}。
tldr: The paper introduces a Coarse-to-Fine Hierarchical Alignment (CFHA) framework using diffusion models to improve UAV-based human detection by transforming synthetic data to reduce the domain gap, achieving significant mAP improvements on Sim2Real benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于扩散模型的粗到细分层对齐（CFHA）框架，通过转换合成数据以缩小域差距，从而提高基于无人机的行人检测性能，并在Sim2Real基准测试中实现了显着的mAP改进。

title: Pattern-Guided Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have shown promise in forecasting future data from multivariate time series. However, few existing methods account for recurring structures, or patterns, that appear within the data. We present Pattern-Guided Diffusion Models (PGDM), which leverage inherent patterns within temporal data for forecasting future time steps. PGDM first extracts patterns using archetypal analysis and estimates the most likely next pattern in the sequence. By guiding predictions with this pattern estimate, PGDM makes more realistic predictions that fit within the set of known patterns. We additionally introduce a novel uncertainty quantification technique based on archetypal analysis, and we dynamically scale the guidance level based on the pattern estimate uncertainty. We apply our method to two well-motivated forecasting applications, predicting visual field measurements and motion capture frames. On both, we show that pattern guidance improves PGDM's performance (MAE / CRPS) by up to 40.67% / 56.26% and 14.12% / 14.10%, respectively. PGDM also outperforms baselines by up to 65.58% / 84.83% and 93.64% / 92.55%.
summary_zh: 扩散模型在预测多元时间序列的未来数据方面展现出潜力。然而，鲜有现有方法考虑数据中出现的重复结构或模式。我们提出了模式引导的扩散模型 (PGDM)，它利用时间数据中的内在模式来预测未来的时间步。PGDM 首先使用原型分析提取模式，并估计序列中最可能的下一个模式。通过使用此模式估计来引导预测，PGDM 可以做出更符合已知模式集的更现实的预测。我们还引入了一种基于原型分析的新型不确定性量化技术，并根据模式估计的不确定性动态调整引导级别。我们将我们的方法应用于两个动机充分的预测应用，即预测视野测量值和动作捕捉帧。在这两种情况下，我们都表明模式引导将 PGDM 的性能（MAE / CRPS）分别提高了高达 40.67% / 56.26% 和 14.12% / 14.10%。PGDM 的性能也优于基线方法，分别高达 65.58% / 84.83% 和 93.64% / 92.55%。
tldr: The paper introduces Pattern-Guided Diffusion Models (PGDM) for time series forecasting, which incorporates recurring patterns extracted via archetypal analysis to improve prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification, demonstrating significant performance gains in visual field measurement and motion capture forecasting.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了模式引导扩散模型（PGDM），用于时间序列预测，该模型结合了通过原型分析提取的重复模式，以提高预测精度和不确定性量化，并在视野测量和运动捕捉预测中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: A Geometric Task-Space Port-Hamiltonian Formulation for Redundant Manipulators
summary: We present a novel geometric port-Hamiltonian formulation of redundant manipulators performing a differential kinematic task $η=J(q)\dot{q}$, where $q$ is a point on the configuration manifold, $η$ is a velocity-like task space variable, and $J(q)$ is a linear map representing the task, for example the classical analytic or geometric manipulator Jacobian matrix. The proposed model emerges from a change of coordinates from canonical Hamiltonian dynamics, and splits the standard Hamiltonian momentum variable into a task-space momentum variable and a null-space momentum variable. Properties of this model and relation to Lagrangian formulations present in the literature are highlighted. Finally, we apply the proposed model in an \textit{Interconnection and Damping Assignment Passivity-Based Control} (IDA-PBC) design to stabilize and shape the impedance of a 7-DOF Emika Panda robot in simulation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种冗余机械臂执行微分运动学任务 $η=J(q)\dot{q}$ 的新型几何Port-Hamiltonian 建模方法，其中 $q$ 是构型流形上的点，$η$ 是类速度的任务空间变量，$J(q)$ 是表示任务的线性映射，例如经典的解析或几何机械臂雅可比矩阵。所提出的模型源于对规范哈密顿动力学进行坐标变换，并将标准的哈密顿动量变量分解为任务空间动量变量和零空间动量变量。着重强调了该模型的性质及其与文献中拉格朗日公式的关系。最后，我们应用该模型进行\textit{互连和阻尼分配的基于无源性的控制} (IDA-PBC) 设计，以稳定和塑造仿真中7自由度Emika Panda机器人的阻抗。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel geometric port-Hamiltonian formulation for redundant manipulators, enabling task-space control using IDA-PBC, demonstrated on a 7-DOF Emika Panda robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于冗余机械臂的新型几何端口哈密顿公式，能够使用IDA-PBC进行任务空间控制，并在7自由度 Emika Panda 机器人上进行了演示。

title: Trajectory Tracking for Multi-Manipulator Systems in Constrained Environments
summary: We consider the problem of cooperative manipulation by a mobile multi-manipulator system operating in obstacle-cluttered and highly constrained environments under spatio-temporal task specifications. The task requires transporting a grasped object while respecting both continuous robot dynamics and discrete geometric constraints arising from obstacles and narrow passages. To address this hybrid structure, we propose a multi-rate planning and control framework that combines offline generation of an STL-satisfying object trajectory and collision-free base footprints with online constrained inverse kinematics and continuous-time feedback control. The resulting closed-loop system enables coordinated reconfiguration of multiple manipulators while tracking the desired object motion. The approach is evaluated in high-fidelity physics simulations using three Franka Emika Panda mobile manipulators rigidly grasping an object.
summary_zh: 我们考虑由移动式多机械臂系统在充满障碍物和高度受限的环境中，按照时空任务规范进行协同操作的问题。该任务要求在尊重连续机器人动力学以及源于障碍物和狭窄通道的离散几何约束的同时，运输一个被抓取的物体。为了解决这种混合结构，我们提出了一种多速率规划与控制框架，该框架将离线生成的满足STL的对象轨迹和无碰撞的底座足迹，与在线受约束的逆运动学和连续时间反馈控制相结合。由此产生的闭环系统能够协调多个机械臂的重构，同时跟踪期望的物体运动。该方法在使用三个刚性抓取一个物体的Franka Emika Panda移动机械臂的高保真物理仿真中进行了评估。
tldr: The paper presents a multi-rate planning and control framework for trajectory tracking of a grasped object by multiple mobile manipulators in constrained environments, combining offline trajectory generation with online constrained inverse kinematics and feedback control, validated in simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多速率规划和控制框架，用于在受限环境中通过多个移动机械臂对抓取物体进行轨迹跟踪，结合了离线轨迹生成与在线约束逆运动学和反馈控制，并在仿真中进行了验证。

title: CLAIM: Camera-LiDAR Alignment with Intensity and Monodepth
summary: In this paper, we unleash the potential of the powerful monodepth model in camera-LiDAR calibration and propose CLAIM, a novel method of aligning data from the camera and LiDAR. Given the initial guess and pairs of images and LiDAR point clouds, CLAIM utilizes a coarse-to-fine searching method to find the optimal transformation minimizing a patched Pearson correlation-based structure loss and a mutual information-based texture loss. These two losses serve as good metrics for camera-LiDAR alignment results and require no complicated steps of data processing, feature extraction, or feature matching like most methods, rendering our method simple and adaptive to most scenes. We validate CLAIM on public KITTI, Waymo, and MIAS-LCEC datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate its superior performance compared with the state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Tompson11/claim.
summary_zh: 本文旨在挖掘强大的单目深度模型在相机-激光雷达标定中的潜力，并提出CLAIM，一种用于对齐相机和激光雷达数据的新方法。给定初始估计以及图像和激光雷达点云对，CLAIM利用一种由粗到精的搜索方法，寻找最优变换，从而最小化基于分块Pearson相关性的结构损失和基于互信息的纹理损失。这两种损失函数作为相机-激光雷达对齐结果的良好度量，无需像大多数方法那样进行复杂的数据处理、特征提取或特征匹配，使得我们的方法既简单又能适应大多数场景。我们在公开的KITTI、Waymo和MIAS-LCEC数据集上验证了CLAIM，实验结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，该方法具有优越的性能。代码可在https://github.com/Tompson11/claim 找到。
tldr: CLAIM is a novel camera-LiDAR calibration method that uses a coarse-to-fine approach minimizing structure and texture loss to achieve state-of-the-art performance on public datasets.
tldr_zh: CLAIM是一种新颖的相机-激光雷达校准方法，它使用由粗到精的方法，通过最小化结构和纹理损失，从而在公共数据集上实现最先进的性能。

title: Impact of Robot Facial-Audio Expressions on Human Robot Trust Dynamics and Trust Repair
summary: Despite recent advances in robotics and human-robot collaboration in the AEC industry, trust has mostly been treated as a static factor, with little guidance on how it changes across events during collaboration. This paper investigates how a robot's task performance and its expressive responses after outcomes shape the dynamics of human trust over time. To this end, we designed a controlled within-subjects study with two construction-inspired tasks, Material Delivery (physical assistance) and Information Gathering (perceptual assistance), and measured trust repeatedly (four times per task) using the 14-item Trust Perception Scale for HRI plus a redelegation choice. The robot produced two multimodal expressions, a "glad" display with a brief confirmation after success, and a "sad" display with an apology and a request for a second chance after failure. The study was conducted in a lab environment with 30 participants and a quadruped platform, and we evaluated trust dynamics and repair across both tasks. Results show that robot success reliably increases trust, failure causes sharp drops, and apology-based expressions partially restores trust (44% recovery in Material Delivery; 38% in Information Gathering). Item-level analysis indicates that recovered trust was driven mostly by interaction and communication factors, with competence recovering partially and autonomy aspects changing least. Additionally, age group and prior attitudes moderated trust dynamics with younger participants showed larger but shorter-lived changes, mid-20s participants exhibited the most durable repair, and older participants showed most conservative dynamics. This work provides a foundation for future efforts that adapt repair strategies to task demands and user profiles to support safe, productive adoption of robots on construction sites.
summary_zh: 尽管近年来AEC行业在机器人技术和人机协作方面取得了显著进展，但信任感主要被视为一个静态因素，对于合作过程中事件如何改变信任感的研究较少。本文研究了机器人的任务表现及其在结果产生后的表达性反应如何塑造人类信任感随时间变化的动态。为此，我们设计了一项受建筑启发的任务为基础的控制型被试内研究，包含材料递送（物理辅助）和信息收集（感知辅助）两项任务，并使用包含14个条目的HRI信任感知量表以及重新委派选择，对信任感进行重复测量（每个任务四次）。机器人产生两种多模态表达，成功后显示一个简短确认的“高兴”表情，失败后显示一个带有道歉和请求再试一次的“悲伤”表情。该研究在实验室环境中进行，有30名参与者和一台四足机器人平台，我们评估了两种任务中的信任动态和修复。结果表明，机器人成功会可靠地提高信任感，失败会导致信任感急剧下降，而基于道歉的表达可以部分地恢复信任感（材料递送任务中恢复44%；信息收集任务中恢复38%）。条目级分析表明，恢复的信任感主要受交互和沟通因素驱动，能力方面的信任部分恢复，而自主性方面的变化最小。此外，年龄组和先前的态度调节了信任感的动态，年轻参与者表现出更大但持续时间更短的变化，20多岁的参与者表现出最持久的修复效果，而年长参与者表现出最保守的动态。这项工作为未来的研究奠定了基础，这些研究将调整修复策略以适应任务需求和用户画像，从而支持在建筑工地上安全、高效地采用机器人。
tldr: This paper investigates how robot facial-audio expressions impact human trust dynamics and trust repair in construction-related tasks, finding that success increases trust, failure decreases it, and apologies partially restore it.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人面部音频表情如何影响建筑相关任务中人类的信任动态和信任修复，发现成功会增加信任，失败会降低信任，而道歉可以部分恢复信任。

title: Explainable Preference Learning: a Decision Tree-based Surrogate Model for Preferential Bayesian Optimization
summary: Current Preferential Bayesian Optimization methods rely on Gaussian Processes (GPs) as surrogate models. These models are hard to interpret, struggle with handling categorical data, and are computationally complex, limiting their real-world usability. In this paper, we introduce an inherently interpretable decision tree-based surrogate model capable of handling both categorical and continuous data, and scalable to large datasets. Extensive numerical experiments on eight increasingly spiky optimization functions show that our model outperforms GP-based alternatives on spiky functions and has only marginally lower performance for non-spiky functions. Moreover, we apply our model to the real-world Sushi dataset and show its ability to learn an individual's sushi preferences. Finally, we show some initial work on using historical preference data to speed up the optimization process for new unseen users.
summary_zh: 当前基于偏好信息的贝叶斯优化方法依赖于高斯过程（GP）作为代理模型。这些模型难以解释，处理类别数据时存在困难，且计算复杂度高，限制了其在现实世界中的可用性。本文提出一种本质上可解释的、基于决策树的代理模型，该模型能够处理类别数据和连续数据，并且可扩展到大型数据集。在八个日益尖锐的优化函数上进行的大量数值实验表明，我们的模型在尖锐函数上优于基于GP的替代方案，且在非尖锐函数上的性能仅略微降低。此外，我们将我们的模型应用于真实的寿司数据集，并展示了其学习个人寿司偏好的能力。最后，我们展示了一些关于使用历史偏好数据来加速新用户的优化过程的初步工作。
tldr: This paper presents an interpretable decision tree-based surrogate model for Preferential Bayesian Optimization, addressing limitations of GP-based methods by handling categorical data, scalability, and interpretability. It demonstrates competitive performance on optimization functions and real-world sushi preference learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于决策树的、可解释的偏好贝叶斯优化替代模型，通过处理类别数据、可扩展性和可解释性，解决了基于高斯过程方法的局限性。它在优化函数和现实世界的寿司偏好学习中表现出有竞争力的性能。

title: FacEDiT: Unified Talking Face Editing and Generation via Facial Motion Infilling
summary: Talking face editing and face generation have often been studied as distinct problems. In this work, we propose viewing both not as separate tasks but as subtasks of a unifying formulation, speech-conditional facial motion infilling. We explore facial motion infilling as a self-supervised pretext task that also serves as a unifying formulation of dynamic talking face synthesis. To instantiate this idea, we propose FacEDiT, a speech-conditional Diffusion Transformer trained with flow matching. Inspired by masked autoencoders, FacEDiT learns to synthesize masked facial motions conditioned on surrounding motions and speech. This formulation enables both localized generation and edits, such as substitution, insertion, and deletion, while ensuring seamless transitions with unedited regions. In addition, biased attention and temporal smoothness constraints enhance boundary continuity and lip synchronization. To address the lack of a standard editing benchmark, we introduce FacEDiTBench, the first dataset for talking face editing, featuring diverse edit types and lengths, along with new evaluation metrics. Extensive experiments validate that talking face editing and generation emerge as subtasks of speech-conditional motion infilling; FacEDiT produces accurate, speech-aligned facial edits with strong identity preservation and smooth visual continuity while generalizing effectively to talking face generation.
summary_zh: 说话人脸编辑和人脸生成通常作为截然不同的问题进行研究。在本工作中，我们提出将两者视为一个统一公式的子任务，即语音条件下的面部运动填充，而不是单独的任务。 我们探索面部运动填充作为一种自监督的预训练任务，同时也可以作为动态说话人脸合成的统一公式。为了具体化这个想法，我们提出了 FacEDiT，一个通过流动匹配训练的语音条件扩散Transformer。受到掩码自编码器的启发， FacEDiT学习合成以周围运动和语音为条件的掩码面部运动。这种公式能够实现局部生成和编辑，例如替换、插入和删除，同时确保与未编辑区域的无缝过渡。此外，有偏注意力机制和时间平滑约束增强了边界连续性和唇形同步。 为了解决缺乏标准编辑基准的问题，我们推出了 FacEDiTBench，这是第一个用于说话人脸编辑的数据集，具有多样化的编辑类型和长度，以及新的评估指标。 广泛的实验验证了说话人脸编辑和生成是语音条件运动填充的子任务； FacEDiT能够生成准确、与语音对齐的面部编辑，具有强大的身份保留和流畅的视觉连续性，同时能够有效地泛化到说话人脸生成。
tldr: The paper introduces FacEDiT, a speech-conditional Diffusion Transformer for unified talking face editing and generation based on facial motion infilling, along with a new benchmark dataset, FacEDiTBench.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了FacEDiT，一个基于面部运动填充的语音条件扩散Transformer，用于统一的说话人脸编辑和生成，并提出了一个新的基准数据集FacEDiTBench。

title: Intelligent matter consisting of active particles
summary: In this book chapter, we review how systems of simple motile agents can be used as a pathway to intelligent systems. It is a well known result from nature that large groups of entities following simple rules, such as swarms of animals, can give rise to much more complex collective behavior in a display of emergence. This begs the question whether we can emulate this behavior in synthetic matter and drive it to a point where the collective behavior reaches the complexity level of intelligent systems. Here, we will use a formalized notion of "intelligent matter" and compare it to recent results in the field of active matter. First, we will explore the approach of emergent computing in which specialized active matter systems are designed to directly solve a given task through emergent behavior. This we will then contrast with the approach of physical reservoir computing powered by the dynamics of active particle systems. In this context, we will also describe a novel reservoir computing scheme for active particles driven ultrasonically or via light refraction.
summary_zh: 本书章节中，我们回顾了如何利用简单的运动主体系统作为通往智能系统的一条途径。自然界中一个广为人知的结果是，遵循简单规则的大量实体群体，例如动物群，能够涌现出更为复杂的集体行为。这引出了一个问题：我们是否能够在合成物质中模拟这种行为，并将其驱动到集体行为达到智能系统复杂程度的临界点。在这里，我们将采用“智能物质”的形式化概念，并将其与活性物质领域的最新研究成果进行比较。首先，我们将探讨涌现式计算的方法，其中专用活性物质系统被设计成通过涌现行为直接解决给定的任务。然后，我们将把这种方法与由活性粒子系统动力学驱动的物理储备池计算方法进行对比。在此背景下，我们还将描述一种由超声波或光折射驱动的活性粒子的新型储备池计算方案。
tldr: This book chapter explores the potential of active matter systems to achieve intelligence through emergent computing and physical reservoir computing, including a novel reservoir computing scheme.
tldr_zh: 该书章节探讨了利用活性物质系统通过涌现计算和物理储层计算实现智能的潜力，包括一种新型的储层计算方案。

title: TUMTraf EMOT: Event-Based Multi-Object Tracking Dataset and Baseline for Traffic Scenarios
summary: In Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), multi-object tracking is primarily based on frame-based cameras. However, these cameras tend to perform poorly under dim lighting and high-speed motion conditions. Event cameras, characterized by low latency, high dynamic range and high temporal resolution, have considerable potential to mitigate these issues. Compared to frame-based vision, there are far fewer studies on event-based vision. To address this research gap, we introduce an initial pilot dataset tailored for event-based ITS, covering vehicle and pedestrian detection and tracking. We establish a tracking-by-detection benchmark with a specialized feature extractor based on this dataset, achieving excellent performance.
summary_zh: 在智能交通系统(ITS)中，多目标跟踪主要依赖于基于帧的相机。然而，这些相机在光线昏暗和高速运动条件下通常表现不佳。事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和高时间分辨率的特性，因此在缓解这些问题上具有相当大的潜力。与基于帧的视觉相比，关于基于事件的视觉的研究要少得多。为了弥补这一研究空白，我们引入了一个针对基于事件的ITS的初始试验数据集，涵盖车辆和行人的检测与跟踪。我们基于该数据集建立了一个基于检测的跟踪基准，并设计了一个专门的特征提取器，实现了优异的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a new event-based multi-object tracking dataset (TUMTraf EMOT) for traffic scenarios, aiming to address the limitations of frame-based cameras in challenging lighting and high-speed conditions. They also establish a baseline tracking-by-detection benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个新的基于事件的多目标跟踪数据集（TUMTraf EMOT），用于交通场景，旨在解决基于帧的相机在具有挑战性的光照和高速条件下的局限性。他们还建立了一个基线检测跟踪基准。

title: DASP: Self-supervised Nighttime Monocular Depth Estimation with Domain Adaptation of Spatiotemporal Priors
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation has achieved notable success under daytime conditions. However, its performance deteriorates markedly at night due to low visibility and varying illumination, e.g., insufficient light causes textureless areas, and moving objects bring blurry regions. To this end, we propose a self-supervised framework named DASP that leverages spatiotemporal priors for nighttime depth estimation. Specifically, DASP consists of an adversarial branch for extracting spatiotemporal priors and a self-supervised branch for learning. In the adversarial branch, we first design an adversarial network where the discriminator is composed of four devised spatiotemporal priors learning blocks (SPLB) to exploit the daytime priors. In particular, the SPLB contains a spatial-based temporal learning module (STLM) that uses orthogonal differencing to extract motion-related variations along the time axis and an axial spatial learning module (ASLM) that adopts local asymmetric convolutions with global axial attention to capture the multiscale structural information. By combining STLM and ASLM, our model can acquire sufficient spatiotemporal features to restore textureless areas and estimate the blurry regions caused by dynamic objects. In the self-supervised branch, we propose a 3D consistency projection loss to bilaterally project the target frame and source frame into a shared 3D space, and calculate the 3D discrepancy between the two projected frames as a loss to optimize the 3D structural consistency and daytime priors. Extensive experiments on the Oxford RobotCar and nuScenes datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance for nighttime depth estimation. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component.
summary_zh: 在自监督单目深度估计领域，白天条件下已经取得了显著的成功。然而，由于低可见度和变化的光照条件（例如，光照不足导致无纹理区域，运动物体带来模糊区域），其在夜间的性能显著下降。为此，我们提出了一个名为DASP的自监督框架，该框架利用时空先验进行夜间深度估计。具体而言，DASP由一个用于提取时空先验的对抗分支和一个用于学习的自监督分支组成。在对抗分支中，我们首先设计了一个对抗网络，其判别器由四个精心设计的时空先验学习块（SPLB）组成，以利用白天先验。特别地，SPLB包含一个基于空间的时间学习模块（STLM），该模块使用正交差分来提取沿时间轴的运动相关变化，以及一个轴向空间学习模块（ASLM），该模块采用具有全局轴向注意力的局部非对称卷积来捕获多尺度结构信息。通过结合STLM和ASLM，我们的模型可以获取足够的时空特征来恢复无纹理区域并估计由动态物体引起的模糊区域。在自监督分支中，我们提出了一个3D一致性投影损失，以双向地将目标帧和源帧投影到共享的3D空间中，并计算两个投影帧之间的3D差异作为损失，以优化3D结构一致性和白天先验。在Oxford RobotCar和nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在夜间深度估计方面取得了最先进的性能。消融研究进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。
tldr: The paper presents DASP, a self-supervised framework for nighttime monocular depth estimation using spatiotemporal priors learned through adversarial training and a 3D consistency projection loss, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 DASP，一个自监督的夜间单目深度估计框架，利用对抗训练学习时空先验，并使用 3D 一致性投影损失，在基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: HGS: Hybrid Gaussian Splatting with Static-Dynamic Decomposition for Compact Dynamic View Synthesis
summary: Dynamic novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for creating immersive experiences. Existing approaches have advanced dynamic NVS by introducing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with implicit deformation fields or indiscriminately assigned time-varying parameters, surpassing NeRF-based methods. However, due to excessive model complexity and parameter redundancy, they incur large model sizes and slow rendering speeds, making them inefficient for real-time applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices. To obtain a more efficient model with fewer redundant parameters, in this paper, we propose Hybrid Gaussian Splatting (HGS), a compact and efficient framework explicitly designed to disentangle static and dynamic regions of a scene within a unified representation. The core innovation of HGS lies in our Static-Dynamic Decomposition (SDD) strategy, which leverages Radial Basis Function (RBF) modeling for Gaussian primitives. Specifically, for dynamic regions, we employ time-dependent RBFs to effectively capture temporal variations and handle abrupt scene changes, while for static regions, we reduce redundancy by sharing temporally invariant parameters. Additionally, we introduce a two-stage training strategy tailored for explicit models to enhance temporal coherence at static-dynamic boundaries. Experimental results demonstrate that our method reduces model size by up to 98% and achieves real-time rendering at up to 125 FPS at 4K resolution on a single RTX 3090 GPU. It further sustains 160 FPS at 1352 * 1014 on an RTX 3050 and has been integrated into the VR system. Moreover, HGS achieves comparable rendering quality to state-of-the-art methods while providing significantly improved visual fidelity for high-frequency details and abrupt scene changes.
summary_zh: 动态新视角合成（NVS）对于创造沉浸式体验至关重要。现有的方法通过引入带有隐式形变场的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）或者不加选择地分配随时间变化的参数，推进了动态NVS的发展，超越了基于NeRF的方法。然而，由于过度的模型复杂性和参数冗余，它们导致模型体积庞大，渲染速度缓慢，使得它们在实时应用中效率低下，尤其是在资源受限的设备上。为了获得一个更高效的模型，减少冗余参数，在本文中，我们提出了一种混合高斯溅射（HGS），这是一种紧凑且高效的框架，专门用于在统一的表示中解耦场景的静态和动态区域。HGS的核心创新在于我们的静态-动态分解（SDD）策略，该策略利用径向基函数（RBF）建模高斯基元。具体来说，对于动态区域，我们采用时间相关的RBFs来有效地捕捉时间变化并处理突发场景变化，而对于静态区域，我们通过共享时间不变参数来减少冗余。此外，我们引入了一种针对显式模型的两阶段训练策略，以增强静态-动态边界处的时间一致性。实验结果表明，我们的方法将模型尺寸减少了高达98%，并在单个RTX 3090 GPU上以高达125 FPS的速度实现了4K分辨率的实时渲染。它进一步在RTX 3050上以1352 * 1014的分辨率维持了160 FPS，并已集成到VR系统中。此外，HGS在实现与最先进方法相当的渲染质量的同时，为高频细节和突发场景变化提供了显著提高的视觉保真度。
tldr: The paper introduces Hybrid Gaussian Splatting (HGS), a method for efficient dynamic novel view synthesis that disentangles static and dynamic scene regions using RBF modeling, achieving real-time rendering with significantly reduced model size.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了混合高斯溅射（HGS），一种用于高效的动态新视角合成的方法，它使用RBF建模分离静态和动态场景区域，从而以显著减小的模型尺寸实现实时渲染。

title: 4D-RaDiff: Latent Diffusion for 4D Radar Point Cloud Generation
summary: Automotive radar has shown promising developments in environment perception due to its cost-effectiveness and robustness in adverse weather conditions. However, the limited availability of annotated radar data poses a significant challenge for advancing radar-based perception systems. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework to generate 4D radar point clouds for training and evaluating object detectors. Unlike image-based diffusion, our method is designed to consider the sparsity and unique characteristics of radar point clouds by applying diffusion to a latent point cloud representation. Within this latent space, generation is controlled via conditioning at either the object or scene level. The proposed 4D-RaDiff converts unlabeled bounding boxes into high-quality radar annotations and transforms existing LiDAR point cloud data into realistic radar scenes. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating synthetic radar data of 4D-RaDiff as data augmentation method during training consistently improves object detection performance compared to training on real data only. In addition, pre-training on our synthetic data reduces the amount of required annotated radar data by up to 90% while achieving comparable object detection performance.
summary_zh: 汽车雷达因其经济性和在恶劣天气条件下的鲁棒性，在环境感知方面展现出良好的发展前景。然而，标注雷达数据的有限性对推进基于雷达的感知系统构成重大挑战。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新的框架，用于生成4D雷达点云，以训练和评估目标检测器。与基于图像的扩散不同，我们的方法通过将扩散应用于潜在点云表示，从而考虑雷达点云的稀疏性和独特特征。在这个潜在空间中，生成过程通过对象或场景级的条件调节来控制。所提出的4D-RaDiff将未标记的边界框转换为高质量的雷达标注，并将现有的LiDAR点云数据转换为逼真的雷达场景。实验表明，在训练期间将4D-RaDiff的合成雷达数据作为数据增强方法，与仅在真实数据上训练相比，能够持续提高目标检测性能。此外，在我们的合成数据上进行预训练，可以在实现相当的目标检测性能的同时，将所需的标注雷达数据量减少高达90%。
