Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that ColaVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both open-loop and closed-loop settings with favorable efficiency and robustness.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶需要从复杂的多模态输入中生成安全可靠的轨迹。传统的模块化流程将感知、预测和规划相分离，而最近的端到端（E2E）系统则将它们联合学习。 视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过引入跨模态先验和常识推理进一步丰富了这个范式，但目前基于VLM的规划器面临三个关键挑战： (i) 离散文本推理与连续控制之间的不匹配，(ii)来自自回归思维链解码的高延迟，以及(iii)限制实时部署的低效或非因果规划器。我们提出了ColaVLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，它将推理从文本转移到一个统一的潜在空间，并将其与分层、并行轨迹解码器耦合。认知潜在推理器通过自我适应选择和仅两次VLM前向传递，将场景理解压缩成紧凑的、面向决策的元动作嵌入。分层并行规划器随后在一次前向传递中生成多尺度、因果一致的轨迹。总之，这些组件保留了VLM的泛化性和可解释性，同时实现了高效、准确和安全的轨迹生成。在nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，ColaVLA在开环和闭环设置中都实现了最先进的性能，同时具有良好的效率和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces ColaVLA, a vision-language-action framework for autonomous driving that addresses limitations of current VLM-based planners by using a cognitive latent reasoner and hierarchical parallel planner to achieve efficient and safe trajectory generation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ColaVLA，一个用于自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作框架，它通过使用认知潜在推理器和分层并行规划器来解决当前基于VLM的规划器的局限性，从而实现高效且安全的轨迹生成。

title: ReDiF: Reinforced Distillation for Few Step Diffusion
summary: Distillation addresses the slow sampling problem in diffusion models by creating models with smaller size or fewer steps that approximate the behavior of high-step teachers. In this work, we propose a reinforcement learning based distillation framework for diffusion models. Instead of relying on fixed reconstruction or consistency losses, we treat the distillation process as a policy optimization problem, where the student is trained using a reward signal derived from alignment with the teacher's outputs. This RL driven approach dynamically guides the student to explore multiple denoising paths, allowing it to take longer, optimized steps toward high-probability regions of the data distribution, rather than relying on incremental refinements. Our framework utilizes the inherent ability of diffusion models to handle larger steps and effectively manage the generative process. Experimental results show that our method achieves superior performance with significantly fewer inference steps and computational resources compared to existing distillation techniques. Additionally, the framework is model agnostic, applicable to any type of diffusion models with suitable reward functions, providing a general optimization paradigm for efficient diffusion learning.
summary_zh: 蒸馏通过创建尺寸更小或步数更少的模型来解决扩散模型中采样速度慢的问题，这些模型近似于高步数教师的行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的扩散模型蒸馏框架。我们不依赖于固定的重构或一致性损失，而是将蒸馏过程视为一个策略优化问题，其中学生的训练使用一个从与教师输出对齐而获得的奖励信号。这种由强化学习驱动的方法动态地引导学生探索多个去噪路径，使其能够采取更长、更优化的步骤，朝着数据分布的高概率区域前进，而不是依赖于增量式的精细化。我们的框架利用了扩散模型处理更大步长的固有能力，并有效地管理生成过程。实验结果表明，与现有的蒸馏技术相比，我们的方法仅需明显更少的推理步骤和计算资源就能获得更优越的性能。此外，该框架是模型无关的，适用于任何类型的扩散模型，只要具有合适的奖励函数，为高效的扩散学习提供了一种通用的优化范式。
tldr: The paper introduces ReDiF, a reinforcement learning-based distillation framework for diffusion models that optimizes student models to take larger, more efficient denoising steps, achieving better performance with fewer steps and less computation compared to existing distillation methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReDiF，一种基于强化学习的扩散模型蒸馏框架，优化学生模型以采取更大、更有效的去噪步骤，与现有蒸馏方法相比，以更少的步骤和更少的计算量实现了更好的性能。

title: VPTracker: Global Vision-Language Tracking via Visual Prompt and MLLM
summary: Vision-Language Tracking aims to continuously localize objects described by a visual template and a language description. Existing methods, however, are typically limited to local search, making them prone to failures under viewpoint changes, occlusions, and rapid target movements. In this work, we introduce the first global tracking framework based on Multimodal Large Language Models (VPTracker), exploiting their powerful semantic reasoning to locate targets across the entire image space. While global search improves robustness and reduces drift, it also introduces distractions from visually or semantically similar objects. To address this, we propose a location-aware visual prompting mechanism that incorporates spatial priors into the MLLM. Specifically, we construct a region-level prompt based on the target's previous location, enabling the model to prioritize region-level recognition and resort to global inference only when necessary. This design retains the advantages of global tracking while effectively suppressing interference from distracting visual content. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly enhances tracking stability and target disambiguation under challenging scenarios, opening a new avenue for integrating MLLMs into visual tracking. Code is available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/VPTracker.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言跟踪旨在连续地定位由视觉模板和语言描述所描述的目标。然而，现有方法通常局限于局部搜索，这使得它们在视角变化、遮挡和目标快速移动的情况下容易失效。在这项工作中，我们引入了首个基于多模态大型语言模型（VPTracker）的全局跟踪框架，利用其强大的语义推理能力在整个图像空间中定位目标。虽然全局搜索提高了鲁棒性并减少了漂移，但它也引入了来自视觉或语义相似物体的干扰。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种位置感知的视觉提示机制，将空间先验知识融入到MLLM中。具体来说，我们基于目标之前的位置构建了一个区域级别的提示，使模型能够优先考虑区域级别的识别，并且仅在必要时才诉诸全局推理。这种设计保留了全局跟踪的优势，同时有效地抑制了来自分散视觉内容的干扰。大量的实验表明，我们的方法显著增强了在具有挑战性的场景下的跟踪稳定性和目标消歧能力，为将MLLM集成到视觉跟踪中开辟了一条新途径。代码可在https://github.com/jcwang0602/VPTracker获取。
tldr: This paper introduces VPTracker, a novel vision-language tracking framework leveraging multimodal large language models and location-aware visual prompting for robust global target localization in challenging scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为VPTracker的新型视觉-语言跟踪框架，该框架利用多模态大型语言模型和位置感知的视觉提示，以便在具有挑战性的场景中实现鲁棒的全局目标定位。

title: TrimTokenator-LC: Towards Adaptive Visual Token Pruning for Large Multimodal Models with Long Contexts
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have proven effective on various tasks. They typically encode visual inputs into Original Model sequences of tokens, which are then concatenated with textual tokens and jointly processed by the language model. However, the growing number of visual tokens greatly increases inference cost. Visual token pruning has emerged as a promising solution. However, existing methods often overlook scenarios involving long context inputs with multiple images. In this paper, we analyze the challenges of visual token pruning in long context, multi-image settings and introduce an adaptive pruning method tailored for such scenarios. We decompose redundancy into intra-image and inter-image components and quantify them through intra-image diversity and inter-image variation, which jointly guide dynamic budget allocation. Our approach consists of two stages. The intra-image stage allocates each image a content-aware token budget and greedily selects its most representative tokens. The inter-image stage performs global diversity filtering to form a candidate pool and then applies a Pareto selection procedure that balances diversity with text alignment. Extensive experiments show that our approach maintains strong performance in long context settings while significantly cutting down the number of visual tokens.
summary_zh: 大型多模态模型(LMMs)已被证明在各种任务中非常有效。它们通常将视觉输入编码成原始模型的token序列，然后与文本token连接，并由语言模型联合处理。然而，不断增长的视觉token数量极大地增加了推理成本。视觉token剪枝已成为一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有方法通常忽略了涉及长上下文和多图像输入的场景。在本文中，我们分析了长上下文、多图像设置中视觉token剪枝的挑战，并提出了一种针对此类场景定制的自适应剪枝方法。我们将冗余分解为图像内和图像间分量，并通过图像内多样性和图像间变异来量化它们，共同指导动态预算分配。我们的方法包括两个阶段。图像内阶段为每个图像分配一个内容相关的token预算，并贪婪地选择其最具代表性的token。图像间阶段执行全局多样性过滤以形成候选池，然后应用帕累托选择程序，以平衡多样性与文本对齐。大量实验表明，我们的方法在长上下文设置下保持了强大的性能，同时显著减少了视觉token的数量。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for adaptively pruning visual tokens in Large Multimodal Models, specifically targeting long-context, multi-image scenarios to reduce inference cost while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种自适应地修剪大型多模态模型中的视觉标记的方法，特别是针对长上下文、多图像场景，以降低推理成本并保持性能。

title: SCPainter: A Unified Framework for Realistic 3D Asset Insertion and Novel View Synthesis
summary: 3D Asset insertion and novel view synthesis (NVS) are key components for autonomous driving simulation, enhancing the diversity of training data. With better training data that is diverse and covers a wide range of situations, including long-tailed driving scenarios, autonomous driving models can become more robust and safer. This motivates a unified simulation framework that can jointly handle realistic integration of inserted 3D assets and NVS. Recent 3D asset reconstruction methods enable reconstruction of dynamic actors from video, supporting their re-insertion into simulated driving scenes. While the overall structure and appearance can be accurate, it still struggles to capture the realism of 3D assets through lighting or shadows, particularly when inserted into scenes. In parallel, recent advances in NVS methods have demonstrated promising results in synthesizing viewpoints beyond the originally recorded trajectories. However, existing approaches largely treat asset insertion and NVS capabilities in isolation. To allow for interaction with the rest of the scene and to enable more diverse creation of new scenarios for training, realistic 3D asset insertion should be combined with NVS. To address this, we present SCPainter (Street Car Painter), a unified framework which integrates 3D Gaussian Splat (GS) car asset representations and 3D scene point clouds with diffusion-based generation to jointly enable realistic 3D asset insertion and NVS. The 3D GS assets and 3D scene point clouds are projected together into novel views, and these projections are used to condition a diffusion model to generate high quality images. Evaluation on the Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate the capability of our framework to enable 3D asset insertion and NVS, facilitating the creation of diverse and realistic driving data.
summary_zh: 3D 资产插入和新视角合成 (NVS) 是自动驾驶模拟的关键组成部分，能够增强训练数据的多样性。凭借更优质、多样化且覆盖广泛场景（包括长尾驾驶场景）的训练数据，自动驾驶模型可以变得更加稳健和安全。这促使人们开发一种统一的模拟框架，能够联合处理插入的 3D 资产的逼真集成和 NVS。 近期 3D 资产重建方法支持从视频中重建动态对象，从而支持将其重新插入到模拟的驾驶场景中。虽然整体结构和外观可能足够准确，但它仍然难以捕捉 3D 资产通过光照或阴影体现的逼真感，尤其是在插入场景中时。与此同时，NVS 方法的最新进展在合成超出原始记录轨迹的视角方面表现出良好的效果。然而，现有方法在很大程度上孤立地处理了资产插入和 NVS 功能。为了允许与场景的其余部分进行交互，并实现更多样化的新场景创建以进行训练，逼真的 3D 资产插入应与 NVS 相结合。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 SCPainter (Street Car Painter)，一个统一的框架，它集成了基于扩散生成的 3D 高斯 Splat (GS) 车辆资产表示和 3D 场景点云，以共同实现逼真的 3D 资产插入和 NVS。3D GS 资产和 3D 场景点云被一起投影到新视角中，这些投影被用来调节扩散模型以生成高质量图像。在 Waymo Open Dataset 上的评估证明了我们框架支持 3D 资产插入和 NVS 的能力，从而促进了多样化和逼真的驾驶数据的创建。
tldr: The paper introduces SCPainter, a unified framework combining 3D Gaussian Splatting and diffusion models for realistic 3D asset insertion and novel view synthesis to generate diverse training data for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SCPainter，一个统一的框架，结合了3D高斯溅射和扩散模型，用于逼真的3D资产插入和新视角合成，从而为自动驾驶生成多样化的训练数据。

title: TEACH: Temporal Variance-Driven Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved significant success in solving single-goal tasks. However, uniform goal selection often results in sample inefficiency in multi-goal settings where agents must learn a universal goal-conditioned policy. Inspired by the adaptive and structured learning processes observed in biological systems, we propose a novel Student-Teacher learning paradigm with a Temporal Variance-Driven Curriculum to accelerate Goal-Conditioned RL. In this framework, the teacher module dynamically prioritizes goals with the highest temporal variance in the policy's confidence score, parameterized by the state-action value (Q) function. The teacher provides an adaptive and focused learning signal by targeting these high-uncertainty goals, fostering continual and efficient progress. We establish a theoretical connection between the temporal variance of Q-values and the evolution of the policy, providing insights into the method's underlying principles. Our approach is algorithm-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with existing RL frameworks. We demonstrate this through evaluation across 11 diverse robotic manipulation and maze navigation tasks. The results show consistent and notable improvements over state-of-the-art curriculum learning and goal-selection methods.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）在解决单目标任务方面取得了显著成功。然而，在需要智能体学习通用目标条件策略的多目标环境中，统一目标选择通常会导致样本效率低下。受生物系统中观察到的自适应和结构化学习过程的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的基于时间方差驱动课程的学生-教师学习范式，以加速目标条件强化学习。在该框架中，教师模块动态地优先选择策略置信度得分中具有最高时间方差的目标，该置信度得分由状态-动作价值（Q）函数参数化。教师通过针对这些高不确定性目标，提供自适应和集中的学习信号，从而促进持续和高效的进步。我们建立了Q值的时间方差与策略演化之间的理论联系，深入了解了该方法的底层原理。我们的方法与算法无关，并且可以与现有的RL框架无缝集成。我们通过在11个不同的机器人操作和迷宫导航任务中的评估证明了这一点。结果表明，与最先进的课程学习和目标选择方法相比，我们的方法获得了持续且显著的改进。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel teacher-student curriculum learning approach for goal-conditioned RL, where the teacher prioritizes goals based on the temporal variance of Q-values, leading to improved sample efficiency in multi-goal tasks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种新颖的用于目标条件强化学习的Teacher-Student课程学习方法，其中teacher根据Q值的时间方差来确定目标的优先级，从而提高了多目标任务中的样本效率。

title: Active Constraint Learning in High Dimensions from Demonstrations
summary: We present an iterative active constraint learning (ACL) algorithm, within the learning from demonstrations (LfD) paradigm, which intelligently solicits informative demonstration trajectories for inferring an unknown constraint in the demonstrator's environment. Our approach iteratively trains a Gaussian process (GP) on the available demonstration dataset to represent the unknown constraints, uses the resulting GP posterior to query start/goal states, and generates informative demonstrations which are added to the dataset. Across simulation and hardware experiments using high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics and unknown nonlinear constraints, our method outperforms a baseline, random-sampling based method at accurately performing constraint inference from an iteratively generated set of sparse but informative demonstrations.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种迭代的主动约束学习 (ACL) 算法，它位于从演示中学习 (LfD) 范式中，该算法智能地请求信息丰富的演示轨迹，以推断演示者环境中未知的约束。我们的方法迭代地训练一个高斯过程 (GP) 来代表未知的约束，使用获得的高斯过程后验来查询起始/目标状态，并生成信息丰富的演示，将其添加到数据集。 通过使用高维非线性动力学和未知非线性约束的仿真和硬件实验，我们的方法在从迭代生成的稀疏但信息丰富的演示集中准确执行约束推断方面，优于基于随机抽样的基线方法。
tldr: This paper presents an active constraint learning algorithm using Gaussian processes within a Learning from Demonstrations framework, showing improved performance over random sampling in high-dimensional environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯过程的主动约束学习算法，应用于从演示学习框架中，并在高维环境中优于随机采样方法。

title: Heterogeneity in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Heterogeneity is a fundamental property in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), which is closely related not only to the functional differences of agents, but also to policy diversity and environmental interactions. However, the MARL field currently lacks a rigorous definition and deeper understanding of heterogeneity. This paper systematically discusses heterogeneity in MARL from the perspectives of definition, quantification, and utilization. First, based on an agent-level modeling of MARL, we categorize heterogeneity into five types and provide mathematical definitions. Second, we define the concept of heterogeneity distance and propose a practical quantification method. Third, we design a heterogeneity-based multi-agent dynamic parameter sharing algorithm as an example of the application of our methodology. Case studies demonstrate that our method can effectively identify and quantify various types of agent heterogeneity. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm, compared to other parameter sharing baselines, has better interpretability and stronger adaptability. The proposed methodology will help the MARL community gain a more comprehensive and profound understanding of heterogeneity, and further promote the development of practical algorithms.
summary_zh: 异质性是多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 中的一个基本属性，它不仅与智能体的功能差异密切相关，还与策略多样性和环境交互密切相关。然而，MARL 领域目前缺乏对异质性的严格定义和深入理解。本文从定义、量化和利用的角度系统地探讨了 MARL 中的异质性。首先，基于 MARL 的智能体级别建模，我们将异质性分为五种类型，并提供了数学定义。其次，我们定义了异质性距离的概念，并提出了一种实用的量化方法。第三，我们设计了一种基于异质性的多智能体动态参数共享算法，作为应用我们方法论的一个例子。案例研究表明，我们的方法可以有效地识别和量化各种类型的智能体异质性。实验结果表明，与其他的参数共享基线相比，所提出的算法具有更好的可解释性和更强的适应性。所提出的方法将有助于 MARL 社区对异质性获得更全面和深刻的理解，并进一步促进实用算法的发展。
tldr: This paper tackles heterogeneity in MARL by providing definitions, quantification methods, and a dynamic parameter sharing algorithm, demonstrating improved interpretability and adaptability compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文解决了多智能体强化学习中的异质性问题，通过提供定义、量化方法和一个动态参数共享算法，证明了与基线相比，具有更好的可解释性和适应性。

title: EgoReAct: Egocentric Video-Driven 3D Human Reaction Generation
summary: Humans exhibit adaptive, context-sensitive responses to egocentric visual input. However, faithfully modeling such reactions from egocentric video remains challenging due to the dual requirements of strictly causal generation and precise 3D spatial alignment. To tackle this problem, we first construct the Human Reaction Dataset (HRD) to address data scarcity and misalignment by building a spatially aligned egocentric video-reaction dataset, as existing datasets (e.g., ViMo) suffer from significant spatial inconsistency between the egocentric video and reaction motion, e.g., dynamically moving motions are always paired with fixed-camera videos. Leveraging HRD, we present EgoReAct, the first autoregressive framework that generates 3D-aligned human reaction motions from egocentric video streams in real-time. We first compress the reaction motion into a compact yet expressive latent space via a Vector Quantised-Variational AutoEncoder and then train a Generative Pre-trained Transformer for reaction generation from the visual input. EgoReAct incorporates 3D dynamic features, i.e., metric depth, and head dynamics during the generation, which effectively enhance spatial grounding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoReAct achieves remarkably higher realism, spatial consistency, and generation efficiency compared with prior methods, while maintaining strict causality during generation. We will release code, models, and data upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 人类对自我中心视觉输入展现出适应性和情境相关的反应。然而，由于严格的因果生成和精确的3D空间对齐的双重需求，从自我中心视频中忠实地建模这种反应仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们首先构建了人类反应数据集（HRD），通过构建空间对齐的自我中心视频-反应数据集来解决数据稀缺和未对齐的问题，因为现有的数据集（例如，ViMo）在自我中心视频和反应运动之间存在显著的空间不一致性，例如，动态运动总是与固定摄像头的视频配对。利用HRD，我们提出了EgoReAct，这是第一个从自我中心视频流中实时生成3D对齐的人类反应运动的自回归框架。我们首先通过矢量量化变分自编码器将反应运动压缩成紧凑而富有表现力的潜在空间，然后训练生成式预训练Transformer模型，以从视觉输入中生成反应。EgoReAct在生成过程中融入了3D动态特征，即度量深度和头部动态，有效地增强了空间定位。大量的实验表明，与现有方法相比，EgoReAct在保持严格因果关系的同时，实现了显著更高的真实感、空间一致性和生成效率。我们将在接受后发布代码、模型和数据。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoReAct, a novel autoregressive framework leveraging a new Human Reaction Dataset (HRD) to generate spatially aligned 3D human reaction motions from egocentric video in real-time, achieving improved realism and spatial consistency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoReAct，一个新颖的自回归框架，它利用新的人体反应数据集（HRD）从以自我为中心的视频中实时生成空间对齐的3D人体反应运动，从而实现了改进的真实感和空间一致性。

title: Next Best View Selections for Semantic and Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Understanding semantics and dynamics has been crucial for embodied agents in various tasks. Both tasks have much more data redundancy than the static scene understanding task. We formulate the view selection problem as an active learning problem, where the goal is to prioritize frames that provide the greatest information gain for model training. To this end, we propose an active learning algorithm with Fisher Information that quantifies the informativeness of candidate views with respect to both semantic Gaussian parameters and deformation networks. This formulation allows our method to jointly handle semantic reasoning and dynamic scene modeling, providing a principled alternative to heuristic or random strategies. We evaluate our method on large-scale static images and dynamic video datasets by selecting informative frames from multi-camera setups. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves rendering quality and semantic segmentation performance, outperforming baseline methods based on random selection and uncertainty-based heuristics.
summary_zh: 理解语义和动态信息对于具身智能体在各种任务中至关重要。与静态场景理解任务相比，这两类任务都具有更多的数据冗余。我们将视角选择问题定义为一个主动学习问题，其目标是优先选择能够为模型训练提供最大信息增益的帧。为此，我们提出了一种基于费希尔信息的主动学习算法，该算法能够量化候选视角在语义高斯参数和形变网络两方面的的信息量。这种公式化使得我们的方法能够联合处理语义推理和动态场景建模，为启发式或随机策略提供了一种有原则的替代方案。我们通过从多相机设置中选择信息丰富的帧，在大规模静态图像和动态视频数据集上评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够持续提高渲染质量和语义分割性能，优于基于随机选择和基于不确定性启发式的基线方法。
tldr: The paper proposes an active learning approach using Fisher Information to select the most informative views for training semantic and dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting models, improving rendering quality and semantic segmentation performance. It addresses the data redundancy in dynamic scene understanding and active view selection.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用Fisher信息的主动学习方法，用于选择信息量最大的视图来训练语义和动态3D高斯溅射模型，从而提高渲染质量和语义分割性能。它解决了动态场景理解中的数据冗余和主动视图选择问题。

title: ByteLoom: Weaving Geometry-Consistent Human-Object Interactions through Progressive Curriculum Learning
summary: Human-object interaction (HOI) video generation has garnered increasing attention due to its promising applications in digital humans, e-commerce, advertising, and robotics imitation learning. However, existing methods face two critical limitations: (1) a lack of effective mechanisms to inject multi-view information of the object into the model, leading to poor cross-view consistency, and (2) heavy reliance on fine-grained hand mesh annotations for modeling interaction occlusions. To address these challenges, we introduce ByteLoom, a Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based framework that generates realistic HOI videos with geometrically consistent object illustration, using simplified human conditioning and 3D object inputs. We first propose an RCM-cache mechanism that leverages Relative Coordinate Maps (RCM) as a universal representation to maintain object's geometry consistency and precisely control 6-DoF object transformations in the meantime. To compensate HOI dataset scarcity and leverage existing datasets, we further design a training curriculum that enhances model capabilities in a progressive style and relaxes the demand of hand mesh. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method faithfully preserves human identity and the object's multi-view geometry, while maintaining smooth motion and object manipulation.
summary_zh: 人-物交互（HOI）视频生成因其在数字人、电子商务、广告和机器人模仿学习等领域中的应用前景而备受关注。然而，现有方法面临两个关键限制：（1）缺乏将物体的多视角信息有效注入模型中的机制，导致跨视角一致性较差；（2）过度依赖于精细的手部网格标注来建模交互遮挡。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ByteLoom，一个基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的框架，它使用简化的人体条件输入和3D物体输入，生成具有几何一致性物体渲染的真实HOI视频。我们首先提出了一种RCM-缓存机制，该机制利用相对坐标图（RCM）作为一种通用表示，以保持物体的几何一致性，同时精control 6自由度物体变换。为了弥补HOI数据集的稀缺性并利用现有数据集，我们进一步设计了一种训练课程，以渐进式风格增强模型能力，并Relax对手部网格的需求。大量实验表明，我们的方法忠实地保留了人的身份和物体的多视角几何形状，同时保持了平滑的运动和物体操作。
tldr: ByteLoom addresses geometrically consistent Human-Object Interaction (HOI) video generation using a Diffusion Transformer and a novel RCM-cache mechanism, with a progressive curriculum learning approach to overcome data scarcity.
tldr_zh: ByteLoom 致力于解决几何一致的人-物交互 (HOI) 视频生成问题，采用扩散 Transformer 和新型 RCM 缓存机制，以及渐进式课程学习方法来克服数据稀缺问题。

title: Depth Anything in $360^\circ$: Towards Scale Invariance in the Wild
summary: Panoramic depth estimation provides a comprehensive solution for capturing complete $360^\circ$ environmental structural information, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, while extensively studied in indoor settings, its zero-shot generalization to open-world domains lags far behind perspective images, which benefit from abundant training data. This disparity makes transferring capabilities from the perspective domain an attractive solution. To bridge this gap, we present Depth Anything in $360^\circ$ (DA360), a panoramic-adapted version of Depth Anything V2. Our key innovation involves learning a shift parameter from the ViT backbone, transforming the model's scale- and shift-invariant output into a scale-invariant estimate that directly yields well-formed 3D point clouds. This is complemented by integrating circular padding into the DPT decoder to eliminate seam artifacts, ensuring spatially coherent depth maps that respect spherical continuity. Evaluated on standard indoor benchmarks and our newly curated outdoor dataset, Metropolis, DA360 shows substantial gains over its base model, achieving over 50\% and 10\% relative depth error reduction on indoor and outdoor benchmarks, respectively. Furthermore, DA360 significantly outperforms robust panoramic depth estimation methods, achieving about 30\% relative error improvement compared to PanDA across all three test datasets and establishing new state-of-the-art performance for zero-shot panoramic depth estimation.
summary_zh: 全景深度估计为捕获完整的$360^\circ$环境结构信息提供了一种全面的解决方案，为机器人和AR/VR应用带来了显著优势。然而，虽然已在室内环境中得到广泛研究，但其到开放世界领域的零样本泛化能力却远落后于透视图像，后者受益于海量的训练数据。这种差距使得从透视领域迁移能力成为一种有吸引力的解决方案。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了$360^\circ$全景深度估计（DA360），这是Depth Anything V2的全景适应版本。我们的关键创新在于从ViT主干网络中学习一个平移参数，将模型的尺度和平移不变输出转换为尺度不变的估计，从而直接产生良好成形的3D点云。此外，我们还将圆形填充集成到DPT解码器中，以消除接缝伪影，确保尊重球面连续性的空间一致的深度图。在标准室内基准数据集和我们新策划的室外数据集Metropolis上进行的评估表明，DA360相比其基础模型取得了显著提升，在室内和室外基准数据集上分别实现了超过50％和10％的相对深度误差降低。此外，DA360显著优于鲁棒的全景深度估计方法，与PanDA相比，在所有三个测试数据集上取得了约30％的相对误差改进，并为零样本全景深度估计建立了新的最先进性能。
tldr: The paper introduces DA360, a panoramic depth estimation model based on Depth Anything V2, adapted for zero-shot generalization in open-world environments via learned shift parameters and circular padding, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 DA360，一个基于 Depth Anything V2 的全景深度估计模型，通过学习偏移参数和圆形填充进行调整，以实现开放世界环境中的零样本泛化，并取得了最先进的性能。

title: Split4D: Decomposed 4D Scene Reconstruction Without Video Segmentation
summary: This paper addresses the problem of decomposed 4D scene reconstruction from multi-view videos. Recent methods achieve this by lifting video segmentation results to a 4D representation through differentiable rendering techniques. Therefore, they heavily rely on the quality of video segmentation maps, which are often unstable, leading to unreliable reconstruction results. To overcome this challenge, our key idea is to represent the decomposed 4D scene with the Freetime FeatureGS and design a streaming feature learning strategy to accurately recover it from per-image segmentation maps, eliminating the need for video segmentation. Freetime FeatureGS models the dynamic scene as a set of Gaussian primitives with learnable features and linear motion ability, allowing them to move to neighboring regions over time. We apply a contrastive loss to Freetime FeatureGS, forcing primitive features to be close or far apart based on whether their projections belong to the same instance in the 2D segmentation map. As our Gaussian primitives can move across time, it naturally extends the feature learning to the temporal dimension, achieving 4D segmentation. Furthermore, we sample observations for training in a temporally ordered manner, enabling the streaming propagation of features over time and effectively avoiding local minima during the optimization process. Experimental results on several datasets show that the reconstruction quality of our method outperforms recent methods by a large margin.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了从多视角视频中进行分解式4D场景重建的问题。最近的方法通过可微渲染技术将视频分割结果提升到4D表示来实现这一目标。因此，它们严重依赖于视频分割图的质量，而视频分割图通常不稳定，导致重建结果不可靠。为了克服这一挑战，我们的核心思想是用Freetime FeatureGS来表示分解式4D场景，并设计一种流式特征学习策略，以从每张图像的分割图中准确恢复它，从而消除了对视频分割的需求。Freetime FeatureGS将动态场景建模为一组具有可学习特征和线性运动能力的高斯原语，使其能够在时间推移上移动到相邻区域。我们对Freetime FeatureGS应用了对比损失，根据高斯原语投影是否属于2D分割图中的同一实例，强制原语特征彼此靠近或远离。由于我们的高斯原语可以跨时间移动，它自然地将特征学习扩展到时间维度，从而实现4D分割。此外，我们以时间顺序方式对训练样本进行采样，从而实现特征在时间上的流式传播，并有效避免了优化过程中的局部最小值。在几个数据集上的实验结果表明，我们方法的重建质量大大超过了最近的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces Split4D, a novel decomposed 4D scene reconstruction method that leverages Freetime FeatureGS and a streaming feature learning strategy to overcome the limitations of relying on video segmentation, using only per-image segmentation maps.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Split4D，一种新的分解式4D场景重建方法， 利用Freetime FeatureGS和流式特征学习策略，克服了依赖视频分割的局限性，仅使用每张图像的分割图。

title: Autoregressive Flow Matching for Motion Prediction
summary: Motion prediction has been studied in different contexts with models trained on narrow distributions and applied to downstream tasks in human motion prediction and robotics. Simultaneously, recent efforts in scaling video prediction have demonstrated impressive visual realism, yet they struggle to accurately model complex motions despite massive scale. Inspired by the scaling of video generation, we develop autoregressive flow matching (ARFM), a new method for probabilistic modeling of sequential continuous data and train it on diverse video datasets to generate future point track locations over long horizons. To evaluate our model, we develop benchmarks for evaluating the ability of motion prediction models to predict human and robot motion. Our model is able to predict complex motions, and we demonstrate that conditioning robot action prediction and human motion prediction on predicted future tracks can significantly improve downstream task performance. Code and models publicly available at: https://github.com/Johnathan-Xie/arfm-motion-prediction.
summary_zh: 运动预测已经在不同的背景下被研究，相关模型通常在狭窄的分布上训练，并被应用于人体运动预测和机器人领域的下游任务。与此同时，近期视频预测领域在大规模扩展方面取得了令人印象深刻的视觉真实感，但尽管具有巨大的规模，它们仍然难以准确地建模复杂运动。受到视频生成扩展的启发，我们开发了自回归流动匹配（ARFM），这是一种用于序列连续数据概率建模的新方法，并在多样化的视频数据集上对其进行训练，以生成长时程的未来点轨迹位置。为了评估我们的模型，我们开发了用于评估运动预测模型预测人类和机器人运动能力的基准。我们的模型能够预测复杂运动，并且我们证明，将机器人动作预测和人体运动预测以预测的未来轨迹为条件，可以显著提高下游任务的性能。代码和模型可在以下网址公开获取：https://github.com/Johnathan-Xie/arfm-motion-prediction。
tldr: The paper introduces Autoregressive Flow Matching (ARFM) for probabilistic motion prediction, demonstrating improved performance on predicting complex human and robot motions and enhancing downstream task performance when conditioned on these predictions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于概率运动预测的自回归流动匹配（ARFM），展示了在预测复杂人类和机器人运动方面的改进性能，并在基于这些预测进行调节时提升了下游任务的性能。

title: Adaptive Trust Consensus for Blockchain IoT: Comparing RL, DRL, and MARL Against Naive, Collusive, Adaptive, Byzantine, and Sleeper Attacks
summary: Securing blockchain-enabled IoT networks against sophisticated adversarial attacks remains a critical challenge. This paper presents a trust-based delegated consensus framework integrating Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) with Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) for privacy-preserving policy evaluation, combined with learning-based defense mechanisms. We systematically compare three reinforcement learning approaches -- tabular Q-learning (RL), Deep RL with Dueling Double DQN (DRL), and Multi-Agent RL (MARL) -- against five distinct attack families: Naive Malicious Attack (NMA), Collusive Rumor Attack (CRA), Adaptive Adversarial Attack (AAA), Byzantine Fault Injection (BFI), and Time-Delayed Poisoning (TDP). Experimental results on a 16-node simulated IoT network reveal significant performance variations: MARL achieves superior detection under collusive attacks (F1=0.85 vs. DRL's 0.68 and RL's 0.50), while DRL and MARL both attain perfect detection (F1=1.00) against adaptive attacks where RL fails (F1=0.50). All agents successfully defend against Byzantine attacks (F1=1.00). Most critically, the Time-Delayed Poisoning attack proves catastrophic for all agents, with F1 scores dropping to 0.11-0.16 after sleeper activation, demonstrating the severe threat posed by trust-building adversaries. Our findings indicate that coordinated multi-agent learning provides measurable advantages for defending against sophisticated trust manipulation attacks in blockchain IoT environments.
summary_zh: 保障基于区块链的物联网网络免受复杂的对抗攻击仍然是一个关键挑战。本文提出了一种基于信任的委托共识框架，该框架集成了全同态加密（FHE）和基于属性的访问控制（ABAC），以实现隐私保护策略评估，并结合了基于学习的防御机制。我们系统地比较了三种强化学习方法——表格Q学习（RL）、带有竞争双重DQN的深度强化学习（DRL）和多智能体强化学习（MARL）——针对五种不同的攻击类型：朴素恶意攻击（NMA）、合谋谣言攻击（CRA）、自适应对抗攻击（AAA）、拜占庭故障注入（BFI）和时间延迟投毒（TDP）。在一个16节点模拟物联网网络上的实验结果表明，性能差异显著：MARL在合谋攻击下实现了卓越的检测效果（F1=0.85，而DRL为0.68，RL为0.50），而DRL和MARL在自适应攻击下都实现了完美的检测效果（F1=1.00），而RL则失败（F1=0.50）。所有智能体都成功防御了拜占庭攻击（F1=1.00）。最关键的是，时间延迟投毒攻击对所有智能体来说都是灾难性的，在休眠激活后，F1得分降至0.11-0.16，这表明建立信任的对抗者构成了严重威胁。我们的研究结果表明，协调的多智能体学习在防御区块链物联网环境中复杂的信任操纵攻击方面提供了可衡量的优势。
tldr: This paper explores different reinforcement learning (RL, DRL, MARL) approaches for defending blockchain-enabled IoT networks against various adversarial attacks, finding MARL superior against collusive attacks but all agents vulnerable to time-delayed poisoning.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了不同的强化学习（RL、DRL、MARL）方法，用于防御区块链物联网网络中的各种对抗性攻击。研究发现，MARL 在应对合谋攻击方面表现更优，但所有 agents 都容易受到时延中毒攻击。

title: JADAI: Jointly Amortizing Adaptive Design and Bayesian Inference
summary: We consider problems of parameter estimation where design variables can be actively optimized to maximize information gain. To this end, we introduce JADAI, a framework that jointly amortizes Bayesian adaptive design and inference by training a policy, a history network, and an inference network end-to-end. The networks minimize a generic loss that aggregates incremental reductions in posterior error along experimental sequences. Inference networks are instantiated with diffusion-based posterior estimators that can approximate high-dimensional and multimodal posteriors at every experimental step. Across standard adaptive design benchmarks, JADAI achieves superior or competitive performance.
summary_zh: 我们考虑参数估计问题，其中设计变量可以被主动优化，以最大化信息增益。为此，我们引入JADAI，一个联合摊销贝叶斯自适应设计与推理的框架，通过端到端地训练策略网络、历史网络和推理网络来实现。这些网络最小化一个通用损失函数，该函数聚合了沿实验序列的后验误差的增量式减少。推理网络使用基于扩散的后验估计器进行实例化，这些估计器可以近似每个实验步骤中的高维和多模态后验分布。在标准自适应设计基准测试中，JADAI实现了优越或具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: JADAI is a framework that uses neural networks trained end-to-end to jointly perform Bayesian adaptive design and inference for parameter estimation problems, outperforming or matching existing methods on standard benchmarks. It uses diffusion-based posterior estimators for better handling of high-dimensional and multimodal posteriors.
tldr_zh: JADAI是一个框架，它使用端到端训练的神经网络联合执行贝叶斯自适应设计和推理，用于参数估计问题，其性能优于或与现有方法在标准基准上匹配。 它使用基于扩散的后验估计器来更好地处理高维和多峰后验。

title: PoseStreamer: A Multi-modal Framework for 6DoF Pose Estimation of Unseen Moving Objects
summary: Six degree of freedom (6DoF) pose estimation for novel objects is a critical task in computer vision, yet it faces significant challenges in high-speed and low-light scenarios where standard RGB cameras suffer from motion blur. While event cameras offer a promising solution due to their high temporal resolution, current 6DoF pose estimation methods typically yield suboptimal performance in high-speed object moving scenarios. To address this gap, we propose PoseStreamer, a robust multi-modal 6DoF pose estimation framework designed specifically on high-speed moving scenarios. Our approach integrates three core components: an Adaptive Pose Memory Queue that utilizes historical orientation cues for temporal consistency, an Object-centric 2D Tracker that provides strong 2D priors to boost 3D center recall, and a Ray Pose Filter for geometric refinement along camera rays. Furthermore, we introduce MoCapCube6D, a novel multi-modal dataset constructed to benchmark performance under rapid motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseStreamer not only achieves superior accuracy in high-speed moving scenarios, but also exhibits strong generalizability as a template-free framework for unseen moving objects.
summary_zh: 针对新物体的六自由度(6DoF)姿态估计是计算机视觉中的一项关键任务，但在高速和低光照环境下，标准RGB相机容易受到运动模糊的影响，这给该任务带来了重大挑战。虽然事件相机凭借其高时间分辨率提供了一种很有前景的解决方案，但目前大多数6DoF姿态估计算法在高速物体运动场景中的表现通常欠佳。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出PoseStreamer，这是一个鲁棒的多模态6DoF姿态估计框架，专门为高速运动场景设计。我们的方法整合了三个核心组件：一个利用历史方向线索以保证时间一致性的自适应姿态记忆队列、一个提供强2D先验以提升3D中心召回率的以物体为中心的2D跟踪器，以及一个用于沿相机光线进行几何精化的光线姿态滤波器。此外，我们引入了MoCapCube6D，这是一个新型多模态数据集，用于在高速度运动下评估性能。大量实验表明，PoseStreamer不仅在高速运动场景中实现了卓越的精度，而且作为一种针对未见运动物体的无模板框架，也展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: PoseStreamer is a new multi-modal framework for 6DoF pose estimation of unseen moving objects in high-speed scenarios, using event cameras and a novel dataset (MoCapCube6D) to overcome motion blur challenges.
tldr_zh: PoseStreamer 是一个新型多模态框架，用于在高速场景中估计未见过的移动物体的 6DoF 姿势。该框架利用事件相机和一个新的数据集 (MoCapCube6D) 来克服运动模糊挑战。

title: Schrodinger AI: A Unified Spectral-Dynamical Framework for Classification, Reasoning, and Operator-Based Generalization
summary:
We introduce \textbf{Schrödinger AI}, a unified machine learning framework inspired by quantum mechanics. The system is defined by three tightly coupled components: (1) a {time-independent wave-energy solver} that treats perception and classification as spectral decomposition under a learned Hamiltonian; (2) a {time-dependent dynamical solver} governing the evolution of semantic wavefunctions over time, enabling context-aware decision revision, re-routing, and reasoning under environmental changes; and (3) a {low-rank operator calculus} that learns symbolic transformations such as modular arithmetic through learned quantum-like transition operators. Together, these components form a coherent physics-driven alternative to conventional cross-entropy training and transformer attention, providing robust generalization, interpretable semantics, and emergent topology.
  Empirically, Schrödinger AI demonstrates: (a) emergent semantic manifolds that reflect human-conceived class relations without explicit supervision; (b) dynamic reasoning that adapts to changing environments, including maze navigation with real-time potential-field perturbations; and (c) exact operator generalization on modular arithmetic tasks, where the system learns group actions and composes them across sequences far beyond training length. These results suggest a new foundational direction for machine learning, where learning is cast as discovering and navigating an underlying semantic energy landscape.
summary_zh:
我们引入了\textbf{薛定谔AI}，一个受量子力学启发的统一机器学习框架。该系统由三个紧密耦合的组件定义：（1）一个{与时间无关的波能量求解器}，将感知和分类视为在学习到的哈密顿量下的谱分解；（2）一个{与时间相关的动态求解器}，控制语义波函数随时间的演化，从而能够在环境变化下进行上下文感知的决策修正、重新路由和推理；以及（3）一个{低秩算子演算}，通过学习到的类量子跃迁算子学习符号变换，例如模算术。这些组件共同构成了一种连贯的、物理驱动的替代方案，以取代传统的交叉熵训练和Transformer注意力机制，从而提供强大的泛化能力、可解释的语义和涌现的拓扑结构。

  从经验上讲，薛定谔AI展示了：（a）涌现的语义流形，反映了人类构思的类关系，无需显式监督；（b）动态推理，可以适应不断变化的环境，包括具有实时势场扰动的迷宫导航；以及（c）在模算术任务上的精确算子泛化，其中系统学习群作用并在远超训练长度的序列中组合它们。这些结果表明了机器学习的一个新的基础方向，即将学习视为发现和导航潜在的语义能量景观。
tldr: Schrödinger AI is a novel machine learning framework inspired by quantum mechanics, offering a unified approach to classification, reasoning, and operator-based generalization, demonstrating promising results in semantic understanding, dynamic reasoning, and exact operator learning.
tldr_zh: Schrödinger AI是一个受量子力学启发的全新机器学习框架，它为分类、推理和基于算子的泛化提供了一种统一的方法，并在语义理解、动态推理和精确算子学习方面取得了可喜的成果。

title: P-FABRIK: A General Intuitive and Robust Inverse Kinematics Method for Parallel Mechanisms Using FABRIK Approach
summary: Traditional geometric inverse kinematics methods for parallel mechanisms rely on specific spatial geometry constraints. However, their application to redundant parallel mechanisms is challenged due to the increased constraint complexity. Moreover, it will output no solutions and cause unpredictable control problems when the target pose lies outside its workspace. To tackle these challenging issues, this work proposes P-FABRIK, a general, intuitive, and robust inverse kinematics method to find one feasible solution for diverse parallel mechanisms based on the FABRIK algorithm. By decomposing the general parallel mechanism into multiple serial sub-chains using a new topological decomposition strategy, the end targets of each sub-chain can be subsequently revised to calculate the inverse kinematics solutions iteratively. Multiple case studies involving planar, standard, and redundant parallel mechanisms demonstrated the proposed method's generality across diverse parallel mechanisms. Furthermore, numerical simulation studies verified its efficacy and computational efficiency, as well as its robustness ability to handle out-of-workspace targets.
summary_zh: 针对并联机构的传统几何逆运动学方法依赖于特定的空间几何约束。然而，由于约束复杂性的增加，它们在冗余并联机构中的应用面临挑战。此外，当目标姿态位于工作空间之外时，它将输出无解并导致不可预测的控制问题。为了解决这些挑战性问题，本文提出了一种基于FABRIK算法的通用、直观且鲁棒的逆运动学方法P-FABRIK，用于寻找各种并联机构的一个可行解。通过使用一种新的拓扑分解策略将一般的并联机构分解成多个串联子链，可以随后修正每个子链的末端目标，以迭代计算逆运动学解。涉及平面、标准和冗余并联机构的多个案例研究证明了该方法在各种并联机构中的通用性。此外，数值模拟研究验证了其有效性和计算效率，以及其处理工作空间外目标的鲁棒性能力。
tldr: The paper introduces P-FABRIK, a FABRIK-based inverse kinematics method for parallel mechanisms, addressing challenges with traditional methods, especially for redundant mechanisms and out-of-workspace targets, demonstrating its generality, efficacy, and robustness across various parallel mechanism types.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于 FABRIK 的并行机构逆运动学方法 P-FABRIK，解决了传统方法的挑战，尤其是在冗余机构和超出工作空间目标的情况下，并展示了其在各种并行机构类型中的通用性、有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Sistema de navegación de cobertura para vehículos no holonómicos en ambientes de exterior
summary: In mobile robotics, coverage navigation refers to the deliberate movement of a robot with the purpose of covering a certain area or volume. Performing this task properly is fundamental for the execution of several activities, for instance, cleaning a facility with a robotic vacuum cleaner. In the mining industry, it is required to perform coverage in several unit processes related with material movement using industrial machinery, for example, in cleaning tasks, in dumps, and in the construction of tailings dam walls. The automation of these processes is fundamental to enhance the security associated with their execution. In this work, a coverage navigation system for a non-holonomic robot is presented. This work is intended to be a proof of concept for the potential automation of various unit processes that require coverage navigation like the ones mentioned before. The developed system includes the calculation of routes that allow a mobile platform to cover a specific area, and incorporates recovery behaviors in case that an unforeseen event occurs, such as the arising of dynamic or previously unmapped obstacles in the terrain to be covered, e.g., other machines or pedestrians passing through the area, being able to perform evasive maneuvers and post-recovery to ensure a complete coverage of the terrain. The system was tested in different simulated and real outdoor environments, obtaining results near 90% of coverage in the majority of experiments. The next step of development is to scale up the utilized robot to a mining machine/vehicle whose operation will be validated in a real environment. The result of one of the tests performed in the real world can be seen in the video available in https://youtu.be/gK7_3bK1P5g.
summary_zh: 在移动机器人领域，覆盖导航是指机器人为了覆盖特定区域或体积而进行的有目的的移动。正确地执行这项任务对于执行若干活动至关重要，例如，使用机器人真空吸尘器清洁设施。在采矿业中，需要使用工业机械在与物料运输相关的多个单元过程中执行覆盖，例如，在清洁任务、矿渣堆以及尾矿坝墙的建设中。这些过程的自动化对于提高与其执行相关的安全性至关重要。本文提出了一种用于非完整约束机器人的覆盖导航系统。这项工作旨在验证各种需要覆盖导航的单元过程自动化的潜力，如前所述。开发的系统包括计算允许移动平台覆盖特定区域的路线，并包含在发生不可预见事件时的恢复行为，例如在待覆盖地形中出现动态或先前未映射的障碍物，例如，其他机器或行人通过该区域，从而能够执行规避操作和后恢复，以确保对地形的完整覆盖。该系统在不同的模拟和真实户外环境中进行了测试，在大多数实验中获得了接近90%的覆盖率。开发的下一步是将所使用的机器人扩展到矿用机械/车辆，其运行将在真实环境中进行验证。在现实世界中进行的其中一项测试的结果可以在视频https://youtu.be/gK7_3bK1P5g中看到。
tldr: This paper presents a coverage navigation system for non-holonomic robots in outdoor environments, focusing on mining industry applications and incorporating recovery behaviors for unforeseen obstacles. The system achieved approximately 90% coverage in simulated and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于室外环境中非完整机器人覆盖导航系统，重点关注矿业应用，并结合了对不可预见障碍的恢复行为。 该系统在模拟和实际环境中实现了约 90%的覆盖率。

title: Reach-Avoid Differential game with Reachability Analysis for UAVs: A decomposition approach
summary: Reach-avoid (RA) games have significant applications in security and defense, particularly for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). These problems are inherently challenging due to the need to consider obstacles, consider the adversarial nature of opponents, ensure optimality, and account for nonlinear dynamics. Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis has emerged as a powerful tool for tackling these challenges; however, while it has been applied to games involving two spatial dimensions, directly extending this approach to three spatial dimensions is impossible due to high dimensionality. On the other hand, alternative approaches for solving RA games lack the generality to consider games with three spatial dimensions involving agents with non-trivial system dynamics. In this work, we propose a novel framework for dimensionality reduction by decomposing the problem into a horizontal RA sub-game and a vertical RA sub-game. We then solve each sub-game using HJ reachability analysis and consider second-order dynamics that account for the defender's acceleration. To reconstruct the solution to the original RA game from the sub-games, we introduce a HJ-based tracking control algorithm in each sub-game that not only guarantees capture of the attacker but also tracking of the attacker thereafter. We prove the conditions under which the capture guarantees are maintained. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated via numerical simulations, showing that the decomposition maintains optimality and guarantees in the original problem. Our methods are also validated in a Gazebo physics simulator, achieving successful capture of quadrotors in three spatial dimensions space for the first time to the best of our knowledge.
summary_zh: 抵达-规避（RA）博弈在安全和防御领域，特别是无人机（UAV）方面具有重要应用。由于需要考虑障碍物，考虑对手的对抗性质，确保最优性以及考虑非线性动力学，这些问题本身就具有挑战性。Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析已经成为解决这些挑战的有力工具；然而，虽然它已经被应用于涉及两个空间维度的博弈，但由于高维度性，直接将这种方法扩展到三个空间维度是不可能的。另一方面，解决RA博弈的替代方法缺乏通用性，无法考虑涉及具有非平凡系统动力学的代理的三个空间维度的博弈。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的降维框架，通过将问题分解为水平RA子博弈和垂直RA子博弈。然后，我们使用HJ可达性分析来解决每个子博弈，并考虑能够考虑到防御者加速度的二阶动力学。为了从子博弈中重建原始RA博弈的解，我们在每个子博弈中引入了一种基于HJ的跟踪控制算法，该算法不仅保证捕获攻击者，而且保证此后对攻击者的跟踪。我们证明了保持捕获保证的条件。通过数值模拟证明了我们方法的有效性，表明该分解在原始问题中保持了最优性和保证。我们的方法还在Gazebo物理模拟器中得到了验证，据我们所知，首次实现了在三个空间维度空间中成功捕获四旋翼飞行器。
tldr: This paper presents a novel framework for solving 3D reach-avoid differential games for UAVs by decomposing the problem into horizontal and vertical sub-games solved via Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis, achieving successful capture in simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的框架，通过将问题分解为水平和垂直子博弈，利用 Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析解决无人机三维可达-避让微分博弈问题，并在仿真中成功实现了捕获。

title: A Low-Cost UAV Deep Learning Pipeline for Integrated Apple Disease Diagnosis,Freshness Assessment, and Fruit Detection
summary: Apple orchards require timely disease detection, fruit quality assessment, and yield estimation, yet existing UAV-based systems address such tasks in isolation and often rely on costly multispectral sensors. This paper presents a unified, low-cost RGB-only UAV-based orchard intelligent pipeline integrating ResNet50 for leaf disease detection, VGG 16 for apple freshness determination, and YOLOv8 for real-time apple detection and localization. The system runs on an ESP32-CAM and Raspberry Pi, providing fully offline on-site inference without cloud support. Experiments demonstrate 98.9% accuracy for leaf disease classification, 97.4% accuracy for freshness classification, and 0.857 F1 score for apple detection. The framework provides an accessible and scalable alternative to multispectral UAV solutions, supporting practical precision agriculture on affordable hardware.
summary_zh: 苹果园需要及时的病害检测、果实质量评估和产量估计，然而，现有的基于无人机的系统通常孤立地处理这些任务，并且往往依赖于昂贵的多光谱传感器。本文提出了一种统一的、低成本的、仅使用RGB图像的基于无人机的果园智能流水线，该流水线集成了用于叶片病害检测的ResNet50、用于苹果新鲜度判定的VGG16和用于实时苹果检测与定位的YOLOv8。该系统运行在ESP32-CAM和Raspberry Pi上，提供完全离线的现场推理，无需云支持。实验表明，叶片病害分类的准确率为98.9%，新鲜度分类的准确率为97.4%，苹果检测的F1值为0.857。该框架为多光谱无人机解决方案提供了一种可访问且可扩展的替代方案，支持在经济实惠的硬件上实现实用的精准农业。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost UAV system for apple orchard management, integrating disease detection, freshness assessment, and fruit detection using deep learning models (ResNet50, VGG16, YOLOv8) on affordable hardware (ESP32-CAM, Raspberry Pi).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种低成本的无人机系统，用于苹果园管理，集成了疾病检测、新鲜度评估和水果检测，使用深度学习模型（ResNet50，VGG16，YOLOv8）在经济实惠的硬件（ESP32-CAM，Raspberry Pi）上实现。

title: YOLO-IOD: Towards Real Time Incremental Object Detection
summary: Current methods for incremental object detection (IOD) primarily rely on Faster R-CNN or DETR series detectors; however, these approaches do not accommodate the real-time YOLO detection frameworks. In this paper, we first identify three primary types of knowledge conflicts that contribute to catastrophic forgetting in YOLO-based incremental detectors: foreground-background confusion, parameter interference, and misaligned knowledge distillation. Subsequently, we introduce YOLO-IOD, a real-time Incremental Object Detection (IOD) framework that is constructed upon the pretrained YOLO-World model, facilitating incremental learning via a stage-wise parameter-efficient fine-tuning process. Specifically, YOLO-IOD encompasses three principal components: 1) Conflict-Aware Pseudo-Label Refinement (CPR), which mitigates the foreground-background confusion by leveraging the confidence levels of pseudo labels and identifying potential objects relevant to future tasks. 2) Importancebased Kernel Selection (IKS), which identifies and updates the pivotal convolution kernels pertinent to the current task during the current learning stage. 3) Cross-Stage Asymmetric Knowledge Distillation (CAKD), which addresses the misaligned knowledge distillation conflict by transmitting the features of the student target detector through the detection heads of both the previous and current teacher detectors, thereby facilitating asymmetric distillation between existing and newly introduced categories. We further introduce LoCo COCO, a more realistic benchmark that eliminates data leakage across stages. Experiments on both conventional and LoCo COCO benchmarks show that YOLO-IOD achieves superior performance with minimal forgetting.
summary_zh: 当前增量式目标检测(IOD)的方法主要依赖于Faster R-CNN或DETR系列检测器；然而，这些方法并不适用于实时的YOLO检测框架。在本文中，我们首先识别出导致基于YOLO的增量式检测器中灾难性遗忘的三种主要知识冲突：前景-背景混淆、参数干扰以及未对齐的知识蒸馏。随后，我们提出YOLO-IOD，一个建立在预训练的YOLO-World模型之上的实时增量式目标检测(IOD)框架，它通过阶段性的参数高效微调过程来促进增量学习。具体来说，YOLO-IOD包含三个主要组成部分：1) 冲突感知伪标签精炼(CPR)，通过利用伪标签的置信度并识别与未来任务相关的潜在对象，来缓解前景-背景混淆。2) 基于重要性的核选择(IKS)，识别并更新当前学习阶段中与当前任务相关的关键卷积核。3) 跨阶段非对称知识蒸馏(CAKD)，通过将学生目标检测器的特征传输到先前和当前教师检测器的检测头，从而解决未对齐的知识蒸馏冲突，以此促进现有类别和新引入类别之间的非对称蒸馏。我们进一步引入LoCo COCO，一个更真实的基准，消除了跨阶段的数据泄漏。在传统和LoCo COCO基准上的实验表明，YOLO-IOD实现了卓越的性能，同时最大程度地减少了遗忘。
tldr: The paper introduces YOLO-IOD, a real-time incremental object detection framework built upon YOLO-World, designed to mitigate catastrophic forgetting through conflict-aware pseudo-label refinement, importance-based kernel selection, and cross-stage asymmetric knowledge distillation. It also introduces a new benchmark dataset, LoCo COCO.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了YOLO-IOD，一个基于YOLO-World的实时增量目标检测框架，旨在通过冲突感知伪标签改进、基于重要性的核选择和跨阶段非对称知识蒸馏来减轻灾难性遗忘。它还引入了一个新的基准数据集LoCo COCO。

title: Wavelet-based Multi-View Fusion of 4D Radar Tensor and Camera for Robust 3D Object Detection
summary: 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has been widely adopted in autonomous driving and robot perception due to its low cost and all-weather robustness. However, its inherent sparsity and limited semantic richness significantly constrain perception capability. Recently, fusing camera data with 4D radar has emerged as a promising cost effective solution, by exploiting the complementary strengths of the two modalities. Nevertheless, point-cloud-based radar often suffer from information loss introduced by multi-stage signal processing, while directly utilizing raw 4D radar data incurs prohibitive computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose WRCFormer, a novel 3D object detection framework that fuses raw radar cubes with camera inputs via multi-view representations of the decoupled radar cube. Specifically, we design a Wavelet Attention Module as the basic module of wavelet-based Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) to enhance the representation of sparse radar signals and image data. We further introduce a two-stage query-based, modality-agnostic fusion mechanism termed Geometry-guided Progressive Fusion to efficiently integrate multi-view features from both modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WRCFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on the K-Radar benchmarks, surpassing the best model by approximately 2.4% in all scenarios and 1.6% in the sleet scenario, highlighting its robustness under adverse weather conditions.
summary_zh: 由于其低成本和全天候鲁棒性，4D毫米波雷达已被广泛应用于自动驾驶和机器人感知。然而，其固有的稀疏性和有限的语义丰富性显著地限制了感知能力。最近，通过利用两种模态的互补优势，将相机数据与4D雷达融合已成为一种有前景的经济有效的解决方案。然而，基于点云的雷达通常会受到多阶段信号处理引入的信息丢失的影响，而直接利用原始4D雷达数据则会产生过高的计算成本。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的3D目标检测框架WRCFormer，该框架通过解耦雷达立方体的多视角表示来融合原始雷达立方体与相机输入。具体而言，我们设计了一种小波注意力模块作为基于小波的特征金字塔网络（FPN）的基本模块，以增强稀疏雷达信号和图像数据的表示。我们进一步引入了一种基于查询的两阶段、模态无关的融合机制，称为几何引导渐进融合，以有效地整合来自两种模态的多视角特征。大量实验表明，WRCFormer在K-Radar基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，在所有场景下超过最佳模型约2.4%，在雨夹雪场景下超过1.6%，突出了其在恶劣天气条件下的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper proposes WRCFormer, a novel 3D object detection framework fusing raw 4D radar and camera data using wavelet-based FPN and geometry-guided fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results on K-Radar benchmarks, especially in adverse weather.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了WRCFormer，一种新颖的3D目标检测框架，它融合了原始4D雷达和摄像头数据，采用了基于小波的FPN和几何引导的融合方法，在K-Radar基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，尤其是在恶劣天气下。

title: 3D Scene Change Modeling With Consistent Multi-View Aggregation
summary: Change detection plays a vital role in scene monitoring, exploration, and continual reconstruction. Existing 3D change detection methods often exhibit spatial inconsistency in the detected changes and fail to explicitly separate pre- and post-change states. To address these limitations, we propose SCaR-3D, a novel 3D scene change detection framework that identifies object-level changes from a dense-view pre-change image sequence and sparse-view post-change images. Our approach consists of a signed-distance-based 2D differencing module followed by multi-view aggregation with voting and pruning, leveraging the consistent nature of 3DGS to robustly separate pre- and post-change states. We further develop a continual scene reconstruction strategy that selectively updates dynamic regions while preserving the unchanged areas. We also contribute CCS3D, a challenging synthetic dataset that allows flexible combinations of 3D change types to support controlled evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves both high accuracy and efficiency, outperforming existing methods.
summary_zh: 变更检测在场景监控、探索和持续重建中扮演着至关重要的角色。现有的 3D 变更检测方法常常在检测到的变更中表现出空间不一致性，并且无法明确分离变更前和变更后的状态。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 SCaR-3D，一种新颖的 3D 场景变更检测框架，可以从密集的变更前图像序列和稀疏的变更后图像中识别对象级别的变更。我们的方法包括一个基于有符号距离的 2D 差异模块，以及后续利用投票和剪枝进行的多视角聚合，从而利用 3D 高斯溅射 (3DGS) 的一致性来有效地分离变更前和变更后的状态。我们进一步开发了一种持续场景重建策略，选择性地更新动态区域，同时保留未更改的区域。我们还贡献了 CCS3D，一个具有挑战性的合成数据集，允许灵活组合 3D 变更类型以支持受控评估。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法实现了高精度和高效率，优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper introduces SCaR-3D, a novel framework for 3D scene change detection using multi-view aggregation and consistent 3D Gaussian Splatting, along with a new synthetic dataset, CCS3D, and claims significant performance improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的3D场景变化检测框架SCaR-3D，该框架使用多视图聚合和一致的3D高斯泼溅。论文还提出了一个新的合成数据集CCS3D，并声称性能有显著提高。

title: Mesquite MoCap: Democratizing Real-Time Motion Capture with Affordable, Bodyworn IoT Sensors and WebXR SLAM
summary: Motion capture remains costly and complex to deploy, limiting use outside specialized laboratories. We present Mesquite, an open-source, low-cost inertial motion-capture system that combines a body-worn network of 15 IMU sensor nodes with a hip-worn Android smartphone for position tracking. A low-power wireless link streams quaternion orientations to a central USB dongle and a browser-based application for real-time visualization and recording. Built on modern web technologies -- WebGL for rendering, WebXR for SLAM, WebSerial and WebSockets for device and network I/O, and Progressive Web Apps for packaging -- the system runs cross-platform entirely in the browser. In benchmarks against a commercial optical system, Mesquite achieves mean joint-angle error of 2-5 degrees while operating at approximately 5% of the cost. The system sustains 30 frames per second with end-to-end latency under 15ms and a packet delivery rate of at least 99.7% in standard indoor environments. By leveraging IoT principles, edge processing, and a web-native stack, Mesquite lowers the barrier to motion capture for applications in entertainment, biomechanics, healthcare monitoring, human-computer interaction, and virtual reality. We release hardware designs, firmware, and software under an open-source license (GNU GPL).
summary_zh: 运动捕捉部署成本高昂且复杂，限制了其在专业实验室之外的应用。我们提出 Mesquite，一个开源、低成本的惯性运动捕捉系统，它结合了一个由15个IMU传感器节点组成的体穿戴网络和一个用于位置追踪的髋部佩戴Android智能手机。一个低功耗无线链路将四元数姿态流传输到一个中央USB加密狗和一个基于浏览器的应用，用于实时可视化和记录。该系统构建于现代Web技术之上——WebGL用于渲染，WebXR用于SLAM，WebSerial和WebSockets用于设备和网络I/O，以及用于打包的渐进式Web应用——该系统完全在浏览器中跨平台运行。在与商业光学系统进行的基准测试中，Mesquite实现了平均关节角度误差为2-5度，而成本约为其5%。该系统在标准室内环境下，能以低于15毫秒的端到端延迟和至少99.7%的丢包率维持每秒30帧的速率。通过利用物联网原则、边缘处理和Web原生堆栈，Mesquite降低了娱乐、生物力学、健康监测、人机交互和虚拟现实等应用中运动捕捉的门槛。我们以开源许可（GNU GPL）发布硬件设计、固件和软件。
tldr: The paper introduces Mesquite, an open-source, low-cost inertial motion capture system using wearable sensors and web technologies, achieving performance comparable to commercial systems at a fraction of the cost.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Mesquite的开源、低成本惯性运动捕捉系统，该系统使用可穿戴传感器和Web技术，以远低于商业系统的成本实现了与其相当的性能。

title: Risk-Averse Learning with Varying Risk Levels
summary: In safety-critical decision-making, the environment may evolve over time, and the learner adjusts its risk level accordingly. This work investigates risk-averse online optimization in dynamic environments with varying risk levels, employing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) as the risk measure. To capture the dynamics of the environment and risk levels, we employ the function variation metric and introduce a novel risk-level variation metric. Two information settings are considered: a first-order scenario, where the learner observes both function values and their gradients; and a zeroth-order scenario, where only function evaluations are available. For both cases, we develop risk-averse learning algorithms with a limited sampling budget and analyze their dynamic regret bounds in terms of function variation, risk-level variation, and the total number of samples. The regret analysis demonstrates the adaptability of the algorithms in non-stationary and risk-sensitive settings. Finally, numerical experiments are presented to demonstrate the efficacy of the methods.
summary_zh: 在安全攸关型决策中，环境可能会随时间演变，并且学习者会相应地调整其风险水平。 本文研究了在具有变化风险水平的动态环境中进行具有风险规避性的在线优化，并采用条件风险价值（CVaR）作为风险度量。 为了捕获环境和风险水平的动态性，我们采用了函数变差度量并引入了一种新的风险水平变差度量。 我们考虑了两种信息设置：一种一阶情景，学习者可以观察到函数值及其梯度；以及零阶情景，仅能进行函数评估。 对于这两种情况，我们都开发了具有有限采样预算的风险规避学习算法，并根据函数变差、风险水平变差和样本总数分析了它们的动态后悔界限。 后悔分析证明了算法在非平稳和风险敏感设置中的适应性。 最后，我们通过数值实验展示了这些方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes risk-averse online optimization algorithms using CVaR in dynamic environments with varying risk levels, providing dynamic regret bounds for first-order and zeroth-order information settings and demonstrating their efficacy numerically.
tldr_zh: 本文针对动态环境和变化风险水平下的风险规避在线优化问题，提出了基于条件风险价值(CVaR)的算法。该算法在具有一阶和零阶信息的环境中，针对动态遗憾界限进行了分析，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。

title: Causal-Policy Forest for End-to-End Policy Learning
summary: This study proposes an end-to-end algorithm for policy learning in causal inference. We observe data consisting of covariates, treatment assignments, and outcomes, where only the outcome corresponding to the assigned treatment is observed. The goal of policy learning is to train a policy from the observed data, where a policy is a function that recommends an optimal treatment for each individual, to maximize the policy value. In this study, we first show that maximizing the policy value is equivalent to minimizing the mean squared error for the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) under $\{-1, 1\}$ restricted regression models. Based on this finding, we modify the causal forest, an end-to-end CATE estimation algorithm, for policy learning. We refer to our algorithm as the causal-policy forest. Our algorithm has three advantages. First, it is a simple modification of an existing, widely used CATE estimation method, therefore, it helps bridge the gap between policy learning and CATE estimation in practice. Second, while existing studies typically estimate nuisance parameters for policy learning as a separate task, our algorithm trains the policy in a more end-to-end manner. Third, as in standard decision trees and random forests, we train the models efficiently, avoiding computational intractability.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种用于因果推断中策略学习的端到端算法。我们观察到的数据包括协变量、处理分配和结果，其中仅观察到与分配的处理相对应的结果。策略学习的目标是从观察到的数据中训练策略，该策略是一个为每个人推荐最优处理的函数，以最大化策略价值。在本研究中，我们首先证明了最大化策略价值等价于在$\{-1, 1\}$约束回归模型下最小化条件平均处理效应(CATE)的均方误差。基于这一发现，我们修改了因果森林，一种端到端CATE估计算法，用于策略学习。我们将我们的算法称为因果策略森林。我们的算法具有三个优势。首先，它是对现有且广泛使用的CATE估计方法的简单修改，因此有助于弥合实践中策略学习和CATE估计之间的差距。其次，虽然现有的研究通常将策略学习的干扰参数估计作为一个单独的任务，但我们的算法以一种更加端到端的方式训练策略。第三，正如在标准决策树和随机森林中一样，我们高效地训练模型，避免了计算上的棘手性。
tldr: The paper introduces Causal-Policy Forest, an end-to-end algorithm for policy learning by modifying causal forests to minimize CATE error, bridging the gap between CATE estimation and policy learning with computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Causal-Policy Forest，一种端到端的策略学习算法，通过修改因果森林以最小化CATE误差，弥合了CATE估计和策略学习之间的差距，且计算效率高。

title: Long-Range Distillation: Distilling 10,000 Years of Simulated Climate into Long Timestep AI Weather Models
summary: Accurate long-range weather forecasting remains a major challenge for AI models, both because errors accumulate over autoregressive rollouts and because reanalysis datasets used for training offer a limited sample of the slow modes of climate variability underpinning predictability. Most AI weather models are autoregressive, producing short lead forecasts that must be repeatedly applied to reach subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) or seasonal lead times, often resulting in instability and calibration issues. Long-timestep probabilistic models that generate long-range forecasts in a single step offer an attractive alternative, but training on the 40-year reanalysis record leads to overfitting, suggesting orders of magnitude more training data are required. We introduce long-range distillation, a method that trains a long-timestep probabilistic "student" model to forecast directly at long-range using a huge synthetic training dataset generated by a short-timestep autoregressive "teacher" model. Using the Deep Learning Earth System Model (DLESyM) as the teacher, we generate over 10,000 years of simulated climate to train distilled student models for forecasting across a range of timescales. In perfect-model experiments, the distilled models outperform climatology and approach the skill of their autoregressive teacher while replacing hundreds of autoregressive steps with a single timestep. In the real world, they achieve S2S forecast skill comparable to the ECMWF ensemble forecast after ERA5 fine-tuning. The skill of our distilled models scales with increasing synthetic training data, even when that data is orders of magnitude larger than ERA5. This represents the first demonstration that AI-generated synthetic training data can be used to scale long-range forecast skill.
summary_zh: 准确的长时程天气预报对于 AI 模型而言仍然是一项主要的挑战，这既是因为误差会在自回归展开过程中累积，也因为用于训练的再分析数据集对支撑可预测性的气候变率慢模式提供了有限的样本。 大多数 AI 天气模型都是自回归的，生成短期领先时间的预报，这些预报必须重复应用才能达到次季节到季节（S2S）或季节性领先时间，这通常会导致不稳定性和校准问题。 一步式生成长时程预报的长时间步概率模型提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但是在 40 年的再分析记录上进行训练会导致过拟合，表明需要数量级更大的训练数据。 我们引入了长时程蒸馏，这是一种训练长时间步概率“学生”模型的方法，该方法使用短时间步自回归“教师”模型生成的巨大合成训练数据集直接预测长时程。 使用深度学习地球系统模型（DLESyM）作为教师，我们生成了超过 10,000 年的模拟气候来训练蒸馏后的学生模型，以预测各种时间尺度。 在完美模型实验中，蒸馏后的模型优于气候学基线，并接近其自回归教师模型的技能水平，同时用单步取代了数百个自回归步骤。 在现实世界中，经过 ERA5 微调后，它们实现了与欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）集合预报相当的 S2S 预报技能。 我们的蒸馏模型的技能随着合成训练数据的增加而扩展，即使该数据比 ERA5 大几个数量级。 这代表着首次证明 AI 生成的合成训练数据可用于扩展长时程预报技能。
tldr: The paper introduces 'long-range distillation,' a method using synthetic climate data generated by a teacher model to train long-timestep AI weather models. These distilled models show improved long-range forecasting skill, even exceeding traditional methods when fine-tuned with real-world data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“远距离蒸馏”的方法，该方法使用教师模型生成的合成气候数据来训练长时间步长的AI天气模型。 这种蒸馏模型显示出改进的长期预测能力，甚至在经过真实世界数据微调后超过了传统方法。

title: PreGME: Prescribed Performance Control of Aerial Manipulators based on Variable-Gain ESO
summary:
An aerial manipulator, comprising a multirotor base and a robotic arm, is subject to significant dynamic coupling between these two components. Therefore, achieving precise and robust motion control is a challenging yet important objective. Here, we propose a novel prescribed performance motion control framework based on variable-gain extended state observers (ESOs), referred to as PreGME. The method includes variable-gain ESOs for real-time estimation of dynamic coupling and a prescribed performance flight control that incorporates error trajectory constraints. Compared with existing methods, the proposed approach exhibits the following two characteristics. First, the adopted variable-gain ESOs can accurately estimate rapidly varying dynamic coupling. This enables the proposed method to handle manipulation tasks that require aggressive motion of the robotic arm. Second, by prescribing the performance, a preset error trajectory is generated to guide the system evolution along this trajectory. This strategy allows the proposed method to ensure the tracking error remains within the prescribed performance envelope, thereby achieving high-precision control. Experiments on a real platform, including aerial staff twirling, aerial mixology, and aerial cart-pulling experiments, are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
  Experimental results demonstrate that even under the dynamic coupling caused by rapid robotic arm motion (end-effector velocity: 1.02 m/s, acceleration: 5.10 m/s$^2$), the proposed method achieves high tracking performance.
summary_zh: 一种由多旋翼飞行器和机械臂组成的空中机械臂机构，其两部分之间存在显著的动态耦合。因此，实现精确且鲁棒的运动控制是一项具有挑战性但十分重要的目标。本文提出了一种基于变增益扩展状态观测器（ESO）的新型预设性能运动控制框架，称为PreGME。该方法包括用于实时估计动态耦合的变增益ESO，以及包含误差轨迹约束的预设性能飞行控制。与现有方法相比，所提出的方法具有以下两个特点。首先，所采用的变增益ESO能够准确估计快速变化的动态耦合。这使得该方法能够处理需要机械臂进行剧烈运动的操纵任务。其次，通过预设性能，生成预设误差轨迹以引导系统沿着该轨迹演化。该策略允许该方法确保跟踪误差保持在预设性能范围内，从而实现高精度控制。通过在真实平台进行的实验，包括空中棍棒旋转、空中调酒和空中拉车实验，验证了该方法的有效性。实验结果表明，即使在机器人手臂快速运动引起的动态耦合下（末端执行器速度：1.02 m/s，加速度：5.10 m/s$^2$），所提出的方法也能实现高跟踪性能。
tldr: This paper introduces PreGME, a novel prescribed performance motion control framework with variable-gain extended state observers for aerial manipulators, demonstrating robust tracking performance under significant dynamic coupling in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的预定性能运动控制框架PreGME，该框架采用变增益扩展状态观测器用于空中机械臂，并在实际实验中展示了在显着动态耦合下的稳健跟踪性能。

title: Two-Robot Computational Landscape: A Complete Characterization of Model Power in Minimal Mobile Robot Systems
summary: The computational power of autonomous mobile robots under the Look-Compute-Move (LCM) model has been widely studied through an extensive hierarchy of robot models defined by the presence of memory, communication, and synchrony assumptions. While the general n-robot landscape has been largely established, the exact structure for two robots has remained unresolved. This paper presents the first complete characterization of the computational power of two autonomous robots across all major models, namely OBLOT, FSTA, FCOM, and LUMI, under the full spectrum of schedulers (FSYNCH, SSYNCH, ASYNCH, and their atomic variants). Our results reveal a landscape that fundamentally differs from the general case. Most notably, we prove that FSTA^F and LUMI^F coincide under full synchrony, a surprising collapse indicating that perfect synchrony can substitute both memory and communication when only two robots exist. We also show that FSTA and FCOM are orthogonal: there exists a problem solvable in the weakest communication model but impossible even in the strongest finite-state model, completing the bidirectional incomparability. All equivalence and separation results are derived through a novel simulation-free method, providing a unified and constructive view of the two-robot hierarchy. This yields the first complete and exact computational landscape for two robots, highlighting the intrinsic challenges of coordination at the minimal scale.
summary_zh: 在观察-计算-移动 (LCM) 模型下，自主移动机器人的计算能力已被广泛研究，通过由是否存在记忆、通信和同步假设定义的机器人模型构建了一套详尽的层级结构。虽然通用的 n 机器人图景已基本确立，但两个机器人的精确结构仍未解决。本文首次完整刻画了两个自主机器人在所有主要模型（即 OBLOT、FSTA、FCOM 和 LUMI）下，在完整调度器谱（FSYNCH、SSYNCH、ASYNCH 及其原子变体）中的计算能力。我们的结果揭示了一个与一般情况截然不同的图景。最值得注意的是，我们证明了 FSTA^F 和 LUMI^F 在完全同步下重合，这是一个令人惊讶的坍缩，表明当只有两个机器人存在时，完美的同步可以替代记忆和通信。我们还表明 FSTA 和 FCOM 是正交的：存在一个在最弱通信模型中可解的问题，但在最强的有限状态模型中也不可能解决，从而完成了双向不可比性。所有等价和分离结果都通过一种新颖的无模拟方法推导得出，从而为双机器人层级结构提供了一个统一且建设性的视角。这产生了第一个完整且精确的双机器人计算图景，突显了在最小规模下协调的内在挑战。
tldr: This paper provides a complete characterization of the computational power of two robots under different model assumptions (OBLOT, FSTA, FCOM, LUMI) and scheduler types (FSYNCH, etc.), revealing a landscape that differs significantly from the general n-robot case and demonstrating unexpected equivalences and separations.
tldr_zh: 本文全面描述了两个机器人在不同模型假设（OBLOT、FSTA、FCOM、LUMI）和调度器类型（FSYNCH 等）下的计算能力，揭示了一个与一般 n 机器人情况显著不同的格局，展示了意想不到的等价性和分离。

title: A Neural Network-Based Real-time Casing Collar Recognition System for Downhole Instruments
summary: Accurate downhole positioning is critical in oil and gas operations but is often compromised by signal degradation in traditional surface-based Casing Collar Locator (CCL) monitoring. To address this, we present an in-situ, real-time collar recognition system using embedded neural network. We introduce lightweight "Collar Recognition Nets" (CRNs) optimized for resource-constrained ARM Cortex-M7 microprocessors. By leveraging temporal and depthwise separable convolutions, our most compact model reduces computational complexity to just 8,208 MACs while maintaining an F1 score of 0.972. Hardware validation confirms an average inference latency of 343.2 μs, demonstrating that robust, autonomous signal processing is feasible within the severe power and space limitations of downhole instrumentation.
summary_zh: 精确的井下定位在油气作业中至关重要，但传统的基于地面的套管扶正器定位器(CCL)监测通常会因信号衰减而受到影响。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种使用嵌入式神经网络的井下原位、实时套管扶正器识别系统。我们引入了轻量级的“套管扶正器识别网络”(CRNs)，该网络针对资源受限的ARM Cortex-M7微处理器进行了优化。通过利用时域和深度可分离卷积，我们最紧凑的模型将计算复杂度降低到仅8,208个MAC操作，同时保持了0.972的F1得分。硬件验证确认平均推理延迟为343.2μs，这表明在井下仪器的严格功率和空间限制下，稳健的自主信号处理是可行的。
tldr: This paper presents an embedded neural network system for real-time casing collar recognition in downhole instruments, optimized for low-resource environments using compact convolutional architectures, achieving high accuracy and low latency.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于井下仪器中实时套管定位的嵌入式神经网络系统。该系统使用紧凑的卷积架构进行了优化，以适应低资源环境，实现了高精度和低延迟。

title: A Minimal Solver for Relative Pose Estimation with Unknown Focal Length from Two Affine Correspondences
summary: In this paper, we aim to estimate the relative pose and focal length between two views with known intrinsic parameters except for an unknown focal length from two affine correspondences (ACs). Cameras are commonly used in combination with inertial measurement units (IMUs) in applications such as self-driving cars, smartphones, and unmanned aerial vehicles. The vertical direction of camera views can be obtained by IMU measurements. The relative pose between two cameras is reduced from 5DOF to 3DOF. We propose a new solver to estimate the 3DOF relative pose and focal length. First, we establish constraint equations from two affine correspondences when the vertical direction is known. Then, based on the properties of the equation system with nontrivial solutions, four equations can be derived. These four equations only involve two parameters: the focal length and the relative rotation angle. Finally, the polynomial eigenvalue method is utilized to solve the problem of focal length and relative rotation angle. The proposed solver is evaluated using synthetic and real-world datasets. The results show that our solver performs better than the existing state-of-the-art solvers.
summary_zh: 本文旨在从两个仿射对应(ACs)中估计两个视角之间的相对姿态和焦距，两个视角的内参已知，但焦距未知。在自动驾驶汽车、智能手机和无人机等应用中，相机通常与惯性测量单元(IMU)结合使用。可以通过IMU测量获得相机视角的垂直方向。两相机之间的相对姿态从5DOF减少到3DOF。我们提出了一种新的求解器来估计3DOF相对姿态和焦距。首先，在垂直方向已知的情况下，我们从两个仿射对应建立约束方程。然后，基于具有非平凡解的方程组的性质，可以导出四个方程。这四个方程只涉及两个参数：焦距和相对旋转角。最后，利用多项式特征值方法来解决焦距和相对旋转角的问题。使用合成和真实世界数据集对所提出的求解器进行评估。结果表明，我们的求解器比现有的最先进求解器表现更好。
tldr: This paper presents a minimal solver for relative pose estimation and focal length calibration using only two affine correspondences and leveraging known vertical direction (e.g., from IMU data), outperforming current state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种极简求解器，利用两个仿射对应关系和已知的垂直方向（例如来自IMU数据），来估计相对姿态和焦距校准，并且优于当前最先进的方法。

title: Nonlinear Dynamical Modeling of Human Intracranial Brain Activity with Flexible Inference
summary: Dynamical modeling of multisite human intracranial neural recordings is essential for developing neurotechnologies such as brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Linear dynamical models are widely used for this purpose due to their interpretability and their suitability for BCIs. In particular, these models enable flexible real-time inference, even in the presence of missing neural samples, which often occur in wireless BCIs. However, neural activity can exhibit nonlinear structure that is not captured by linear models. Furthermore, while recurrent neural network models can capture nonlinearity, their inference does not directly address handling missing observations. To address this gap, recent work introduced DFINE, a deep learning framework that integrates neural networks with linear state-space models to capture nonlinearities while enabling flexible inference. However, DFINE was developed for intracortical recordings that measure localized neuronal populations. Here we extend DFINE to modeling of multisite human intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings. We find that DFINE significantly outperforms linear state-space models (LSSMs) in forecasting future neural activity. Furthermore, DFINE matches or exceeds the accuracy of a gated recurrent unit (GRU) model in neural forecasting, indicating that a linear dynamical backbone, when paired and jointly trained with nonlinear neural networks, can effectively describe the dynamics of iEEG signals while also enabling flexible inference. Additionally, DFINE handles missing observations more robustly than the baselines, demonstrating its flexible inference and utility for BCIs. Finally, DFINE's advantage over LSSM is more pronounced in high gamma spectral bands. Taken together, these findings highlight DFINE as a strong and flexible framework for modeling human iEEG dynamics, with potential applications in next-generation BCIs.
summary_zh: 对多部位人体颅内神经记录进行动态建模对于开发诸如脑机接口(BCI)等神经技术至关重要。线性动态模型因其可解释性和适用于BCI而被广泛使用。特别地，这些模型能够实现灵活的实时推理，即使在存在缺失神经样本的情况下，这在无线BCI中经常发生。然而，神经活动可能会表现出线性模型无法捕捉的非线性结构。此外，虽然循环神经网络模型可以捕捉非线性，但它们的推理并没有直接解决处理缺失观测值的问题。为了弥补这一差距，最近的研究引入了DFINE，一个深度学习框架，它将神经网络与线性状态空间模型相结合，以捕捉非线性并实现灵活的推理。然而，DFINE是为测量局部神经元群体的皮质内记录而开发的。在这里，我们将DFINE扩展到多部位人体颅内脑电图(iEEG)记录的建模。我们发现，在预测未来神经活动方面，DFINE明显优于线性状态空间模型(LSSM)。此外，DFINE在神经预测方面达到了或超过了门控循环单元(GRU)模型的准确性，表明线性动态骨干与非线性神经网络配对并联合训练时，可以有效地描述iEEG信号的动态，同时实现灵活的推理。另外，DFINE处理缺失观测值的能力比基线模型更稳健，证明了其灵活的推理能力和在BCI中的实用性。最后，DFINE相对于LSSM的优势在高伽马频谱频段中更为明显。总而言之，这些发现突显了DFINE作为一个强大而灵活的框架，用于建模人体iEEG动态，并在下一代BCI中具有潜在的应用。
tldr: This paper extends a deep learning framework called DFINE for modeling human intracranial EEG (iEEG) data, demonstrating its superior performance over linear models and comparable accuracy to GRUs while handling missing data robustly, making it suitable for brain-computer interfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了一个名为DFINE的深度学习框架，用于建模人类颅内脑电图（iEEG）数据，证明其性能优于线性模型，并且与GRU模型具有相当的准确性，同时能够稳健地处理缺失数据，使其适用于脑机接口。

title: Act2Goal: From World Model To General Goal-conditioned Policy
summary: Specifying robotic manipulation tasks in a manner that is both expressive and precise remains a central challenge. While visual goals provide a compact and unambiguous task specification, existing goal-conditioned policies often struggle with long-horizon manipulation due to their reliance on single-step action prediction without explicit modeling of task progress. We propose Act2Goal, a general goal-conditioned manipulation policy that integrates a goal-conditioned visual world model with multi-scale temporal control. Given a current observation and a target visual goal, the world model generates a plausible sequence of intermediate visual states that captures long-horizon structure. To translate this visual plan into robust execution, we introduce Multi-Scale Temporal Hashing (MSTH), which decomposes the imagined trajectory into dense proximal frames for fine-grained closed-loop control and sparse distal frames that anchor global task consistency. The policy couples these representations with motor control through end-to-end cross-attention, enabling coherent long-horizon behavior while remaining reactive to local disturbances. Act2Goal achieves strong zero-shot generalization to novel objects, spatial layouts, and environments. We further enable reward-free online adaptation through hindsight goal relabeling with LoRA-based finetuning, allowing rapid autonomous improvement without external supervision. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that Act2Goal improves success rates from 30% to 90% on challenging out-of-distribution tasks within minutes of autonomous interaction, validating that goal-conditioned world models with multi-scale temporal control provide structured guidance necessary for robust long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://act2goal.github.io/
summary_zh: 以表达性和精确性兼顾的方式指定机器人操作任务仍然是一项核心挑战。虽然视觉目标提供了紧凑且明确的任务规范，但现有的目标条件策略通常难以处理长程操作任务，因为它们依赖于单步动作预测，而没有显式地建模任务进度。我们提出了Act2Goal，一个通用的目标条件操作策略，它整合了目标条件视觉世界模型和多尺度时间控制。给定当前观测和目标视觉目标，世界模型生成一系列合理的中间视觉状态，这些状态捕捉了长程结构。为了将这种视觉规划转化为稳健的执行，我们引入了多尺度时间哈希（MSTH），它将想象的轨迹分解为密集的近端帧，用于细粒度的闭环控制，以及稀疏的远端帧，以锚定全局任务一致性。该策略通过端到端交叉注意力将这些表示与电机控制相结合，从而实现连贯的长程行为，同时对局部扰动保持反应性。Act2Goal在 novel 对象、空间布局和环境中实现了强大的零样本泛化。我们进一步通过带有LoRA微调的事后目标重标记实现了无奖励的在线自适应，从而在没有外部监督的情况下实现快速的自主改进。真实机器人实验表明，Act2Goal在具有挑战性的分布外任务上，在自主交互的几分钟内将成功率从30%提高到90%，验证了具有多尺度时间控制的目标条件世界模型提供了稳健的长程操作所需的结构化指导。项目页面：https://act2goal.github.io/
tldr: Act2Goal is a goal-conditioned manipulation policy using a world model and multi-scale temporal control for robust long-horizon robotic tasks, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization and rapid online adaptation through hindsight relabeling.
tldr_zh: Act2Goal 是一种目标条件操纵策略，它使用世界模型和多尺度时间控制来实现鲁棒的长期机器人任务，展示了强大的零样本泛化能力，并通过事后重新标记实现快速在线适应。

title: Replay Failures as Successes: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown promise for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) to follow instructions with various constraints. Despite the encouraging results, RL improvement inevitably relies on sampling successful, high-quality responses; however, the initial model often struggles to generate responses that satisfy all constraints due to its limited capabilities, yielding sparse or indistinguishable rewards that impede learning. In this work, we propose Hindsight instruction Replay (HiR), a novel sample-efficient RL framework for complex instruction following tasks, which employs a select-then-rewrite strategy to replay failed attempts as successes based on the constraints that have been satisfied in hindsight. We perform RL on these replayed samples as well as the original ones, theoretically framing the objective as dual-preference learning at both the instruction- and response-level to enable efficient optimization using only a binary reward signal. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed HiR yields promising results across different instruction following tasks, while requiring less computational budget. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/sastpg/HIR.
summary_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 已展现出将大型语言模型 (LLM) 与具有各种约束的指令对齐的潜力。尽管取得了令人鼓舞的成果，但强化学习的改进不可避免地依赖于对成功的、高质量响应进行采样；然而，初始模型由于其有限的能力，通常难以生成满足所有约束的响应，从而产生稀疏或难以区分的奖励，阻碍学习。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的、具有样本高效性的强化学习框架——后见之明指令重放 (HiR)，用于复杂的指令遵循任务。该框架采用一种先选择后重写的策略，基于事后已满足的约束，将失败的尝试重放为成功案例。我们对这些重放样本以及原始样本执行强化学习，在理论上将目标定义为指令级别和响应级别的双重偏好学习，从而仅使用二元奖励信号即可实现高效优化。大量的实验表明，所提出的 HiR 在不同的指令遵循任务中取得了有希望的结果，同时需要更少的计算资源。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/sastpg/HIR 上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Hindsight Instruction Replay (HiR), a sample-efficient RL method that replays failed attempts as successes in instruction following tasks, leading to improved performance with less computation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了事后指令回放（HiR），这是一种样本高效的强化学习方法，通过将指令跟随任务中的失败尝试作为成功案例进行回放，从而以更少的计算量提高性能。

title: DriveLaW:Unifying Planning and Video Generation in a Latent Driving World
summary: World models have become crucial for autonomous driving, as they learn how scenarios evolve over time to address the long-tail challenges of the real world.
